paragraph.text: Uchunge-chunge lwezifundo ezizofundwa kulekota, “Ukuhamba noJesu,” zisekelwe encwadini i-Steps to Christ. Lencwadi ingafundwa, isahluko ngesahluko, njengephawula izifundo zoMbhalo engcwele.

Abanye abafundi besikolo seSabatha bazokhumbula ukuthi lesihloko sike safundwa ngaphambili, ngekota lokuqala lonyaka ka-1980. Kuyintokozo kithi ukusiletha futhi ngomqondo omusha nangemininingwane eyengeziwe, kodwa amaqiniso ayafana ngokujulile nalawo akhulunywa ngaphambili.

Kaningi abantu bacabanga ngoBaba wabo osezulwini njengobandayo futhi okude, umahluleli olukhuni nononya. Bakhohlwa ukujula kothando Lwakhe kubona, nonakekelo olunesihe olukhona enhliziyweni Yakhe maqondana nabo bonke abantwana Bakhe.

Uthando lukaNkulunkulu kufanele lube yinto yokuqala ekhona. Bese kulandela umcabango wokuthi isoni asinakuzisiza futhi asinalo ithemba, nokuthi badinga uMsindisi. Ukuphila kukaKristu, oweza ukusindisa izoni, ebonisa ukuthi ikhona indlela eqinisekile yokubuyela kuBaba osezulwini.

Izihloko ezichazwa yilezifundo zithinta amava amakhulu okuphila kwamaKrestu amukelwa ngokukhethekile omusha ekukholweni ofuna ukukhula emseni. Bonke abakholwayo kufanele bahlole izihloko ngezinye izikhathi-futhi kungabi ngenzuzo yabo kuphela, ukuba baqaphele indlela elungile yokusiza abanye ukuba beze nabo kuKristu.

Ukulethwa ngohlelo imfundiso yeqiniso kungaholela ekuqondeni nelamukelwa yibo, nokusiza umuntu ukuthi angemukelwa njengelunga lebandla. Kodwa ngaphandle kokuthi angalethwa ebudllelwaneni noKristu, akanakho ukuphila ngempela-ukuphila okuphakade. Ngeqiniso, yilowo kuphela “okholwa kwiNdodana unokuphila okuphakade” (Johane 3:36).

Ilunga ngalinye lesikolo seSabatha kufanele lifakazele uMoya ngomoya walo ukuthi ngempela wamukelwe emndenini kaNkulunkulu. Ngamunye kufanele aqonde ukuthi isibonelo sakhe, sokweyama kwabo njalo kuBaba osezulwini, ngezikhathi zonke nangezinto zonke, kufanele ziqiniseke futhi zisebenze. Badinga kakhulu kunokuba babebuthakathaka, uthando lomuntu. Bonke badinga uthando lukaNkulunkulu-uthando lukaNkulunkulu olungazicabangeli-malutshalwe ezinhliziyweni zabo nasemiphefumulweni ukuze bangathanda njengoba Yena athanda.
Kwangathi lokhu kungaba amava elunga ngalinye lesikolo seSabatha.

lessons.title: Uthando LukaNkulunkulu Kumuntu
lessons.keyTextVerse: IVESI LEKHANDA: “Bhekani uthando olungaka asinike lona uBaba lokuba sithiwe singabantwana bakaNkulunkulu; futhi siyibo. Ngalokho izwe alisazi, ngokuba alimazanga yena”

keyText.text: IVESI LEKHANDA: “Bhekani uthando olungaka asinike lona uBaba lokuba sithiwe singabantwana bakaNkulunkulu; futhi siyibo. Ngalokho izwe alisazi, ngokuba alimazanga yena”

keyNote.text: “UNkulunkulu uluthando. Njengemisebe yokukhanya evela elangeni, uthando nokukhanya nenjabulo kuphuma Kuye kuye kuzo zonke izidalwa Zakhe.”-Thoughts from the Mount of Blessing, p. 77.

q.text: a. Yibuphi ubufakazi bothando lukaNkulunkulu olunikezwe abantu-na? Exodusi 34:6, 7;

note.text: “Izwi likaNkulunkulu liveza isimilo Sakhe. Yena uQobo wamemezela ngothando Lwakhe olungapheli nozwelo. Lapho uMose ekhuleka, ‘Ake ngibone inkazimulo Yakho, uJehova wathi, ‘Ngiyakudlulisa phambi kwakho ubuhle Bami.’ Eksodusi 33:18, 19. Lena inkazimulo Yakhe. UJehova wadlula phambi kukaMose, wamemeza wathi, NguJehova! NguJehova! NguNkulunkulu ogcwele isihe, onomusa, ophuza ukuthukuthela, novame ubumnene neqiniso, ogcinela izinkulungwane umusa, othethelela ububi neziphambeko.’ Eksodusi 34:6, 7. Wephuza ukuthukuthela, unesihe esikhulu,’ ‘ngokuba wenamela umusa.’ Jona 4:2; Mika 7:18.”-Steps to Christ, p. 10.

q.text: b. Beliyini icebo likaNkulunkulu ngokuthumela iNdodana Yakhe-na?

note.text: “USathane uholela abantu ukuba bacabange ngoNkulunkulu njengesidalwa ukucabangela kwaso kungukulunga okulukhuni-umahluleli oqinile, nolukhuni, owedlulisa amalungelo akhe. Ufanekisa uMdali njengomuntu obheke ngeliso lomona ukubona amaphutha neziphambeko zabantu, ukuze abahambele ngezahlulelo zakhe. Kwakungenxa yokususa lelithunzi elimnyama, ngokwembula emhlabeni uthando lukaNkulunkulu olungapheli, lokuthi uJesu weza wahlala phakathi kwabantu.”-Ibid., p. 11.

q.text: a. U-Jesu uchaza kanjani umsebenzi Wakhe emhlabeni-na?

note.text: “[Ku-Luka 4:18 ngokuphindwa.] Lona ngumsebenzi [kaJesu]. Wayehamba enza okuhle ephulukisa bonke abacindezelwe nguSathane. Kwakukhona yonke imizana lapho kwakungekho ukububula kwezifo kunoma ngeyiphi indlu, ngoba wayedabula kuyo futhi epholisa bonke abagulayo bayo. Umsebenzi Wakhe wanikeza ubufakazi bobungcwele bokugcotshwa Kwakhe. Uthando, umusa, isihawu kwembulwa kwisenzo ngasinye sokuphila Kwakhe; inhliziyo Yakhe yelulwa ngozwelo olumnene kubantwana babantu. Wathatha imvelo yomuntu, ukuze afinyelele kwizimfuno zomuntu. Abampofu kakhulu nabathobekile babengesabi ukusondela Kuye. Ngisho nabantwana abancane babedonselwa Kuye. Babethanda ukukhwela ezinyaweni Zakhe babheke ubuso obunomunyu, obugcwele uthando.”-Steps to Christ, pp. 11, 12.

“UJesu ubona kuwo wonke umphefumulo umuntu okufanele abizelwe embusweni Wakhe. Wafinyelela ezinhliziyweni zabantu ngokuhamba phakathi kwabo njengalowo ofisa okuhle kubo. Wayebafuna emigwaqeni yomphakathi, kumakhaya abo ngasese, emikhunjini, kumasinagoge, ngasogwini lomfula, edilini lomshado. Wayehlangana nabo emisebenzini yemihla ngemihla, futhi ebonakalisa intakazelelo ezindabeni zabo zezwe. Wayethwala iseluleko Sakhe emakhaya, eletha imindeni ezindlini zabo ngaphansi komfutho wobukhona Bakhe obungcwele. Ubuntu Bakhe bozwelo olunamandla lwasiza ukuzuza izinhliziyo. Kaningi wayeya entabeni eyokhuleka eyedwa, kodwa ngalokhu wayelungisela umsebenzi Wakhe phakathi kwabantu ngempilo ekhuthele. Ngalezikhathi weza ukuba elaphe abagulayo, afundise abangenalo ulwazi, nokuphula amaketanga obugqila bukaSathane.”-The Desire of Ages, p. 151.

q.text: b. Noma egcwele uthando nesihawu, siyini isibonelo sokwethembeka kukaKristu ekukhuzeni ukungalungi-na? 1 Johane 9:39-41;

note.text: “UJesu akazange acindezele nelilodwa izwi leqiniso, kodwa kaningi wayelikhuluma ngothando. Ubesebenzisa ukuhlakanipha okukhulu nokunaka, ubumnene obuthathekisayo ekuxhumaneni Kwakhe nabantu. Akazange ahlambalaze umuntu, akazange akhulume izwi eliqinile, akazange ngokungenasidingo azwise umphefumulo ozwelayo ubuhlungu. Akazange agxeke ubuthakathaka bomuntu. Ubekhuluma iqiniso, kodwa kaningi elikhuluma ngothando. Wayesola ukuzenzisa, ukungakholwa, kanye nobubi; kodwa izinyembezi zazisezwini Lakhe lapho ekhuluma ukusola Kwakhe okuhlabayo…Wonke umphefumulo uyigugu emehlweni Akhe. Lapho ethwele Kuye isithunzi esingcwele, wazithoba ngobumnene maqondana nelunga ngalinye lomkhaya kaNkulunkulu. Kubantu bonke wayebona imiphefumulo okungumsebenzi Wakhe ukuwusindisa.”-Steps to Christ, pp. 12.

q.text: a. Yimuphi umthwalo osindayo owathwala nguMsindisi wethu ekuphileni Kwakhe-na?

note.text: “UJesu wathwala umthwalo owesabekayo wokuziphendulela ngensindiso yabantu. Ubazi ukuthi ngaphandle kwenguquko enqumayo kwizimiso nezinhloso zesizwe soluntu, bonke bazolahlwa. Lona bekungumthwalo womphefumulo Wakhe, nokuthi akekho ozoqonda umthwalo ohlezi phezu Kwakhe. Kusukela ebuntwaneni Bakhe, ebusheni Bakhe, nasebudodeni, wayehamba yedwa. Nokho izulu kwakufanele libe sebukhoneni Bakhe. Imihla ngemihla wayehlangana nezilingo nokuhlolwa; imihla ngemihla elethwa ekuhlanganeni nobubi, efakazela amandla awo phezu kwalabo afuna ukubabusisa nokubasindisa. Kodwa akazange ehluleke noma adangale.

“Ezintweni zonke wayeletha izifiso Zakhe ngaphansi kokumisa okuqinile emsebenzini Wakhe. Wakhazimulisa ukuphila Kwakhe ngokwenza konke kuthobele intando kaBaba Wakhe. Ebusheni Bakhe, umama Wakhe, lapho emfunana esikolweni sawo-rrabi, wathi, “Mtanami, usenzeleni okunje-na?’ Wathi kubo-futhi impendulo Yakhe iyisihluthulelo somsebenzi wokuphila Kwakhe- ‘Kukanjani beningifunelani-na? beningazi yini ukuthi kumelwe ukuba ngibe-kokukaBaba-na?

“Ukuphila Kwakhe kaningi bekungumnikelo wokuzidela. Ubengenalo ikhaya kulomhlaba, ngaphandle komusa abangane abamnika Wona njengesihambi. Weza ukuba aphile ngenxa yethu ukuphila kompofu kakhulu, futhi wayehamba esebenza phakathi kwabantu abadingayo nabahluphekile. Lowo ongavunywa nongahlonishwa, wayengena ephuma phakathi kwabantu labo abenzele okukhulu.”-Gospel Workers, pp. 42, 43.

q.text: b. Uthando oluphuphumayo lukaNkulunkulu lusifundisani maqondana noBaba wethu osezulwini-na?

note.text: “Lomhlatshelo omkhulu awenzelwanga ukuthi kwakheke enhliziyweni kaBaba uthando ngomuntu, kungamenzi futhi athande ukusindisa. Cha, cha! ‘UNkulunkulu walithanda izwe kangaka, waze wanikela ngeNdodana Yakhe ezelwe yodwa.’ Johane 3:16. UBaba uyasithanda, kungesikho ngenxa yenhlawulo enkulu, kodwa wasenzela inhlawulo ngoba esithanda. UKristu ungumxhumanisi ongathulula uthando Lwakhe olungapheli phezu komhlaba owileyo. ‘Ngokuba uNkulunkulu ekuKristu, wenza ukuba izwe libuyisane Naye.’ 2 Korinte 5:19. UNkulunkulu wahlupheka neNdodana Yakhe. Osizini Lwakhe eGetsemane, ukufa eKhalvari, ngenhliziyo yoThando Olungapheli wakhokha inani lenhlawulo yethu.”-Steps to Christ, p. 13.

q.text: a. Siyini isisekelo sokusindiswa kwemiphefumulo yethu-na?

note.text: “Maye, yimuphi umphefumulo olambele nolangazela njengo-Kristu abenakho ukusindisa lokho okwakulahlekile. Umzimba owabethelwa esiphambanweni awuzange unciphise ubungcwele Bakhe. Amandla Akhe obuNkulunkulu ukusindisa ngomhlatshelo womuntu, bonke abazokwamukela ukulunga Kwakhe. Ngokufa esiphambanweni, wadlulisa icala kumuntu owonile ukuya kumbambeli ongcwele ngokukholwa Kuye njengoMhlengi wakhe. Izono zezwe elinecala, ngesibonelo esifanekiswa ‘njengezibomvu okwegazi,’ zabekwa Kwisiqinisekiso esingcwele.”-This Day with God, p. 236.

q.text: b. Kuyini okwenziwa nguKristu ngokuhlengwa kwethu okungaphezu kwanoma yimuphi umzamo womuntu noma ukuhlakanipha-na?

note.text: “UBaba Wami uthe wakuthanda kangaka nokuthi uyangithanda Nami kakhulu ukuba anikele ngokuphila Kwami ukuba akusindise. Ngokuba uMbambeli nesiQiniseko senu, ngokunikela ngokuphila Kwami, ngokuthatha amacala enu, nokweqa kwenu umthetho, ngiyathandeka kuBaba Wami; ngokuba ngomhlatshelo Wami, uNkulunkulu angaba ngolungile, nokho olungisisa lowo okholwa kuJesu.’

“Akukho noyedwa ngaphandle kweNdodana kaNkulunkulu ongaphelelisa ukuhlengwa kwethu; ngoba Nguye kuphela osesifubeni sikaBaba ongasho Ngaye. Nguye kuphela owazi ukuphakama nokujula kothando lukaNkulunkulu ongenza kubesobala. Akukho nokuncane ngaphandle komhlatshelo ongapheli owenziwa nguKristu ngenxa yomuntu owileyo ongacindezela uthando lukaBaba kuluntu oluwileyo.”-Steps to Christ, p. 14.

q.text: c. Kuyini uJohane akufakazela ngommeli wethu esihlalweni sobukhosi sikaNkulunkulu-na?

note.text: “Kukhona abambalwa abaqonda isimilo sesono esibi kakhulu, labo abazindla ngobukhulu bomonakalo ongumphumela wokwephulwa komthetho kaNkulunkulu. Ngokuhlola icebo elimangalisayo losindiso ukubuyisela isoni kumfanekiso omuhle kaNkulunkulu, siyabona ukuthi indlela yinye kuphela yokukhululwa komuntu yenziwa ngomhlatshelo wokuzidela, ukweyisa okungelinganiswe nothando lweNdodana kaNkulunkulu. Nguye kuphela obenamandla okulwa izimpi nesitha esikhulu sikaNkulunkulu nomuntu, futhi, njengombambeli wethu nesiqiniseko, unikile amandla labo ababambelela ngokuqina Kuye ngokukholwa, ukuba ngabanqobi egameni Lakhe, nangokufaneleka Kwakhe.”-Christian Education, p. 112.

q.text: a. Kuyini okwenza uKristu afaneleke ukukhokha inani lokuhlengwa kwethu-na? 1 Peter 1:18, 19;

note.text: “Inani elikhokhiwe ngenxa yokuhlengwa kwethu, umhlatshelo ongapheli kaBaba wethu ngokunikela ngeNdodana Yakhe ukuba isifele, kufanele kusinike umcabango ophakeme esingaba yikho ngoKristu. Njengoba umpostoli uJohane ophefumulelwe ebona ukuphakama, nokujula, nobubanzi bothando lukaBaba esizweni esibhubhayo, wagcwala ukudumisa kanye nenhlonipho; futhi wehluleka nokuthola amazwi afanele ukuveza ubukhulu nobubele baloluthando, wabiza umhlaba ukuba ulubheke….Ibalulekile kangakanani lendawo kumuntu. Ngenxa yesiphambeko samadodana omuntu aphenduka izikhonzi zikaSathane. Ngokukholwa emhlatshelweni wenhlawulelo kaKristu amadodana ka-Adamu angaba amadodana kaNkulunkulu. Ngokulinganisa isimo semvelo, uKristu uphakamisa umuntu. Abantu abawileyo babekwa lapho, ngokuxhumana noKristu, bangaba abafanelekile ngempela igama ‘lamadodana kaNkulunkulu.”-Steps to Christ, p. 15.

q.text: b. Mazwi mani asetshenziswa ngumpostoli uJohane ukugcizelela ubukhulu bothando lukaNkulunkulu-na?

note.text: “Uthando olungaka olungenamlinganiso. Abantwana beNkosi yasezulwini! Isithembiso esiyigugu! Isihloko somcabango omkhulu kakhulu! Uthando olungelinganiswe lukaNkulunkulu ngomhlaba ongazange wamthanda! Umcabango unanamandla athobisa umphefumulo ulethe umqondo ebugqilini bentando kaNkulunkulu. Njengoba sifunda njalo ngesimilo esingcwele ngokukhanya kwesiphambano, yilapho sibona kakhulu umusa, ubumnene, nokuxolela okuhlangene nokulingana nokulunga, yilapho sihlukanisa kakhulu ubufakazi obungenakubalwa bothando olungapheli nesihawu esidlula uzwelo lukamama ngengane yakhe engalawuleki.”-Fundamentals of Christian Education, Ibid., p. 15.

reviewQuestions: 1. Yisho izimpawu ezibalulekile kakhulu zesimilo sikaNkulunkulu.
2. UJesu wembula kanjani isimilo sikaNkulunkulu ngesikhathi elapha emhlabeni-na?
3. Kungayiphi indlela umsebenzi kaKristu ungumfutho wokukhetha Kwakhe-na?
4. Ngokuba uMbambeli wethu, yiziphi izifundo uJesu asifundisa zona-na?
5. Chaza isipho sikaKristu sokugcina ngenxa yethu.

paragraph.text: “I-Chennai, ngaphambili beyaziwa nge-Madras, inhloko-dolobha yomuzi omkhulu waseTamil Nadu, ongaseningizimu yesifunda sase-India. Wakhiwe ngasoGwini lwase Coromandel oSebeni lwaseBengal. Ngokuya ngesibalo sonyaka ka-2011 eIndia, iChennai iyidolobha lesithupha ngobukhulu nelidumile eIndia futhi lakha isifunda sesine ngobubanzi. Lahlanganiswa ngonyaka ka 1688, iGreater Chennai Corpporation umbuso ohlangene wase-India nelesibili ngobudala emhlabeni ilandela iLondon. Iphakathi lokuhwebelana namabhizimisi namafemu ezimpahla ezingu 15 000 kanye neliphakathi lezivakashi zezempilo, nezivunyelwe “India’s health capital.” Umuzi unezindlu nesigaba esikhulu semboni yezimoto, noma elinye igama, “Detroit of India.” I-Chennai yidolobha kuphela eSouth Asia elalinganiswa phakathi kwe-National Geographic “Top 10 Food Cities” ngonyaka ka-2015 futhi ingeyesishiyagalolunye uma ilinganiswa ne-Lonely Planet’s amadolobha azimele emhlabeni wonke.

“Abantu abakhile e-Chennai manje badlula izigidi ezingu 12, okwamanje lenani likhula ngezinga elincane nge 2.34% ngonyaka. Ledolobha liyikhaya lamazwe ahlukahlukene namazwe ezenkolo ehlukahlukene. Uma kubalwa ngonyaka ka-2011, iningi labantu eChennai bekungamaHindu (80.73%) kulandele i9.45% amaMuslim, 7.72% amaKrestu, 1,27% abanye futhi 0.83% bayazisho ukuthi abakholwa noma bakhetha ukungakholwa.

“Ngonyaka ka-2019, i-40% yabantu abayizigidi ezingu 1.788 zemikhaya ehlala ngaphansi koluhlu lobumpofu. Ngonyaka ka-2017, idolobha linemikhaya eyizigidi ezingu-2.2, nge-40% yabakhe kulo lemizi akuyona eyabo. Abantu abangu 1,131 abampofu balomuzi, imizi edlula izindlu ezingu 300, 000. Zonke izinhlobo zabantu abahlala lapho, bonke bafuna ukuzwa ivangeli eliphakade likaJesu Kristu kulezinsuku zokugcina.

“Ngenxa yesimo esiyinselelo, asikwazi ukuphelelisa isakhiwo sebandla eChinnai ngesikhathi esimisiweyo. Manje ngenxa yomsebenzi oqhubekayo, futhi sibonile ukuthi isidingo somsebenzi wokwelula nokwengeza isakhiwo sendlunkulu yabafundisi, iholo lokuhlangana, kanye negumbi labantwana lesikolo seSabatha. Ukuphelelisa lokhu, ngempela sidinga ukucela kulabo abazonikela ngesihle ngamabandla athandekayo emhlabeni wonke.
“Siyacela ngesizotha kubuzalwane, nodade, nabasha bethu ukuba ninikele kakhulu ngezipho zenhliziyo maqondana nalomsebenzi.
“Sibonga ngaphambili, kwangathi iNkosi inganibusisa nonke ngokunothile!

lessons.title: Isoni Sidinga UKristu
lessons.keyTextVerse: “IVESI LEKHANDA: “UJesu waphendula wathi kuye, Ngiqinisile, ngiqinisile ngithi kuwe, Uma umuntu engazalwa ngokusha, angewubone umbuso kaNkulunkulu”

keyText.text: “IVESI LEKHANDA: “UJesu waphendula wathi kuye, Ngiqinisile, ngiqinisile ngithi kuwe, Uma umuntu engazalwa ngokusha, angewubone umbuso kaNkulunkulu”

keyNote.text: “Ithemba lokuhlengwa kwesizwe sethu esiwileyo likuKristu kuphela.”-The Desire of Ages, p. 147.

q.text: a. Chaza isimo somuntu sokuqala ensimini yase-Edeni. Genesis 1:26, 27, 31;

note.text: “Ekuqaleni umuntu wanikwa amandla ahloniphekile kanye nengqondo elinganiswe kahle. Ubeyisidalwa esiphelele, futhi evumelana noNkulunkulu.”-Steps to Christ, p. 17.

“Umuntu kwakufanele athwale umfanekiso kaNkulunkulu, ngokufana kwangaphandle nangesimilo. UKristu kuphela ongacindezela umfanekiso’ (Heberu 1:3) kaBaba, kodwa umuntu wenziwa ngomfanekiso kaNkulunkulu. Imvelo yakhe yayivumelana nentando kaNkulunkulu. Ingqondo yakhe yayinamandla okuzindla izinto ezingcwele. Ukuthanda kwakhe kwakuhlanzekile; unambitho nothando lwalungaphansi kolawulo lomcabango. Wayengcwele futhi ethokozela ukuthwala umfanekiso kaNkulunkulu futhi ukulalela okuphelele entandweni Yakhe.”-Patriachs and Prophets, p. 45.

q.text: b. USathane wasebenza kanjani ukubhuntshisa icebo likaNkulunkulu ekudalweni komuntu-na? Genesis 3:1-7;

note.text: “Ngenxa yokungalaleli, amandla [omuntu] onakaliswa, ubugovu bathatha indawo yothando. Imvelo yakhe yaba buthakathaka kakhulu ngenxa yokweqa umthetho lowo wawunzima kuye, ngamandla akhe, ukuba angamelana namandla obubi. Wenziwa isigqila nguSathane, futhi ngabe wahlala enjalo ingunaphakade uma uNkulunkulu engazange wangenelela ngempela. Bekuyinhloso yomlingi ukuvimbela icebo elingcwele ekudalweni komuntu, elokugcwalisa umhlaba ngosizi nencithakalo. Futhi akhombe bonke lobubi njengomphumela womsebenzi kukaNkulunkulu ekudaleni umuntu.”-Steps to Christ, p. 17.

q.text: a. Emva kwesono sabo, ngeyiphi indlela uAdam noEva abaphendula ngayo lapho bezwa izwi likaNkulunkulu-na? Genesis 3:8-10.
b. Kungani izidalwa zabantu ezonayo zingakwazi ukuma phambi kwaLowo Ongenasiphelo-na?

note.text: “Kwisimo sokona kwakhe, umuntu wagcina intokozo yokuxhumana Naye ‘kuyena okufihlwe amagugu onke okuhlakanipha nowokwazi.’ Kolose 2:3. Kodwa emva kokona kwakhe, angeke asathola injabulo nobungcwele, wazama ukuzifihla ebukhoneni bukaNkulunkulu. Sinjalo isimo senhliziyo engenziwanga busha. Ayivumelani noNkulunkulu, futhi ayitholi injabulo yokuxhumana Naye. Isoni angeke sajabulela ubukhona bukaNkulunkulu; sizoncipha ebudlelwaneni nezidalwa ezingcwele. Uma isoni sivunyelwa ukungena ezulwini, angeke kwaba injabulo kuso. Umoya wothando lobugovu olubusa lapha-yonke inhliziyo esabela enhliziyweni yoThando Olungapheli-angeke ithinte intambo yokuphendula umphefumulo wakhe. Imicabango yakhe, izintakazelelo zakhe, izinhloso zakhe, zingamenza umfokazi kulabo abaqhuba abahlali abangenasono lapho. Wayezoba inothi elihlukanisayo kwingoma yasezulwini. Izulu belizoba kubo indawo yesijeziso. Isikhathi eside efihlakele Kuye ongukukhanya kwakhe, ongumsuka wenjabulo yakhe. Akulona ithuba lomthetho ohlangothini lukaNkulunkulu ukuvimbela ababi ukuba bangena ezulwini; kodwa bavalelwa ngaphandle ngenxa yokungafaneli ubuhlobo balo. Inkazimulo kaNkulunkulu kubo izoba ngumlilo oqothulayo.”-Steps to Christ, pp. 17, 18.

q.text: c. Kungani kungenakwenzeka ukuba umuntu ngokwakhe aphunyuke esijezisweni sesono-na?

note.text: “Angeke kwenzeka kithi, ngokwethu, ukuba siphephe umgodi wesono esicwile kuwo. Izinhliziyo zethu zimbi, futhi asingeke sayiguqula. ‘Ngubani ongaveza okuhlambulukileyo kukho okungcolileyo-na? kakho noyedwa.’ Jobe 14:4….Imfundo, impucuko, ukusebenzisa intando, umzamo womuntu, konke kunesikhathi sakho, kodwa azinawo amandla lapha. Bangabonakalisa ngaphandle ukulunga kwesimilo, kodwa angeke baguqula inhliziyo; angeke bahlanza imithombo yokuphila. Kufanele kubekhona amandla asebenza ukusuka ngaphakathi, ukuphila okusha okuvela phezulu, ngaphambi kokuba abantu baguqulwe basuke esonweni ukuya ebungcweleni. Lawomandla nguKristu. Umusa Wakhe kuphela ongasheshisa amandla okuphila komphefumulo, awuthathekisele kuNkulunkulu, ukuya ebungcweleni.”-Ibid., p. 18.

q.text: a. Kuyini okufanele sikuqaphele ngenhliziyo yomuntu-na?

note.text: “IZwi likaNkulunkulu lithi, ‘Ngokuba bonke bonile’ (Roma 3:23). ‘Akakho owenza okuhle, akakho noyedwa’ (Roma 3:12). Abaningi bayakhohliswa maqondana nesimo senhliziyo yabo. Abaqondi imvelo yenhliziyo ukuthi iyakhohlisa ngaphezu kwakho konke, futhi yimbi. Bazisonga ngokulunga okungokwabo, futhi baneliseka ekufinyeleleni kwizinga lesimilo somuntu; kodwa behluleka kangakanani uma bengafinyeleli kwizinga elingcwele, ngokwabo abasoze bahlangabezana nezimfuno zikaNkulunkulu.”-Selected Messages, bk. 1, p. 320.

q.text: b. Kungani thina njengabantu singakwazi ukuhlukanisa amandla esimoya futhi sibone umbuso kaNkulunkulu-na?

note.text: “UMsindisi uthi, ‘Uma umuntu engazalwa ngokusha,’ ngaphandle kokuthola inhliziyo entsha, izifiso ezintsha, izinhloso ezintsha, okuqondiwe, okuholela ekuphileni okusha, ‘angewubone umbuso kaNkulunkulu.’ Johane 3:3, isiphetho. Umcabango ofunekayo kuphela owokukhulisa okuhle okukhona kumuntu ngokwemvelo, inkohliso ebulalayo. ‘Umuntu wemvelo akakwamukeli okukaMoya kaNkulunkulu: ngokuba kungubuwula kuye: angekuqonde, ngokuba kubonisiswa ngokomoya.’ Ningamangali uma ngithi kini, nimelwe ukuzalwa kabusha.’ 1 Korinte 2:14; 3:7. NgoKristu kulotshiwe ukuthi, ‘Ukuphila kwakuKuye, ukuphila kwakungukukhanya kwabantu’-Alikho elinye igama, ngaphansi kwezulu elinikiwe ebantwini, esimelwe ukusindiswa ngalo.”-Steps to Christ., pp. 18, 19.

q.text: c. Noma singeke sazisindisa ngokwethu, kuyini esingakwenza-na?

note.text: “Ngokuba uNkulunkulu kwakufanele abonakaliswe kuKristu, ngokwenza ukuba izwe libuyisane Naye.’ 2 Korinte 5:19. Umuntu wonakele kakhulu ngenxa yesono kwaze kwabanzima kuye, ngokwakhe, ukuba avumelane Naye omvelo Yakhe ingukuhlanzeka nokulunga. Kodwa uKristu, emva kokuhlenga umuntu ekulahlweni ngumthetho, anganikezwa amandla angcwele ukuhlanganisa umzamo womuntu. Kanjalo ngokuphendukela kuNkulunkulu nokukholwa kuKristu abantwana bakaAbrahama abawileyo bangaba ‘ngamadodana kaNkulunkulu.’ 1 Johane 3:2.”-Patriachs and Prophets, p. 64.

q.text: a. Yayiyini inkinga yompostoli uPawule lapho efinyelela olwazini oluphelele lwesimo sakhe njengesoni phambi kukaNkulunkulu-na?

note.text: “Akwanele ukuhlukanisa uthando olumnene lukaNkulunkulu, ukubona umusa, isisa sikababa, isimilo Sakhe. Akwanele ukuhlukanisa ukuhlakanipha nokulunga komthetho Wakhe, ukubona ukuthi usekelwe kwisimiso sothando oluphakade. Umpostoli uPawule wabona konke lapho ememezela, ‘Ngiyawuvumela umthetho ukuthi muhle.’ ‘Ngakho-ke umthetho ungcwele, nomyalo ungcwele, ulungile, muhle.’ Kodwa wengeza ngokuthi, ngobuhlungu bomphefumulo nosizi nokudangala, ‘Kepha mina ngingowenyama, othengisiwe phansi kwesono.’ Roma 7:16, 12, 14. Wayelangazela ukuhlanzeka, ukulunga, kuyena wayengenamandla okukuzuza, futhi wakhala, ‘Wo mina-muntu wosizi, ngubani oyakungikhulula kulomzimba wokufa-na?’ Roma 7:24, isiphetho. Sinjalo isikhalo esinyukela phezulu sivela ezinhliziyweni ezisindwayo emazweni wonke nasezikhathini zonke. Kubo bonke, kukhona impendulo eyodwa, ‘Bheka iWundlu likaNkulunkulu, elisusa izono zezwe.’ Johane 1:29.”-Steps of Christ, p. 19.

“Kukhona abaningi abaqonda ukungabi namandla okuzisiza, nalabo abalangazelela ukuphila kwesimoya okuzobaletha ekuvumalaneni noNkulunkulu; abazama ngeze ukukuthola….UMsindisi uzithoba phezu kwenani legazi Lakhe, ethi ngobumnene obungenakushiwo ngozwelo, ‘Ungangihlambulula-na?”-The Desire of Ages, p. 203.

q.text: b. UNkulunkulu waqinisekisa kanjani uJakobe ukuthi akamshiyanga lapho ebalekela umfowabo uEsawu-na? Genesis 28:10-13.

note.text: “[UJakobe] wazizwa ukuthi ulahliwe, ubazi ukuthi konke lokuhlupheka okumehlelayo kungenxa yesenzo sakhe esiphambukile. Ubumnyama bokuphelelwa yithemba kwacindezela umpefumulo, futhi akazange ngaphambili azame ukuthandaza. Kodwa wayenesizungu wazizwa enesidingo sokuvikelwa nguNkulunkulu angazange abanakho ngaphambili. Ngokukhala nangokuzithoba okujulile wavuma isono sakhe, encenga ubufakazi bokuthi wayengadelwanga. Kodwa inhliziyo yakhe esindwayo ayizange ithole inkululeko. Walahlekelwa yilo lonke ithemba ngakuye, wesaba ukuthi uNkulunkulu kababa wakhe uthe wamudela.

“Kodwa uNkulunkulu akazange amdela uJakobe. Umusa Wakhe welulelwe kulowo owonayo, inceku engathembekile. UJehova ngesihawu wembula lokhu uJakobe akudingayo-uMsindisi. Wonile, kodwa inhliziyo yakhe yagcwala ukubonga lapho ebona kwembulwa indlela leyo angabuyiselwa ngayo emuseni kaNkulunkulu.”-Pariachs and Prophets, p. 183.

q.text: a. Yisiphi isifundo esingasifunda ngesitebhisi esabonwa uJakobe ehlane-na? Genesis 28:16, 17;

note.text: “Kulombono icebo lensindiso lalethwa kuJakobe, hayi ngokuphelele, kodwa ngezinxenye ezazidingeka kuye ngaleso sikhathi. Isikhwelo esiyindida sembulelwa yena ngephupho ngokufanayo naleso uKristu asiqondisa enkulumeni Yakhe noNathaniyeli. [Johane 1:51 ngokuphindwa]. Kufinyelela ekuhlubukeni komuntu emelene nombuso kaNkulunkulu, bekukhona ukukhulumisana phakathi kukaNkulunkulu nomuntu. Kodwa isono sikaAdamu noEva sahlukanisa umhlaba nezulu, ukuze umuntu angabi nobuhlobo noMdali wakhe. Nokho umhlaba awushiywanga ungenathemba. Isikhwelo sifanekisa uJesu, indlela yokuxhumanisa emisiwe.”-Patriachs and Prophets, p. 184.

q.text: b. Chaza ukuxhumana okwamiswa ukulamula kukaKristu.

note.text: “Ngohlubuko, umuntu wazehlukanisa ngokwakhe kuNkulunkulu; umhlaba wahlukaniswa nezulu. Ngale kwegebe elalikhona ngaphakathi, angeke kwabakhona ukuxhumana. Kodwa ngoKristu, umhlaba futhi uhlanganiswa nezulu. Ngokufaneleka Kwakhe, uKristu uvalile igebe isono elilenzile, ukuze izingelosi ezisebenzayo zingagcina ubuhlobo nomuntu. UKristu uhlanganisa umuntu owileyo ebuthakathakeni bakhe nokungabi nokuzisiza ngamandla oMthombo ongapheliyo.”-Steps to Christ, p. 20.

“Inhliziyo kaNkulunkulu ilangazelela phezu kwabantwana Bakhe abasemhlabeni ngothando olunamandla kunokufa. Ngokunikela ngeNdodana Yakhe, uThululele kithi lonke izulu ngesipho esisodwa. Ukuphila koMsindisi ukufa Kwakhe nokulamula, umsebenzi wezingelosi, ukuncenga koMoya ongcwele, uBaba osebenza ngaphezulu nakubo bonke, intakazelelo engapheli yezidalwa zezulu-konke kubhaliwe ngenxa yokuhlengwa komuntu.”-Ibid., p. 21.

reviewQuestions: 1. Qhathanisa isimo somuntu ngaphambi kokuwa nangasemva kwakho.
2. Emva kokuwa, kuyini okwenziwa umuntu futhi kungani-na?
3. Ngeyiphi impendulo kuphela yenkinga yesono-na?
4. Chaza isizathu sophawu olumangalisayo olwanikezwa uJakobe ephusheni lakhe.
5. Iyiphi indlela yokuxhumana uNkulunkulu ayigcinela abantu-na?

lessons.title: Ukuphenduka
lessons.keyTextVerse: IVESI LEKHANDA: “Ngalokhu phendukani, niguquke ukuba kuhlangulwe izono zenu”

keyText.text: IVESI LEKHANDA: “Ngalokhu phendukani, niguquke ukuba kuhlangulwe izono zenu”

keyNote.text: “UNkulunkulu angeke alahla labo abakhashelwe esonweni, kodwa labo abathe babuya Kuye ngokuphenduka kweqiniso.”-Patriachs and Prophets, pp. 202, 203.

q.text: a. Yibuphi ubufakazi bokuphenduka kweqiniso okwafunwa nguJohane uMbhapathizi-na?

note.text: “Ukuphenduka kungenisa ngaphakathi usizi lwesono nokusuka kuso. Angeke sadela isono ngaphandle kokubona ububi baso; size sifinyelele lapho sisixosha enhliziyweni, angeke kwabakhona inguquko ekuphileni.”- Steps to Christ, p. 23.

q.text: b. Kuyini okufanele sikwazi ngokuphenduka kweqiniso okuguqula inhliziyo nokuphila-na?

note.text: “Ukudabukela isono kwangempela kungumphumela wokusebenza koMoya Ongcwele. UMoya wembula ukungabongi kwenhliziyo ethe yadelela futhi yadabukisa uMsindisi, futhi usiletha ekuzisoleni ezinyaweni zesiphambano. Ngesono ngasinye uJesu ulinyazwa kabusha; futhi njengoba sibheka Kuye Lowo esithe samhlaba, sidabukela izono ezilethe usizi phezu Kwakhe. Ukukhala okunjalo kuzosiholela ekulahleni isono.”-The Desire of Ages, p. 300.

“Lapho inhliziyo izinikela kumfutho woMoya Ongcwele, unembeza uzosheshiswa, isoni sizohlukanisa okuthize okujulile nobungcwele bomthetho kaNkulunkulu, isisekelo sombuso Wakhe ezulwini nasemhlabeni.”-Steps to Christ, p. 24.

q.text: a. Kuncenga kuni uDavide akwenza lapho ebona ukusinda kwesono sakhe-na?

note.text: “Umkhuleko kaDavide emva kokuwa kwakhe, ufanekisa imvelo yokudabukela ngempela isono. Ukuphenduka kwakhe kwakuqinisekile futhi kujulile. Bewungekho umzamo wokufihla isiphambeko sakhe; singekho nesifiso sokubalekela isijeziso esisongelayo, yikho okwakhuthaza umkhuleko wakhe. UDavide wabona ubukhulu bokweqa kwakhe umthetho; wabona ukungcola komphefumulo wakhe; wasenyanya isono sakhe. Akakhulekelanga intethelelo kuphela, kodwa ukuhlanzeka kwenhliziyo. Walanganzelela intokozo yobungcwele-ukuba abuyiselwe ekuvumelaneni nasekuxhumaneni noNkulunkulu.”- Steps to Christ, p. 24.

q.text: b. Ukuphenduka kweqiniso kukaDavide kwamholela ukuba afuneni-na?

note.text: “Dala kimi inhliziyo ehlanzekileyo.’ Lesi isiqalo esilungile, sesisekelo ngempela sesimilo soMkrestu; ngoba enhliziyweni kukhona izinto zokuphila. Uma bonke, abafundisi nabantu, bangabona ukuthi izinhliziyo zabo zilungile kuNkulunkulu, singabona umphumela omkhulu womsebenzi obekwe ngaphambili. Okubaluleke kakhulu nomsebenzi wenu wokuziphendulela, isidingo esikhulu ukuthi sibe nezinhliziyo ezihlanzekile. Umusa esiwudingayo siwuphiwe, namandla oMoya Ongcwele okusebenza wonke umzamo owenziwayo kulendlela. Kuwo wonke umntwana kaNkulunkulu ozomfuna ngempela nangokubekezela, kuzobakhona ukukhula emuseni. Ukungezwani kuzophela; abakholwayo bazoba nhliziyo-nye nomqondo munye; ukuhlanzeka nothando kuzovama emabandleni. Ngokubheka, siyaguqulwa. Uma sizindla kakhulu ngesimilo sikaKristu, sizoguqulelwa ngempela emfanekisweni Wakhe. Woza kuJesu njengoba unjalo, uZokwamukela, faka emlonyeni wakho ingoma entsha, futhi udumise uNkulunkulu.”-Gospel Workers, (1892/1893 edition) pp. 451, 452.

q.text: c. Kuyini iBhayibheli elikufundisayo ngokuphenduka nokuzinikela ngokuphelele kuKristu-na?

note.text: “Angeke sisakwazi ukuphenduka ngaphandle koMoya kaKristu ukuze sivuse unembeza kunokuba sixolelwe ngaphandle kukaKristu.

“UKristu ungumthombo womuzwa wonke olungilele. Nguye kuphela ongatshala enhliziyweni ubutha bumelane nesono. Zonke izifiso zeqiniso nobumsulwa, nokuvuma konke ukona kwethu, kuwubufakaz bokuthi uMoya Wakhe uhamba ezinhliziyweni zethu.”-Steps to Christ, p. 26.

q.text: a. Yabanjani imvelo yokuphenduka kukaEsawu, kaFaro noJudasi lapho bebona imiphumela yesono sabo-na?

note.text: “Abaningi bezwa ubuhlungu bokuthi bonile baze benze inguquko yangaphandle ngoba besaba ukuthi isiphambeko sabo sizoletha isijeziso phezu kwabo. Kodwa lokhu akukona ukuphenduka ngomqondo weBhayibheli. Bakhala ngenxa yokuhlupheka kunokukhalela isono. Lwalunjalo usizi lukaEsawu lapho ebona ukuthi ubuzibulo bumlahlekele ingunaphakade….UJudasi Iskariyothi, emva kokukhaphela iNkosi yakhe, wathi, ‘Ngonile ukuba ngikhaphele igazi elingenacala.’ Mathewu 27:4.

“Ukuvuma kwacindezelwa emphefumulweni wokona kwakhe ngomqondo owesabisayo wokulahlwa nokubheka ngovalo isijeziso. Imiphumela eyayizoza phezu kwakhe yamulethela ukwesaba, kodwa kwakungajulile emphefumulweni wakhe, ukuthi ukhaphele iNdodana kaNkulunkulu engenacala futhi wenqaba Lowo Ongcwele kaIsrayeli. UFaro lapho ehlupheka ngaphansi kwesijeziso sikaNkulunkulu, wavuma isono sakhe ukuze aphephe kwisijeziso, kodwa wabuyela ekweyiseni iZulu lapho izibetho zimiswa. Bonke laba babekhalela umphumela wesono, kodwa kabazange bezwa ubuhlungu besono ngokwaso.”-Steps to Christ, pp. 23, 24.

“UNkulunkulu wanika uFaro ubufakazi obukhanyayo bamandla angcwele, kodwa inkosi ngenkani yenqaba ukunaka ukukhanya. Wonke umbukiso wamandla angapheliyo enqatshwa nguye, kwamenza wazimisela kakhulu ekuhlubukeni kwakhe. Imbewu yohlubuko leyo ayitshala lapho enqaba isimangaliso sokuqala, sathela isivuno saso.”-Patriachs and Prophets, p. 268.

q.text: b. Kuyini okwenzakalayo lapho isoni singaphenduki futhi silibazisa ukuphenduka kwaso kuze kube isikhathi esizayo-na?

note.text: “Labo abazishoyo ukuthi bangamaKristu abeza empini esabekayo yokugcina ngothando olungalungisiwe, ekuphelelweni kwabo yithemba, bavume izono zabo ngamazwi osizi oluvuthayo, lapho ababi benamela ukuhlupheka kwabo. Lokuvuma kwesimo esinjalo njengo-Esawu noma uJudasi. Labo abakwenzayo lokhu, bekhalela umphumela wokweqa umthetho, kodwa kungesibo ububi baso. Abanawo umuzwa wokuzisola ngempela, abakuzondi okubi. Bavuma isono sabo, ngoba besaba isijeziso; kodwa, njengo-Faro wasendulo, bazobuyela ekweyiseni kwabo iZulu uma isijeziso sabo singasuswa.”-The Great Controversy, pp. 620, 621, [Author’s italics.]

q.text: a. Uyini umehluko phakathi koMfarisi nomthelisi embalini kaKristu-na?

note.text: “Kumfanekiso woMfarisi nomthelisi, umkhuleko wokuzilungisisa, ‘Nkulunkulu ngiyakubonga ngokuba ngingenjengabanye abantu,’ wagqama kakhulu ungafani nesicelo somuntu ophendukile, ‘Ngihawukele mina soni.’ Luka 18:11, 13, R.V., isiphetho. Kanjalo uKristu wakhuza ukuzenzisa kwamaJuda.”-The Desire of Ages, p. 495.

q.text: b. Kuyini uJesu akusho ngomphumela womkhuleko womthelisi-na?

note.text: “Umthelisi ompofu owakhuleka, ‘Nkulunkulu, ngihawukele mina soni’ (Luka 18:13), wazibheka njengomuntu omubi kakhulu, nabanye bambheka ngokukhanya okufanayo; kodwa wezwa isidingo sakhe, nomthwalo wesono sakhe enamahloni okuza phambi kukaNkulunkulu, ecela umusa Wakhe. Inhliziyo yakhe yavulelwa uMoya kaNkulunkulu ukwenza umsebenzi wawo umkhulule emandleni esono. Ukuzigabisa koMfarisi, umkhuleko wokulunga kwakhe wabonakalisa ukuthi inhliziyo yavalwa imelene nomfutho woMoya Ongcwele. Ngenxa yokubakude noNkulunkulu, wayengacabangi ngokungcola kwakhe, ngokwehlukile nokuphelela kokulunga okungcwele. Wayengenawo umuzwa wesidingo, futhi akazuzanga lutho.”-Steps to Christ, pp. 30, 31.

q.text: c. Ekuxoxeni lendaba, yisiphi isimo sengqondo esilimazayo uJesu ayefuna ukusilungisa-na?

note.text: “Inkolo yabaFarisi ayithinti umphefumulo. Ayifuni isimilo esifana nesikaNkulunkulu, inhliziyo egcwele uthando nomusa. Yenelisekile ngenkolo enokwenza kuphela ngokuphila kwangaphandle. Ukulunga okungokwakhe-isithelo semisebenzi yakhe-futhi ahlulelwe ngesilinganiso somuntu.

“Noma ngubani ozethemba ngokuthi ulungile, uzodelela abanye. njengoMfarisi owazehlulela ngokwakhe nabanye abantu, kanjalo wehlulela abanye abantu ngaye. Ukulunga kwakhe kulinganiswa nokwabo, futhi njengoba emubi kakhulu ukuthi ukulunga kwakhe kukhulu ngokwahlukile ngokubonakala kwakhe. Ukulunga okungokwakhe kuholela ekusoleni. ‘Abanye abantu’ ubasola njengabephula umthetho kaNkulunkulu. Kanjalo ubonakalisa umoya ngempela kaSathane, ummangaleli wabazalwane. Ngalomoya angeke kwenzeka kuye ukuba axhumane noNkulunkulu.”-Christ’s Object Lessons, p. 151.

q.text: a. Iyiphi ingozi yokunganaki ukuvuma noma ukulibazisa ukuphendula-na?

note.text: “Abaningi bathulisa unembeza okhathazekile ngomcabango wokuthi bangaguqula indlela yobubi uma beyikhetha; nokuthi bangadlala ngesimemo somusa, kodwa baqhubeke ukuwucindezela njalo. Bacabanga ukuthi uma benza ngaphandle koMoya womusa, emva kokwakha umfutho wabo ohlangothini lukaSathane, ngesikhathi sobunzima obesabekayo bangakwazi ukuguqula indlela yabo. Kodwa lokhu akwenzeki kalula. Amava, imfundo, yempilo yonke, ithe yabumba kahle isimilo kangango-kuba bambalwa abafisa ukwamukela umfanekiso kaJesu.”-Steps to Christ, pp. 33, 34.

q.text: b. Kuyini okufanele sikwenze lapho sibona ukuthi inhliziyo nokuphila kwethu akuvumelani noNkulunkulu-na?

note.text: “Hlola izwi likaNkulunkulu ngomkhuleko. Lelozwi elilethwa phambi kwakho, ngomthetho kaNkulunkulu nokuphila kukaKristu, izimiso ezinkulu zobungcwele, ongenakho ‘angeyibone iNkosi.’ Heberu 12:14. Livumisa isono; lembula ngokusobala indlela yensindiso. Liqaphele njengephimbo likaNkulunkulu elikhuluma nomphefumulo wakho.”-Ibid., p. 35.

“Besiyizoni ezinkulu kakhulu, kodwa uKristu wafa ukuze sithethelelwe. Ukufaneleka komhlatshelo Wakhe kwanele ukuwuletha kuBaba ngenxa yethu. Labo athe wabathethelela kakhulu bazomthanda kakhulu, futhi bazokuma eduze kwesihlalo bamdumise ngenxa yothando lukaNkulunkulu esiqonda kakhulu ububi besono. Uma sibona iketanga elide elehliselwa thina, uma sizwisisa okuthize ngomhlatshelo ongapheli uKristu awenza ngenxa yethu, inhliziyo izothanjiswa ngesisa kanye nokuzisola.”-Ibid., p. 36.

reviewQuestions: 1. Yisiphi isipho esimangalisayo uNkulunkulu asinika sona ukuze samukele umusa wezulu-na?
2. Kungani singakwazi ukuphenduka ngempela ngokwethu-na?
3. Kuyini obekusilela ekuphendukeni kukaEsawu, uFaro noJudasi-na?
4. Kungani uJesu akhuluma ngomfanekiso woMfarisi nomthelisi-na?
5. Yiliphi inyathelo elibalulekile kakhulu lokuletha umuntu ebudlelwaneni obuseduze noNkulunkulu-na?

lessons.title: Ukuvuma Izono
lessons.keyTextVerse: IVESI LEKHANDA: “Ofihla iziphambeko zakhe akayikuphumelela, kodwa ozivumayo azishiye uyakuthola umusa”

keyText.text: IVESI LEKHANDA: “Ofihla iziphambeko zakhe akayikuphumelela, kodwa ozivumayo azishiye uyakuthola umusa”

keyNote.text: “Ukuvuma okungukuthululwa komphefumulo ongaphakathi kufumana indlela eya kuNkulunkulu onesihawu esingapheli.”-Steps to Christ, p. 38.

q.text: a. Lapho silahlwa ngesono, kuyini okufanele sikwenze-na?

note.text: “Imibandela yokuthola umusa kaNkulunkulu ilula, ilungile futhi inomqondo. UJehova akadingi ukuthi senze okuthize okunzima ukuze sithole ukuthethelelwa kwesono. Asidingi ukuthatha uhambo olude olukhathazayo, noma sidabukele isono kabuhlungu, ukunikela imiphefumulo yethu kuNkulunkulu oseZulwini noma sihlanze isiphambeko sethu; kodwa lowo osivumayo asilahle isono sakhe uzothola umusa.”-Steps to Christ, p. 37.

q.text: b. Ngenxa yalesimo kuyini okudingeka kithi-na?

note.text: “Labo abangazange bathobise imiphefumulo yabo phambi kukaNkulunkulu ngokuvuma isono sabo, abaphelelisanga umbandelo wokuqala wokwamukela. Uma singenawo amava okuphenduka okungafanele siphenduke kukho, futhi singazange sithobe ngempela umphefumulo ngokudabuka komoya esivuma ngawo izono zethu, ngokwenyanya ububi bethu, asizange ngempela sifune ukuthethelelwa kwesono; futhi uma singazange sizame, asizange sizuze ukuthula kukaNkulunkulu. Isizathu sinye kuphela sokuthi kungani kungekho ukuthethelelwa kwezono ezidlule kusho ukuthi asifuni ukuthoba izinhliziyo zethu futhi sivume imibandela yezwi leqiniso isiluleko esisobala esinikiwe maqondana nalendaba. Ukuvuma isono, phakathi kwabantu noma ngasese, kufanele kuvezwe ngokusuka enhliziyweni futhi ivezwe ngokukhululekile.”-Ibid., pp. 37, 38.

q.text: a. Uma sithe sazwisa omunye ubuhlungu, yimuphi omunye esimkhubekisayo-na?

note.text: “Umpostoli uthi, ‘Vumani izono omunye komunye, nikhulekelane ukuba niphulukiswe.’ Jakobe 5:16. Vuma izono zakho kuNkulunkulu, nguye kuphela ongazithethelela, nezono zakho kwabanye. Uma unecala nomngane wakho noma umakhelwane, kufanele uqonde iphutha lakho, futhi ngumsebenzi wakhe ukukuthethelela ngokuzithandela. Besewena ufuna intethelelo kuNkulunkulu, futhi ngokumzwisa ubuhlungu wenze isono kuMdali wakhe noMhlengi.”- Steps to Christ, p. 37.

“Lowo ongathetheleli unqamula owona-mzila kuphela angathola ngawo umusa ovela kuNkulunkulu. Masingacabangi ukuthi ngaphandle kwalabo abezwe ubuhlungu bavume isiphambeko silungisiswa ngokubamba intethelelo yethu. Kuyinxenye yabo, akungabazeki, yokuthoba izinhliziyo zabo ngokuphenduka nokuvuma; kodwa kufanele sibe nomoya wozwelo kulabo abasonayo, kungakhathalekile ukuthi bayavuma amacala abo. Noma basizwise ubuhlungu obungakanani, akufanele sithokozele izikhalo zethu futhi sizwele nathi ngokulimala kwethu; njengoba Sinethemba lokuthethelelwa iziphambeko zethu maqondana noNkulunkulu kufanele sithethelele bonke abasonayo thina.”-Thoughts from the Mount of Blessings, pp. 113, 114.

q.text: c. Kuyini okufanele kusifundise umsebenzi wethu maqondana nomuntu-na? 1 Peter 4:8;

note.text: “Vumela uKristu, ukuPhila okungcwele, kuhlale kuwe nangawe embule uthando lwenzalo yasezulwini olunikeza ithemba kongenathemba lilethe ukuthula kwasezulwini enhliziyweni ekhungathwe yisono, ukuthi, yamukele umusa ovela Kuye, umas sizinikela Kuye ukuze sembule umusa Wakhe kwabanye.”-Ibid., pp. 114, 115.

“Ukungabi-nobuntu kumuntu maqondana nomunye umuntu isono sethu esikhulu. Abaningi bacabanga ukuthi bamela ukulunga kukaNkulunkulu kuyilapho behluleka ngokuphelele ukumela ubumnene nothando Lwakhe olukhulu. Kaningi labo abahlangana nabo ngobulukhuni nangamandla bangaphansi kobunzima besilingo. USathane ubambene nalemiphefumulo, kanzima, ngamazwi angenamusa adangalisayo abenze bawe njengenyamazane kumandla omlingi.”-The Ministry of Healing, p. 163.

q.text: a. Yiziphi izono okumele zivunywe obala kuyilapho ezinye zivunywa kuNkulunkulu kuphela-na?

note.text: “Ukuvuma kwangempela kaningi kuyisimilo esithile, nokuvuma izono ezithize. Zingaba imvelo osondela ngayo kuNkulunkulu kuphela; kungaba khona iziphambeko okufanele zivunywe kumuntu ngamunye ozwe ubuhlungu ngenxa yabo; noma abanezimilo ezaziwa ngabantu bonke, okufanele zivunywe phambi kwabantu. Kodwa konke ukuvuma kufanele kukhanye futhi kuqonde, ngokuvuma izono onecala kuzo.”-Steps to Christ, p. 38.

“Isono sesimilo sangasese kufanele sivunywe kuKristu, okunguye yedwa umlamuli phakathi kukaNkulunkulu nomuntu….Isono ngasinye siyicala elimelene noNkulunkulu, futhi kufanele sivunywe Kuye ngoKristu. Sonke isono esinziwe phambi kwabantu kufanele sivunywe phambi kwabantu.”-Gospel Workers, p. 216.

q.text: b. Ngeyiphi inhloso yokuvuma izono ngeqiniso-na?

note.text: “Ezinsukwini zikaSamuweli uIsrayeli wazulazula kude noNkulunkulu. Wahlupheka ngenxa yemiphumela yesono; ngoba balahlile ukukholwa kwabo kuNkulunkulu, balahlekelwa ukubona amandla Akhe nokuhlakanipha okubusa isizwe, balahlekelwa ithemba lamandla Akhe ukuvikela impindiselo yokusebenza Kwakhe. Baphendukela uMbusi omkhulu wezulu nomhlaba futhi befisa ukubuswa njengoba zazinjalo izizwe ezibazungezile. Ngaphambi kokuba bathole ukuthula benza ukuvuma okukhanyayo: ‘Ngokuba senezele kuzo zonke izono zethu ububi bokuzicelela iNkosi.’ 1 Samuweli 12:19. Yisona kanye isono ababelahlwa ngaso okwakufanele basivume.”-Steps to Christ, pp. 38, 39.

q.text: c. Yisiphi isenzo esisebenzayo okufanele silandele ukuvuma izono-na?

note.text: “Ukuvuma akusoze kwamukeleka kuNkulunkulu ngaphandle kokuphenduka okuqinisile nemvuselelo. Kufanele kubekhona inguquko enqumayo yokuphila; konke okunyanyeka phambi kukaNkulunkulu kufanele kudelwe. Lona ngumphumela wokudabukela isono ngempela.”-Ibid., p. 39.

“Wonke umphefumulo oguqukile uzofana njengo-Zakewu, owagqamisa ukungena kukaKrisu enhliziyweni yakhe ngokulahla izenzo zokungcola ezaphawula ukuphila kwakhe. Njengomthelisi, uzonikela ngobufakazi bobuqotho bakhe ngokwenza ukubuyisela.”-The Desire of Ages, p. 556.

q.text: a. Lapho uNkulunkulu ebuza uAdamu noEva ngesono sabo, kungayiphi indlela abasho ngayo ukuthi akulona iphutha labo ngempela-na? Genesis 3:12, 13.

note.text: “UAdamu wayengakwazi ukuphika noma athethelele isono sakhe; kodwa esikhundleni sokubonisa ukuphenduka, wazama ukubeka icala kunkosikazi wakhe, kanjalo nakuNkulunkulu uQobo Lwakhe: ‘Owesifazane owangipha yena ukuba abe ngumkami, unginike wona umuthi, ngadla.”-Patriachs and Prophets, p. 57. [Author’s italics.]

“Emva kokuba uAdamu noEva sebedlile isithelo esenqatshelweyo, bagcwaliswa ngomuzwa wehlazo nokwesaba. Ekuqaleni babecabanga kuphela ukuthi bangathethelela kanjani isono sabo futhi baphunyuke kwisigwebo esesabakayo sokufa. Lapho iNkosi ibuza maqondana nesono sabo uAdamu waphendula ngokuthi, ebeka inxenye yecala kuNkulunkulu nenxenye kumlingane wakhe. ‘Owesifazane owangipha yena ukuba abe nami, unginikile umuthi, ngadla.’ Owesifazane wabeka icala phezu kwenyoka, wathi, ‘Inyoka ingikhohlisile, ngadla.’ ’Genesis 3:12, 13. Kungani udale inyoka-na? Kungani uyivumele ukuba ize ensimini yaseEdeni-na? Lena imibuzo ayiqondisa kuye ukuthetheleleni isono sakhe, kanjalo ebeka icala kuNkulunkulu maqondana nokuwa kwabo.”-Steps to Christ, p. 40.

q.text: b. Kungani ukuzithethelela kwenza ukuvuma izono kungaphumeleli-na?

note.text: “Umoya wokuzilungisisa waqala kuyise wamanga futhi uyabonakala kuwo wonke amadodana namadodakazi kaAdamu. Ukuvuma kwaloluhlobo akuqhutshwa uMoya ongcwele futhi angeke kwamukeleka kuNkulunkulu. Ukuphenduka ngeqiniso kuzoholela umuntu athwalele kuye icala lakhe futhi alivume ngaphandle kwenkohliso noma ukuzenzisa.”-Ibid., p. 40.

“Akufanele sizame ukunciphisa icala lethu ngokuthethelela isono. Kufanele samukele isono ngokulinganisa kukaNkulunkulu, futhi lokhu kusinda kakhulu. YiKhalivari kuphela elingembula ubutha obusabekayo besono. Uma kufanele sithwale isono sethu, sizosicindezela. Kodwa Lowo ongenasono uthathile indawo yethu; noma kungamfanele, ubuthwalile ububi bethu. ‘Uma sizivuma izono zethu,’ uNkulunkulu, uthembekile futhi ulungile ukusithethela izono zethu, asihlanze kukho konke ukungalungi.’ 1 Johane 1:9. Yiqiniso elihle kakhulu! Ulungile emthethweni Wakhe, kodwa uLungisisa bonke abakholwa kuJesu. ‘Ngubani onguNkulunkulu onjeNgawe. Othethelela insali yefa Lakho ububi bayo? Akabambeleli entukuthelweni Yakhe kuze kuba phakade.”-Thoughts from the Mount Blessings, p. 116.

q.text: a. Kungayiphi indlela uPawule ngokuthobeka avuma ngokuqondile isono sakhe-na?

note.text: “Izibonelo ezisezwini likaNkulunkulu zokuphenduka kweqiniso nokuzithoba zembula umoya wokuvuma izono lapho kungekho sizathu noma ukuzama ukuzilungisisa. UPawule akazange afune ukuzivikela; noma amboze isono sakhe ethunzini lobumnyama, engazami nokunciphisa icala lakhe. [ Izenzo 26:10, 11 ngokuphindwa].”-Steps to Christ, p. 41.

q.text: b. Kuyini uPawule ayimemezela encwadini yakhe yokuqala ku-Thimothi-na?

note.text: “Akufanele sizame ukunciphisa icala lethu ngokuthethelela isono. Kufanele samukele isillingaso sikaNkulunkulu maqondana nesono, ukuthi sinzima ngempela. IKhalivari kuphela elingembula ubukhulu obesabekayo besono. Uma kwakufanele sizithwalele icala lethu, besizosibulala. Kodwa Lowo ongenasono wathatha indawo yethu; noma wayengafanele, wabetshatha ububi bethu. ‘Uma sizivuma izono zethu,’ UNkulunkulu ‘uthembekile futhi ulungile ukuba asithethelele izono, asihlanze kukho konke ukungalungi.’ 1 Johane 1:9. Kuyqiniso elimangalisayo! -ngenxa yomthetho Wakhe, nokho enguMlungisi wabo bonke abakholwa kuJesu. ‘Ngubani onguNkulunkulu njeNgawe, othethelela insali yefa Lakho ububi bayo-na? Akabambeleli entukuthelweni yakhe kuze kube phakade, ngokuba wenamela umusa.’ Mika 7:18.”-Thoughts from the Mount Blessings, pp. 115, 116.

q.text: c. Uma sizivuma izono zethu, kuyini lokhu uNkulunkulu akuthembisile-na?

note.text: “Inhliziyo ethobekile nedabukileyo, ethotshiselwe ukuphenduka kwangempela, izothokozela okuthize othandweni lukaNkulunkulu ngenani laseKhalvari; futhi njengoba indodana ivuma izono zayo kuyise onothando, kanjalo ophenduka ngokweqiniso uzoletha zonke izono phambi kukaNkulunkulu. Futhi kulotshiwe, [1 Johane 1:9, ngokuphindiwe].”-Steps to Christ, p. 41.

reviewQuestions: 1. Uma sivuma izono zethu ngokwethembeka kuNkulunkulu, sima kanjani phambi Kwakhe?
2. Yiziphi izimo lapho okunye ukuvuma kufanele kwenziwe kwabanye abantu, futhi kungani-na?
3. Kungani kubalulekile ukuthi ukuvuma izono kuqonde-na?
4. Chaza ingozi yokuzithethelela.
5. Uyini umphumela wokuvuma ngokuzithoba-na?

lessons.title: Ukungcweliswa
lessons.keyTextVerse: IVESI LEKHANDA: “Niyakungifuna, ningifumane; lapho ningifunisisa ngenhliziyo yenu yonke”

keyText.text: IVESI LEKHANDA: “Niyakungifuna, ningifumane; lapho ningifunisisa ngenhliziyo yenu yonke”

keyNote.text: “Akunakwenzeka kithi ngamandla ethu ukugcina ukungqubuzana; nanoma yini ephambukisa ingqondo ukuba isuke kuNkulunkulu, noma yini esiholela ekuziphakamiseni noma ekuzethembeni, ngokuqiniseka silungiselela indlela yokuwa kwethu. Umgomo weBhayibheli ungukugxilisa ukungathembi amandla omuntu nokukhuthaza ukuthembela emandleni angcwele.”-Patriachs and Prophets, p. 717.

q.text: a. UPawule uchaza kanjani impi yobuKrestu nezikhali ezidingekayo-na?

note.text: “USathane wahlasela uKristu ngezilingo ezinolaka nezinobuqili obukhulu, kepha waxoshwa ekuhlaselweni konke. Lezo zimpi zaliwa ngenxa yethu; lokho kunqoba kwenza kwaphumelele kithi ukunqoba. UKristu uzonikeza amandla kubo bonke abawafunayo. Akukho muntu ngaphandle kokuvuma kwakhe onganqotshwa nguSathane. Umlingi akanawo amandla okulawula intando noma acindazele umphefumulo ukuba wone. Bangaba lusizi, kodwa angeke bangcoliswa. Bangabanga buhlungu, kodwa angeke bangcola. Umcabango wokuthi uKristu wanqoba kufanele ukhuthaze abalandeli Bakhe ngesibindi sokulwa ngobudoda impi yokumelana nesono noSathane.”-The Great Controversy.”-The Great Conroversy, p. 510.

q.text: b. Kukuphi lapho uSathane ezama ukuthola umbuso ngokuphelele-na?

note.text: “Ngokuba unjengozicabangelayo, unjalo naye.’ Izaga 23:7. Inhliziyo mayivuselelwe ngomusa ongcwele, noma kuzoba yize ukufuna ukuhlanzeka. Lowo ozama ukwakha isimilo esihle, nesilungile ngaphandle komusa kaKristu wakha indlu yakhe phezu kwesihlabathi solwandle. Ngesikhathi sesivunguvungu sesilingo esinamandla izowiswa phansi.”-Patriachs and Prophets, p. 460.

q.text: a. Kuyini okumele ukudele ukuze ube-ngumfundi kaKristu-na?

note.text: “Ekuzinikeleni kwethu kuNkulunkulu, kufanele silahle konke okuzosehlukanisa Naye. Kodwa uMsindisi uthi, [Luka 14:33 ngokuphindwa]. Noma yini ezosusa inhliziyo kuNkulunkulu kufanele iyekwe. UMamona uyisithixo sabaningi. Ukuthanda imali, ukufisa ingcebo, yiketanga legolide elibabophela kuSathane. Idumela nokuhlonishwa ngumhlaba kukhonzwa elinye ixuku. Ukuphila ngokukhululeka kubugovu nenkululeko yokuziphendulela kuyisithixo sabanye. Kodwa lezibopho zobugqila kufanele zigqashulwe. Angeke saba yinxenye yeNkosi nenxenye yomhlaba. Asisibo abantwana bakaNkulunkulu ngaphandle kokuthi sibe ngaBakhe ngokuphelele.”-Steps to Christ, p. 44.

q.text: b. Siyini isimemo iNkosi esidlulisela kubo bonke abafisa ukuvuselelwa kwenhliziyo nokuphila-na?

note.text: “Umbuso kaNkulunkulu akuwona, njengoba uSathane ezowenza ubonakale, njengosekelwe ekuzithobeni obuyimpumputhe, nokulawula okungenangqondo. Uncenga ingqondo nonembeza….UNkulunkulu akacindezeli intando yezidalwa Zakhe. Angeke amukele inkonzo engathandi nengazinikeli ngokuhlakanipha. Ukuzithoba okucindezelwe kuzovimbela konke ukuthuthuka kwengqondo nesimilo; kuzokwenza umuntu abe njengomshini ozihambelayo. Okunjalo akuyona inhloso yoMdali. Ufisa ukuthi umuntu, umsebenzi omkhulu wamandla Akhe okudala, uzofinyelela ekukhuleni okuphakeme kakhulu. Ubeka phambi kwethu isibusiso esikhulu leso afisa ukusinikeza ngomusa Wakhe. Uyasimema ukuthi sinikele Kuye, ukuze asebenze intando Yakhe kithi. Kusele kithi ukukhetha noma ukuba singakhululwa ebugqilini besono, ukwabelana nenkululeko yamadodana kaNkulunkulu.”-Ibid., pp. 43, 44.

“UKristu wabonakaliswa ngokusobala njengoMsindisi wabantu. Abantu kwakungafanele bathembele emisebenzini yabo, ekulungeni kwabo, noma ngokwabo nganoma ngayiphi indlela, kodwa kwiWundlu likaNkulunkulu elisusa izono zezwe. Kuye uMmeli noBaba bembulwa. Ngaye isimemo sanikezwa, ‘Wozani-ke, sithethe indaba, usho uJehova; noma izono zenu zibomvu kakhulu, ziyakuba mhlophe njengeqhwa; noma zibomvu njengokububende, ziyakuba njengoboya bezimvu.’ Lesimemo sizwakala phansi ngokufanayo kithina namuhla. Makungabikho ukuzigabisa, noma ukuzazi, noma ukulunga okungokwethu okuzovimbeli noma ngubani ukuba avume izono zakhe, ukuze abize isithembiso.”-Fundamental of Christian Education, p. 239.

q.text: a. Kuyini okunikeza uKristu ilungelo lokuthathela abantwana Bakhe abayise ezulwini-na?

note.text: “Phakathi kobumnyama obesabekayo, hleze bamkhohlwe uNkulunkulu, uKristu uthe waphuza izinsalela kwindebe yosizi lomuntu. Ngalamahora esabisayo wencika phezu kobufakazi bokwamukelwa nguBaba Wakhe ngaphambili azomupha Wona. Wayejwayelene nesimilo sikaBaba Wakhe; wazwisisa ukulunga Kwakhe, umusa Wakhe, nothando Lwakhe olukhulu. Ngokukholwa weyama Kuye lowo bekuyinjabulo Yakhe njalo ukuyilalela. Ngokuzithoba wazinikela uQobo kuNkulunkulu, umcabango wokulahlekelwa umusa kaNkulunkulu osusiwe. Ngokukholwa, uKristu waba ngumnqobi.”-The Desire of Ages, p. 756.

“Ngesipho esinguJesu, uNkulunkulu wanikela ngezulu lonke. Ngokombono womuntu, umhlatshelo onjalo ubuyincithakalo. Ngomcabango womuntu lonke icebo lensindiso yincithakalo yomusa kanye nezinsiza. Ukuzidela nomhlatshelo wenhliziyo yonke kuzohlangana nathi yonke indawo. Nokho sengathi umbutho wezulu ungabheka ngokumangalela umkhaya woluntu owenqaba ukuphakanyiswa nokunothiswa ngothando olungenamkhawulo olubonakaliswa kuKristu. Nokho bangababaza, Kungani kuyincithakalo enkulu-na?

“Kodwa ukuhlawulwa komhlaba olahlekile kwakufanele kugcwale, kubemkhulu, futhi uphelele. Umnikelo kaKristu bowumkhulu kakhulu ukuba ufinyelele kumphefumulo ngamunye lowo uNkulunkulu awudalile. Kwakungenakuvinjelwa ukuze kungadluli isibalo esizokwamukela iSipho esikhulu. Akusindiswa wonke umuntu; kodwa icebo lensindiso akuyona incithakalo ngoba ingaphelelisi yonke inkululeko yalo owunikelweyo. Kufanele kubekhona okwanele nesingakonga.”-Ibid., pp. 565, 566.

q.text: b. Kuyini uJesu akufuna kubo bonke abafisa ukuba abantwana Bakhe nabadinga ulwazi lokwamukela uMoya Wakhe-na?

note.text: “[UJesu] ulindile ngobumnene obunesisa ukulalela ukuvuma kwalabo abangalaleli, nokwamukela ukuphenduka kwabo. Ubheka imbuyiselo ethize yokubonga okuvela kubo, njengomama obheka ngokumomotheka ukubona okuvela kumntwana amthandayo. UNkulunkulu usifundisa ukuthi simbize ngoBaba. Uthanda ukuba siqonde ukuthi ngokukhuthala nangobumnene benhliziyo Yakhe ulangazelela ngaphezu kwezilingo zonke nokuhlolwa kwethu.”-Gospel Workers, p. 210.

“Kuyini esikudelayo, uma sinikela konke-na? Inhliziyo engcoliswe yisono, nokuthi uJesu ayihlanze, ayihlanze ngegazi Lakhe, nokuthi asisindise ngothando Lwakhe olungenamlinganiso. Nokho abantu bacabanga kanzima ukushiya konke! Nginamahloni ukuzwa kukhulunywa ngakho, nginamahloni ukubhala ngakho.”-Steps to Christ, p. 46.

q.text: a. Yisiphi isifiso sikaPawule esiqotho samakholwa-na?

note.text: “Noma ayeqondiswe kuIsrayeli wasendulo, lamazwi aqukethe isifundo sabantu bakaNkulunkulu namuhla. Lapho umpostoli enxusa abazalwane Bakhe ukuba banikele imizimba yebo ‘ibe ngumnikelo ophilileyo, ongcwele, othandeka kuNkulunkulu,’ wabeka phambili izimiso sokungcweliswa kweqiniso. Akuwona umcabango nje, noma umuzwa, noma isimo samazwi, kodwa ukuphila, kwesimiso esisebenzayo esingeniswa ekuphileni kwemihla ngemihla. Kudinga ukuthi imikhuba yokudla kwethu, ukuphuza, nokwembatha okufanele kuvikele umzimba, ingqondo, nokuziphatha kwempilo, ukuthi sinikele eNkosini imizimba yethu, kungewona umnikelo owonakele ngenxa yemikhuba ephambukile, kodwa umnikelo ophilileyo, ongcwele, othandeka kuNkulunkulu.”-The Sanctified, pp. 27, 28.

"Kufanele sizinikele ngokwethu emsebenzini kaNkulunkulu, futhi kufanele sifune ukwenza umnikelo ophelele ngokungenzeka. UNkulunkulu angeke athokozela nanoma yini okuncane kunokungcono esingakunikela. Kulabo abamthanda ngenhliziyo yonke, bazolangazela ukunikela umsebenzi omuhle wokuphila, futhi kaningi bazofisa ukuletha amandla onke wobuntu babo ekuvumelaneni nemithetho ezokhulisa ulwazi lwabo ekwenzeni intando Yakhe.”-Patriachs and Prophets, pp. 352, 353.

q.text: b. Lapho izixuku zizwa inkulumo kaPeter ngosuku lwePentekoste, wawuyini umthwalo wezinhliziyo zabo-na?

note.text: “[Isixuku] sezwa abafundi bememezela ukuthi bekuyiNdodana kaNkulunkulu ebethelwe esiphambanweni. Abapristi nababusi bathuthumela. Ukulahlwa yicala nosizi kwabamba abantu. ‘Sebekuzwa bahlabeka enhliziyweni, bathi kuPeter nakwabanye abapostoli, Madoda bazalwane, siyakwenzenjani-na?’ Phakathi kwalabo ababelalele abafundi kwakungamaJuda azinikele, abeqotho ekukholweni kwabo. Amandla ahambisana namazwi esikhulumi abavumisa ukuthi uJesu unguMesiya ngempela….

“UPeter wacindezela phezu kwabantu abalahlwe yicala umcijo wokuthi bamenqabile uKristu ngoba badukiswa abapristi nababusi; nokuthi uma beqhubeka ukubheka kulabo bantu ukuba babaqondise, nokuthi balindele kubo ukuvuma uKristu ngaphambi kokwenza lokho, abasoze bamamukela uKristu nanini. Lamadoda anamandla, noma ezisho ukuthi ayamesaba uNkulunkulu, ayefisa ingcebo nodumo. Babengazimisele ukuza kuKristu ukuze bathole ukukhanya.”-The Acts of the Apostles, pp. 43, 44.

q.text: a. Kuyini okuletha ukuqiniseka kokuthi singangcweliswa ngokungcwele eNkosini futhi sikwazi ukuthwala umfanekiso kaKristu-na?

note.text: “UNkulunkulu akanxusi ukuba wesabe ukuthi uZohluleka ukuphelelisa izithembiso Zakhe, ukuthi ukubekezela Kwakhe kuzodikibala, noma uzwelo Lwakhe luzotholakala lulula. Yesaba hleze intando yakho angeke yabanjwa ukuthobela intando kaKristu, hleze uzalo lwakho nemikhuba ekhuliswe yisimilo izolawula ukuphila kwakho. ‘Ngokuba nguNkulunkulu osebenza kini nokuthanda nokwenza njengentando Yakhe.’ Yesaba hleze umina uzongena phakathi komphefumulo wakho nokuSebenza kweNkosi okukhulu. Yesaba hleze intando kamina ingcolise inhloso ephakeme yokuthi ngawe uNkulunkulu ufisa ukuphelelisa. Yesaba ukuthembela emandleni akho, yesaba ukususa isandla sakho esandleni sikaKristu nokuzama ukuhamba endleleni yokuphila ngaphandle kobukhona Bakhe obuhlalayo.”-Christ’s Object Lessons, p. 161.

q.text: b. Kungagcinwa kanjani ukuqina ekukholweni nokuzinikela ngokuphelele ezimisweni ezifanele ukugcinwa-na?

note.text: “Labo abazozuza isibusiso sokungcweliswa kufanele bafunde kuqala isizathu sokuzidela. Isiphambano sikaKristu siyinsika engaphakathi okulenga phezu kwaso isisindo sobukhosi esidlulele senkazimulo ephakade.”-The Acts of the Apostles, p. 560.

“Awukwazi ukuguqula inhliziyo yakho, awukwazi ngokwakho ukunikeza uNkulunkulu ukuthanda kwayo; kodwa ungakhetha ukumkhonza. Ungamnika intando Yakho; Yena uzosebenza kuwe ukuthanda nokwenza ngokwentando Yakhe….

“Ngokusebenzisa intando efanele, lonke ushintsho lungenziwa empilweni yakho. Ngokunikela intando yakho kuKristu. Uzihlanganisa namandla angaphezu kwabo bonke ubukhosi namandla. Uzoba namandla avela phezulu okukubamba uqinile, futhi ngokuzinikela njalo kuNkulunkulu uzokwazi ukuphila impilo entsha, ngisho nempilo yokukholwa.”-Steps of Christ, pp. 47, 48. [Authors italics]

reviewQuestions: 1. Kuyini okudingekayo ukuze siphumelele empini yokulwa nesitha semiphefumulo yethu-na?
2. Iyiphi impi yangempela ukuze sibe nokunqoba isitha esikade sanqotshwa-na?
3. Kuyini esingakufunda ngesipho sikaKristu ngensindiso yethu-na?
4. Iyiphi inhloso kaNkulunkulu kwabakholwayo, ngokomzimba nangesimoya-na?
5. Uma intando yethu ivumelana nentando kaNkulunkulu, mava mani esizoba nawo nsuku zonke-na?

paragraph.text: “Khulisa umntwana ngendlela eyakuba-ngeyakhe: kuyakuthi lapho esekhulile angasuki kuyo” (Izaga 22:6).

Siphila esikhathini esizothile. Phakathi komphakathi okhulayo emhlabeni, ukuziphendulela bokufundisa abantwana bethu nabasha ukumesaba uJehova kuphuthuma kakhulu ukudlula ngaphambili. Njengabazali, abafundisi, namalunga omzimba kaKristu, sinomsebenzi ongcwele wokulungisa isizukulwane esizokwazi ukuvikela ukholo ngokuqina, ngokuzithoba, nangokuqiniseka.
“Ulwazi lwemfundo yangempela iqiniso, okufanele ligxiliswe ngokujulile emphefumulweni kangangokuba awukwazi ukunciphisa iphutha eligcwele yonke indawo.”-Testimonies for the Church, vol. 6, p. 131.

Kulengqikithi, iGenerala Conference Education Department ilokhu isebenza ngokuhlakanipha ukuqinisa nokukhulisa izikolo zethu zokuhambisa ivangeli emhlabeni wonke. Izikhungo eziningi zemfundo ziswela izakhiwo ezifanele, uhlelo lwanamuhla, nezinto zokwakha ezifanela isimoya ngempela abafundi bethu. Ukudlula lapho, amazwe ahlukene acele ukuvulwa kwezikhungo zemfundo ezikhulisa kungesikho imfundo kuphela kodwa izimiso zevangeli elingunaphakade.
Lomnikelo okhethekil uzoxhasa izindawo ezintathu ezibalulekile:
1. Ukwakhiwa kabusha kokubakhona kwezikolo zokohambisa ivangeli:
2. Ukumiswa kwezikolo ezintsha kwizifunda ezidinga ukungena ku-SDARM Christian Education.
3. Ukuhumusha okusezingeni eliphakeme nomsebenzi wokulungisa impahla yokufunda ezikhulisiwe yiqembu labothishela ukusiza izikolo zokuvangela ngezilimi ezihlukene neziyingqikithi yemvelo.

“Imfundo yangempela ukuqeqeshwa kokuhambisa ivangeli. Yonke indodana nendodakazi kaNkulunkulu babizelwa ukuhambisa ivangeli; sibizelwa umsebenzi kaNkulunkulu nabangane bethu; nokusenza silungele lomsebenzi kufanele kube isihloko semfundo yethu.”-The Ministry of Healing, p. 395.

“Ngakho-ke, siyanicela, bazalwane nodade abathandekayo, nilethe iminikelo ngesihle ngombono wokuhambisa ivangeli. Sinikele kwimfundo yabantwana bethu nabasha sigcina ikusasa lebandla, ekumemezeleni ivangeli, nakwisivuno sokugcina.

Kwangathi iNkosi ingandisa izipho zenu iqinise ukubaluleka kokufundisa-futhi kwangathi izikolo zethu ngempela zingaba ukukhanya okukhazimula ebumnyameni, ukulungiselela isizukulwane esithembekile ekubuyeni masinyane koMsindisi wethu.

lessons.title: Ukukholwa Nokwamukela
lessons.keyTextVerse: IVESI LEKHANDA: “Ngiyakuninika inhliziyo entsha, ngifake phakathi kwenu umoya omusha, ngikhiphe inhliziyo yetshe enyameni yenu, ngininike inhliziyo yenyama”

keyText.text: IVESI LEKHANDA: “Ngiyakuninika inhliziyo entsha, ngifake phakathi kwenu umoya omusha, ngikhiphe inhliziyo yetshe enyameni yenu, ngininike inhliziyo yenyama”

keyNote.text: “Awukwazi ukuhlawula izono zakho ezedlule; awukwazi ukuguqula inhliziyo yakho uyenze -ngcwele. Kodwa izithembiso zikaNkulunkulu zizokwenzela konke lokhu ngoKristu.”-Steps to Christ, p. 51.

q.text: a. Yisiphi isithembiso sikaNkulunkulu esimangalisayo sentethelelo nokuthula-na?

note.text: “Uyabona ukuthi ukuphila kwakho kugcwele ubugovu nesono. Uyafisa ukuthethelelwa, ukuhlanzwa, nokukhululwa. Ube nokuvumelana noNkulunkulu, ufane Naye-kuyini ongakwenza ukuba ukuzuze-na?

“Udinga ukuthula-Intethelelo yeZulu ukuthula nothando emphefumulweni. Akuthengwa ngemali, nokuhlakanipha akusoze kwakuthola, ukwazi angeke kwakuzuza; angeke waba nethemba, ngemizamo yakho, ukuba ungakuzuza, kodwa uNkulunkulu ukupha kona njengesipho, ngaphandle kwemali nangaphandle kwentengo.’ Kungokwakho uma uzokwelula kuphela isandla sakho ukubambe.”- Steps to Christ, p. 49.

q.text: b. Yisiphi esinye isithembiso esibalulekile esizoguqula sonke isidalwa sibe umuntu omusha ngokuvumelana noNkulunkulu-na?

note.text: “Uzivumile izono zakho, futhi ngenhliziyo wazilahla. Wanquma ukuzinikela kuNkulunkulu. Manje hamba Kuye, umcele ukuthi ahlanze izono zakho akuphe inhliziyo entsha. Bese uyakholwa ukuthi wenza lokhu ngoba uthembisile. Lesi isifundo uJesu asifundisa ngesikhathi elapha emhlabeni, ukuthi isipho uNkulunkulu asithembise sona, masikholwe ukuthi sizosamukela, futhi singesethu.”-Ibid., pp. 49, 50. [Author’s italics.]

q.text: a. Kuyini uJesu akutshela ofe uhlangothi eBethesda ukuba akwenze futhi kuyini esingakufunda kulamava-na?

note.text: “Masiphendukele kwimbali yomuntu okhubazekile eBethesda. Ohluphekile nompofu wayengenakuzisiza; akazange asebenzise izitho zomzimba iminyaka engamashumi amathathu nesishiyagalombili. Kodwa uJesu wathi kuye, ‘Sukuma, uthabathe uhlaka lwakho, uhambe.’ Lomuntu ogulayo ngabe wathi, ‘Nkosi uma ungangiphilisa, ngizolalela izwi Lakho.’ Kodwa, cha, wakholwa yizwi likaKristu, wakholwa ukuthi usephilisiwe, wenza umzamo ngaleso sikhathi; wavuma ukuhamba, futhi wahamba ngempela. Wenza ngokusho kwezwi likaKristu, noNkulunkulu wamupha amandla. Waphulukiswa.”-Steps to Christ, p. 50.

“UJesu akazange amuphe isiqiniseko sosizo olungcwele. Lendoda ngabe yavumela ukungabaza, ngabe yalahlekelwa umzuzu owodwa wokuphiliswa. Kodwa yakholwa yizwi likaKristu, futhi ngokwenza ngokwezi Lakhe yathola amandla.

“Ngokukholwa okufanayo singamukela ukwelashwa kwesimoya. Ngenxa yesono sisusiwe ekuphileni kukaNkulunkulu. Imiphefumulo yethu ikhubaziwe. Ngokwethu asisakwazi ukuphila impilo engcwele kunaleyo umuntu angabanamandla okuyihamba. Kukhona abaningi abaqondayo ukungabinakho ukuzisiza, labo abalangazela ukuphila kwesimoya okuzobaletha ekuvumelaneni noNkulunkulu; bazama ngeze ukukuzuza. Ngokulahlekelwa ithemba bayamemeza, ‘Wo mina muntu wosizi! ngubani oyakungikhulula kulomzimba wokufa-na? Roma 7:24, isiphetho. Makuthi lokudangala, abahluphekayo babheke phezulu. UMsindisi uthobela phezu kokuthengwe ngegazi Lakhe, uthi ngobumnene obungechazwe kanye nesihawu, ‘Uyathanda ukusinda-na? Uyakuncenga ukuba uvuke uphile ube nokuthula.”-The Desire of Ages, p. 203.

“Awusoze wahlawula izono zakho ezedlule; awusoze waguqula inhliziyo yakho uyenze ibengcwele. Kodwa izithembiso zikaNkulunkulu zizokwenza konke lokhu kuwe ngoKristu. Uyakholwa yini yilesithembiso. Uyavuma yini izono zakho bese uzinikela ngokwakho kuNkulunkulu. Uyathanda yini ukumkhonza. Uma ukwenza lokhu ngempela, uNkulunkulu uzophelelisa izwi Lakhe kuwe. Uma ukholwa isithembiso-kholwa ukuthi uthethelelwe futhi uhlanjuliwe-uNkulunkulu uzogcwalisa umcabango; uzopheleliswa, njengoba uKristu anikeza amandla okuhamba kulowo okhubazekile lapho lendoda ikholwa ukuthi iphilisiwe. Kuzobanjalo nakuwe uma ukholwa yiso.
“Ungalindi uzizwe ukuthi uphilisiwe, kodwa ithi, ‘Ngiyakholwa; ukuthi kunjalo, kungesikho ukuthi uyazizwa, kodwa ngoba uNkulunkulu uthembisile.”- Steps to Christ, p. 51. [Author’s italics.]

q.text: a. Uma uJesu emukelwa njengoMsindisi, kwenzekani ezonweni zesikhathi esedlule-na?

note.text: “‘Konke enikukhulekelayo nenikucelayo, kholwani ukuthi nikwamukele, nizakuba-nakho.’ Marako 11:24. Kukhona umbandela kulesithembiso-ukuthi sikhuleke ngokuya ngentando kaNkulunkulu. Kodwa intando kaNkulunkulu engasihlanza esonweni, ukusenza abantwana Bakhe, nokusisiza ukuba siphile impilo engcwele. Kanjalo singacela lezibusiso, sikholwe ukuthi sizamukele, simbonge uNkulunkulu ukuthi sizamukele. Kuyilungelo lethu lokuya kuJesu asihlanze, nokuthi sime phambi komthetho ngaphandle kwamahloni noma ukuzisola.”-Steps to Christ, p. 51. [Author’s italics.]

q.text: b. Ukuma okunjani okholwayo anakho phambi kukaNkulunkulu-na?

note.text: “Lapho ukuphila kwamaKrestu kuphawulwa ngokuzithoba, akufanele kuphawulwe ngosizi nokuzilulaza. Kuyilungelo lomuntu ngamunye ukuphila lokhu uNkulunkulu azokuvuma futhi ambusise. Akuyona intando kaBaba wethu osezulwini ukuthi sibe ngaphansi kokulahlwa nobumnyama. Abukho ubufakazi bokuzithoba ngeqiniso ngokuhamba ugobise ikhanda phansi kodwa inhliziyo igcwele imicabango yomina. Singaya kuJesu ukuba sihlanzwe, nokuma phambi komthetho ngaphandle kwamahloni nokuzisola.”-The Great Controversy, p. 477.

“Uma sizinikela ngakho konke kuNkulunkulu, sikholwe ngokugcwele, egazini likaKristu elihlanza ezonweni zonke. Unembeza ungakhululwa ekulahlweni. Ngokukholwa egazini Lakhe, konke kuzopheleliswa ngoKristu Jesu…. Akufanele sikhathazeke ukuthi uKristu noNkulunkulu bacabangani ngathi, kodwa ukuthi uNkulunkulu ucabangani ngoKristu, uMbambeli wethu. Nina namukelwa ngoThandiweyo.”-Selected Messages, bk. 2, pp. 32, 33.

q.text: c. Ngeyiphi inguquko okumele ibonwe yibo bonke abangena ebudlelwaneni besivumelwano noNkulunkulu-na? 1 Peter 1:18, 19;

note.text: “Kepha anisebona abenu; nithengiwe ngenani. [1 Peter 1:18, 19 ngokuphindwa.] Ngenxa yesenzo esilula sokukholwa kuNkulunkulu, uMoya Ongcwele udala ukuphila okusha enhliziyweni yakho. Ufana nomntwana ozelwe emndenini kaNkulunkulu, futhi uyakuthanda njengoba ethanda iNdodana Yakhe.”-Steps to Christ, pp. 51, 52.

q.text: a. Kungayiphi indlela okulindelwe ukuthi ikholwa liziphathe ngayo-na?

note.text: “Manje njengoba usuzinikele kuJesu, mawungabuyeli emuva, ungazisusi Kuye, kodwa imihla ngemihla uthi, ‘Ngingoka-Kristu; Ngizinikele Kuye;’ bese ucela akuphe uMoya Wakhe akugcine ngomusa Wakhe. Njengoba kungokuzinikele kuNkulunkulu, ukholwe Nguye, ukuthi uba ngumntwana Wakhe, kanjalo kufanele uphile Kuye. Umposoli uthi, ‘Ngakho-ke njengalokhu nimamukele uKristu Jesu iNkosi, hambani niKuye.’ Kolose 2:6.

“Abanye bazizwa ukuthi kufanele babe semuseni, futhi kufanele bafakaze eNkosini ukuthi balungisiwe, ngaphambi kokuba babize isibusiso Sakhe. Kodwa bangabiza isibusiso sikaNkulunkulu ngisho namuhla. Kufanele babe nomusa Wakhe, uMoya kaKristu, ubasize ebuthakathakeni babo, noma abasoze bamelane nobubi. UJesu uyathanda ukuthi size Kuye njengoba sinjalo, siyizoni, singenakuzisiza, siphethwe. Singeza Kuye nabo bonke ubuthakathaka bethu, ubuthutha bethu, ukona kwethu, siwe ezinyaweni Zakhe ngokudabukela isono. Kuyinkazimulo Yakhe ezingalweni zothando Lwakhe nokubopha amanxeba ethu, nokusihlanza kukho konke ukungcola.”-Steps to Christ, p. 52.

q.text: b. Yikuphi ukuhlinzekelwa kwamaphutha okwenziwe ngohlelo lokufunda-na?

note.text: “Bekela eceleni ukucabangela ukuthi izithembiso zikaNkulunkulu azenzelwanga wena. Lezithembiso ezawo wonke ophenduka ekweqeni umthetho. Amandla nomusa kunikeziwe ngoKristu okulethwa ngezingelosi ezisiza wonke umphefumulo okholwayo. Akukho oyisoni esikhulu ongasoze athole amandla, ukuhlanzeka, nokulunga kukaJesu, owabafelayo. Ulindele ukususa izambatho zabo ezinabala nezingcoliswe isono, nokubeka phezu kwabo ingubo emhlophe yokulunga; uyabanxusa ukuba baphile futhi bangafi.”-Ibid., pp. 52, 53.

q.text: c. Chaza ukuthi siqiniswa kanjani kuloluhambo.

note.text: “Labo abahamba ngezindlela zokuhlakanipha, ngisho nasekuhluphekeni, babonakala bejabule kakhulu; ngoba Lowo othandwa umphefumulo wabo, uyahamba, engabonwa, phambi kwabo. Inyathelo ngalinye elinyukela phezulu lihlukanisa ngokukhanyayo ukuthinta kwesandla Sakhe; kwinyathelo ngalinye imisebe ekhanyayo yenkazimulo yokuwa Okungabonwa endleleni yabo; nezingoma zabo zokudumisa, zifinyelela kwizinga eliphezulu, lenyuke ukuhlanganyele nengoma yezingelosi phambi kwesihlalo sobukhosi.”-Thoughts from the Mount of Blessings, p. 140.
“UNkulunkulu akasiphathi njengabantu abangafi abaphathana ngayo omunye komunye. Imicabango Yakhe iyimicabango yomusa, uthando, nozwelo olumnene.”-Steps to Christ, p. 50.

“Bonke abangaphansi kokukhuza kukaNkulunkulu bazothobisa umphefumulo ngokuvuma nokuphenduka, njengoba kwenza uDaniyeli, angaqiniseka ukuthi likhona ithemba kuye. Bonke ngokukholwa abamukela izithembiso zikaNkulunkulu, bazothola intethelelo. INkosi angeke yadela umphefumulo ophenduka ngokweqiniso.”-Patriachs and Prophets, p. 726.

q.text: b. Siyini isimo sengqondo kaBaba wethu osezulwini seqiniso kubo bonke abadukile-na?

note.text: “USathane ulungele ukweba ithemba elibusisekile likaNkulunkulu. Ufisa ukuthatha konke ukulokoza kwethemba nemisebe yonke yokukhanya emphefumulweni; kodwa ungamvumeli akwenze lokho. Unganikezi indlebe kumlingi, kodwa yithi, ‘UJesu wafa ukuze ngiphile. Uyangithanda, futhi engathandi ukuba ngibhubhe…Umfanekiso usitshela ukuthi ozulayo uzokwamukelwa: [Luka 15:18-20 ngokuphindwa].

“Ngisho nalomfanekiso, omnene nonomhawu njengoba unjalo, uyasilela ukugcizelela uzwelo olungapheli lukaBaba osezulwini. Umprofethi uthi ngoJehova, ‘Ngikuthandile ngothando oluphakade: ngalokho ngikudonsile ngomusa.’ Jeremiya 31:3. Lapho isoni sikude nekhaya likaBaba, sichitha imfuyo yaso ezweni engalaziyo, inhliziyo kaBaba beyimlangazelela; futhi konke ukulangazela okuvuswa emphefumulweni ukuba kubuyele kuNkulunkulu kumane kuncenga ngesisa soMoya Wakhe, ukuvumisa, ukuncenga, ukusondeza isihambi enhliziyweni yothando lukaYise.”-Steps to Christ, pp. 53, 54. [Author’s italics.]

reviewQuestions: 1. Kuyini okungena emphefumulweni lowo izono zakhe zithethelelwe-na?
2. Kungani ofe uhlangothi eBethesda abanakho ukuhamba masinyane-na?
3. Lapho samukela uKristu njengoMsindisi wethu, yisiphi isithembiso okungesethu-na?
4. Iyini imfihlakalo yokuhamba ngokunqoba noKristu-na?
5. Chaza umehluko phakathi kwenzondo kaSathane nothando lukaBaba oluhlengayo.

lessons.title: Ukuhlolwa Kobufundi
lessons.keyTextVerse: IVESI LEKHANDA: “Kanjalo uma umuntu ekuKristu, uyisidalwa esisha; okwakuqala kudlulile; bheka, sekuvele okusha”

keyText.text: IVESI LEKHANDA: “Kanjalo uma umuntu ekuKristu, uyisidalwa esisha; okwakuqala kudlulile; bheka, sekuvele okusha”

keyNote.text: “Isimilo siyembulwa, hayi ngezenzo ezinhle ngezikhathi ezithile, nokungenzi lutho, kodwa umkhuba ovamile ngamazwi nezenzo.”-Steps to Christ, pp. 57, 58.

q.text: a. Yisiphi isifundo uKristu asifundisa sona lapho echaza umsebenzi wokuphenduka-na?

note.text: “Umuntu angeke akwazi ukusho isikhathi esiqondile noma indawo, noma alandelise uhlu lwemininingwane yezehlakalo zokuphenduka; kodwa lokhu akusho ukuthi akaphendukanga…Njengomoya, awubonakali, kodwa imiphumela yawo ibonakala ngokukhanyayo futhi iyezwakala, ngoMoya kaNkulunkulu emsebenzini wawo phezu kwenhliziyo yomuntu. Lamandla adala kabusha, lowo kungekho mehlo omuntu ongawabona, ukuzalwa kwempilo entsha emphefumulweni; adala kabusha umuntu ngomfanekiso kaNkulunkulu.”-Steps to Christ, p. 57.

q.text: b. Ngeyiphi inguquko ezobonakala ekuphileni kulowo oguquke ngempela-na?

note.text: “Lapho singakwazi ukwenza noma yini ukuguqula izinhliziyo zethu noma ukuziletha ekuvumelaneni noNkulunkulu; nalapho singafanele ukuzethemba ngakho konke noma imisebenzi yethu emihle, ukuphila kwethu kuzokwembula noma umusa kaNkulunkulu uhlezi phakathi kwethu. Inguquko izobonakala esimilweni, imikhuba, okulandelwayo. Umahluko uzocaca futhi unqunywe phakathi kwalokhu bebeyikho ngaphambili nalokhu abayikho manje…

“Kuyiqiniso ukuthi kungabakhona ukulunga kokuziphatha okubonwayo ngaphandle kwamandla aguqulayo kaKristu. Uthando lomfutho nokufisa ukuthanda abanye kuzoveza ukuphila okuhleleke kahle. Ukuzihlonipha kuzosiholela ukuthi sigweme ukubonakala kokubi. Inhliziyo ezidelayo ingenza izenzo zomusa. Okusho ukuthi, ngalesikhathi, sizonquma ukuthi sisohlangothini lukabani-na?
“Ngubani osenhliziyweni-na? Imicabango yethu ikubani-na?”-Ibid., pp. 57, 58.

q.text: a. Yisiphi isithelo esivezwa yilabo abangcweliswe ngoMoya-na?

note.text: “Labo ababa yizidwala ezintsha kuKristu Jesu bazoveza izithelo zikaMoya…Izinto ababezizonda ngaphambili manje bayazithanda, izinto ababezithanda manje bayazizonda. Izwi lokuzigabisa libamnene futhi lithobeke ngenhliziyo. Okuyize nokuqholoshayo kubanzima futhi kungavinjelwa. Isidakwa siyaqabuleka, nalowo onemikhuba emibi iyahlanzeka. Imikhuba eyize nemfashini yomhlaba zibekelwa eceleni. AmaKrestu angeke afuna ‘makungabi ngokungaphandle,’ kodwa makube ‘ngumuntu osithakeleyo wenhliziyo, ohloba ngokungabhubhiyo komoya omnene onokuthula.’ 1 Peter 3:3, 4.”-Steps to Christ, pp. 58, 59.

“Umfutho woMoya Ongcwele ukuphila kukaKristu emphefumulweni. Asimboni uKristu noma sikhulume Naye, kodwa uMoya Wakhe Ongcwele useduze kwethu endaweni eyodwa njengakomunye. Usebenza ngaphakathi nakubo bonke abamukela uKristu. Labo abazi ngokuhlala koMoya ngaphakathi okuveza izithelo zikaMoya-uthando, injabulo, ukubekezela, ubumnene, ubuhle, nokukholwa.”-The SDA Bible Commentary, [E. G. White Comments], vol. 6, p. 1112.

“Abukho ubufakazi benguquko yangempela ngaphandle kokuba kusebenze imvuselelo. Uma ebuyisela isiqiniseko, enikela futhi loku akuphangile, avume izono zakhe, futhi athande uNkulunkulu nabangane bakhe, isoni singaqiniseka ukuthi sidlulile ekufeni sangena ekuphileni.

“Lapho, njengabaphambukayo, izidalwa ezonayo, siza kuKristu sibe ngabahlanganyeli bomusa Wakhe othethelelayo, uthando luzobonakala enhliziyweni. Wonke umthwalo ubalula, ngoba ijoka uKristu alibeka phezu kwakhe lilula. Umsebenzi uba yintokozo, futhi ukuzidela kuba yinjabulo. Indlela ngaphambili ebibonakala yembozwe ubumnyama, iyakhanya ngemisebe evela kwiLanga Lokulunga.

“Ubuhle besimilo sikaKristu buzobonakala kubalandeli Bakhe. Bekuyintokozo Kuye ukwenza intando kaNkulunkulu. Uthando kuNkulunkulu, ukushisekela inkazimulo Yakhe, kungamandla abelawula ukuphila koMsindisi wethu. Uthando oluhlobisa nolukhulisa zonke izenzo Zakhe. Uthando olukaNkulunkulu. Inhliziyo engangcweliswanga angeke yalubonakalisa. Lutholakala enhliziyweni edalwe kabusha ngomusa ongcwele, uthando luyisimiso sokwenza. Lulungisa isimilo, lubusa inhliziyo, lilawula inkanuko, luthobisa inzondo, futhi likhulise uthando. Loluthando, luthokozisa umphefumulo, lwenza ukuphila kubemnandi luhlakaze umfutho kubo bonke abasizungezile.”-Steps to Christ, p. 59.

q.text: a. Yimaphi amaphutha emukelekayo kumaKrestu azishoyo-na? Filiphi 3:9;

note.text: “Kukhona amaphutha amabili amelene nabantwana bakaNkulunkulu-ikakhulu labo abeze kuphela ukuthembela emuseni Wakhe-kufanele baqaphele kakhulu. Iphutha lokuqala, esihlezi kulo manje, kungukubheka eyabo imisebenzi, bathembele kunoma-yini abangayenza, ukuziletha ekuvumelaneni noNkulunkulu. Lowo ozama ukubangcwele ngeyakhe imisebenzi ukugcina umthetho, uzama okungeke kwenzeka. Konke okungenziwa umuntu ngaphandle kukaKristu kungcoliswe ngobugovu nesono. Ngumusa kaKristu kuphela, ngokukholwa, okungasenza sibe-ngcwele.

“Okuphambene nakho futhi okuyiphutha eliyingozi ngokufanayo ukuthi ukukholwa kuKristu kukhulula abantu ekugcineni umthetho kaNkulunkulu; ukuthi ngokukholwa kuphela siba ngabahlanganyeli bomusa kaKristu, imisebenzi yethu ayinakwenza lutho ngosindiso lwethu.”-Steps to Christ, pp. 59, 60.

q.text: b. Kungayiphi indlela isithembiso sesivumelwano esisha senza kugqame kanjani ukuthi umusa kaKristu awusikhiphi ekulaleleni umthetho kaNkulunkulu-na?

note.text: “Umthetho kaNkulunkulu ungamazwi emvelo Yakhe; ungukuhlanganiswa kwesimiso esikhulu sothando, futhi uyisisekelo sombuso Wakhe ezulwini nasemhlabeni. Uma izinhliziyo zethu ziguqulwa zifane noNkulunkulu, uma uthando olungcwele lutshalwa emphefumulweni, ingabe umthetho kaNkulunkulu awusoze wathwalwa ekuphileni-na? Lapho isimiso sothando sitshalwa enhliziyweni, lapho umuntu eguqulelwa emfanekisweni waLowo owamdalayo, isithembiso sesivumelwano esisha siyagcwaliseka [Heberu 10:16 ngokuphindwa]. Uma umthetho ubhalwa enhliziyweni, angeke yini wabumba ukuphila-na? Ukulalela-umsebenzi nokuthembeka kothando-kuluphawu ngempela lobufundi.”-Ibid., p. 60.

“UNkulunkulu udinga namuhla lokhu ayekudinga kwababili abangcwele ensimini yaseEdeni, ukulalela okuphelele kwizimfuno Zakhe. Umthetho Wakhe uhlala unjalo ngezikhathi zonke. Isilinganiso esikhulu sokulunga esibonakaliswe kwiTestamende Elidala awehliswanga kwiTestamende Elisha. Akuwona umsebenzi wevangeli ukwenza buthakathaka izimfuno zomthetho ongcwele kaNkulunkulu, kodwa umsebenzi wevangeli ukuletha abantu phezulu lapho bangacina izimiso zawo.

“Ukukholwa kuKristu okusindisa umphefumulo akusikho lokhu okuboniswa ngabaningi. ‘Kholwani, kholwani,’ isikhalo sabo; ‘Kholwani kuKristu kuphela, uzosindiswa. Yilokhu kuphela okumele ukwenze.’ Kuyilapho ukukholwa kwangempela kungukuthembela ngokugcwele kuKristu ukuze usindiswe, ukukholwa kuzokuholela ngokuphelele ekuvumelaneni nomthetho kaNkulunkulu.”-The SDA Bible Commentary [E. G. White Comments], vol. 6, p. 1073.

q.text: a. Kuyini okulindelwe kumalunga azokhethelwa ukuphila okuphakade-na?

note.text: “Uma uzinikela uqobo [kuKristu], umamukele futhi njengoMsindisi wakho, besekuthi, ukuphila kwakho kwesono njengoba kwakunjalo, ngenxa Yakhe ubalelwa ukuthi ulungile. Isimilo sikaKristu sima endaweni yesimilo sakho, futhi wamukeleka phambi kukaNkulunkulu kungathi awuzange wona.

“Ukudlula lokhu, uKristu uguqula inhliziyo, uhlala enhliziyweni yakho ngokukholwa. Kufanele ugcine lokuhlangana noKristu ngokukholwa nokuzinikela okuqhubekayo ngentando yakho Kuye; njengoba uqhubeka wenza lokhu, uzosebenza kuwe ukuthanda nokwenza ngokuya ngokuhle okuthokozisa Yena. Ngakho-ke ungathi, ‘Ukuphila engikuphilayo kalokhu enyameni ngikuphila ngokukholwa yiNdodana kaNkulunkulu, eyangithandayo, yazinikela ngenxa yami.’ Galathiya 2:20. Njengoba uJesu wathi kubafundi Bakhe, ‘Ngokuba akuyinina enikhulumayo kodwa uMoya kaYihlo okhuluma kini.’ Mathewu 10:20. Kanjalo ngoKristu osebenza kini nizobonakalisa umoya ofanayo nenze imisebenzi emihle ngokufanayo-imisebenzi yokulunga, nokulalela.

“Kanjalo akukho kithi esingazigabisa ngakho. Asinayo indawo yokuzikhukhumeza. Indawo yethembe lethu isekulungeni kukaKristu esabelwa kona, futhi lokhu kwenziwa ngoMoya Wakhe osebenza ngaphakathi nangathi.”-Steps to Christ, pp. 62, 63.

q.text: b. Noma iNkosi yenzile amalungiselelo abo bonke ukuba bazuze insindiso, kungani abanye belahlekelwa indlela-na?

note.text: “Esikhundleni sokukhulula umuntu ekulaleleni, ukukholwa, ukukholwa kuphela, okusenza sibe ngabahlanganyeli bomusa kaKristu, lowo osisizayo ukuba sinikele ukulalela.
