“Lokhu okubizwa ukukholwa kuKristu lokhu abaprofethi abakutshela abantu ngesibopho sokulalela uNkulunkulu, akukona ukukholwa, kodwa umcabango. Ngokuba ngomusa nisindisiwe ngokukholwa.’ Kanjalo-ke ‘nokukholwa, uma kungenayo imisebenzi, kufile ngokwakho.’ Efesu 2:8; Jakobe 2:17. UJesu uthi Ngaye ngaphambi kokuza Kwakhe emhlabeni, ‘Ngiyathanda ukwenza intando yakho, Nkulunkulu Wami, nomthetho Wakho usenhliziyweni yami.’ Amahubo 40:8. Ngaphambi kokuba ehlele futhi emhlabeni uthi.’ Mina ngcigcinile imiyalo kaBaba ngihlala othandweni lwakhe.’ Johane 15:10. Imibhalo ithi, ‘Ngalokho siyazi ukuthi siyamazi Yena, uma sigcina imiyalo Yakhe….Lowo othi uhlala Kuye, yena umele ukuhamba, njengalokho ahamba Yena.’ 1 Johane 2:3-6. ‘Ngokuba uKristu wahlushwa ngenxa yenu, enishiyela isibonelo sokuba nilandele ezinyathelweni zakhe.’ 1 Peter 2:21.”-Ibid., pp. 60-62.

q.text: a. Kungayiphi indlela umpostoli uPawule aphila ngokunqoba-na?

note.text: “Kufanele ugcine lokuhlangana noKristu ngokukholwa nokuzinikela okuqhubekayo ngentando yakho Kuye; njengoba uqhubeka ukwenza lokhu, uzosebenza kuwe ukuthanda nokwenza ngokuya ngokuhle okuthokozisa Yena.”-Steps to Christ, pp. 62, 63.

“UKristu ebuntwini Bakhe waphelelisa isimilo, futhi lesimilo ulangazela ukusabela sona. ‘Nokulunga kwethu konke kwakunjengengubo enindiweyo.’ Isaya 64:6. Konke esikwenza ngamandla ethu kungcoliswe yisono. Kodwa iNdodana kaNkulunkulu ‘yabonakaliswa ukuba isuse izono zethu; futhi akukho sono Kuyo.’ …UKristu walalela zonke izimfuno zomthetho. Uthi Ngaye, ‘Ngiyathanda ukwenza intando Yakho, Nkulunkulu Wami; Nomthetho wakho usenhliziyweni Yami.’ Amahubo 40:8…Ngokulalela okuphelele wenza kwaphumelela ukuthi wonke umuntu angabanakho ukulalela umthetho uNkulunkulu. Uma sithobela uKristu, inhliziyo ihlanganiswa nenhliziyo Yakhe, intando ihlanganiswa nentando Yakhe, ingqondo ibayinye nengqondo Yakhe, nemicabango ilethwa ngaphansi kobugqila Bakhe; siphila impilo Yakhe. Yilokhu okuchaza ukwembathiswa ngengubo yokulunga Kwakhe.”-Christ’s Object Lessons, pp. 311, 312.

q.text: b. Yinjabulo engakanani uMhlabeleli ayigcizelela ekuphileni kwakhe-na?

note.text: “Uma sikhuluma ngokukholwa, kufanele kubekhona umehluko ogcinwa engqondweni. Kukhona uhlobo lwenkolo oluhlukile ngempela ekukholweni. Ukubakhona kwamandla kaNkulunkulu, kuyiqiniso lezwi Lakhe, imicijo leyo ngisho noSathane nexuku lakhe abangasoze bakwenqaba ngenhliziyo. IBhayibheli lithi, ‘namademoni ayakholwa athuthumele;’ kodwa lokhu akukona ukukholwa. Jakobe 2:19. Lapho kungekho khona ukukholwa yizwi likaNkulunkulu, kodwa ukuthobela intando Yakhe; lapho inhliziyo izinikela Kuye, ukuthanda kugxiliswe phezu Kwakhe, kukhona ukukholwa-ukukholwa okusebenza ngothando nokuhlanza umphefumulo. Ngenxa yalokukholwa inhliziyo idalwa kabusha ngoko-mfanekiso kaNkulunkulu.”-Steps to Christ, p. 63.

reviewQuestions: 1. Chaza ubufakazi bokuphenduka.
2. Uyini umehluko phakathi komuntu omdala nomuntu omusha-na?
3. Chaza izingozi ezimbili okufanele zigwenywe ekuphileni kwethu kwesimoya.
4. Uma siphila ngaphansi komusa, iyini indawo yokulalela-na?
5. Iyiphi imicabango, izifiso, nokuqondiwe okuthokozelwayo uma uKristu ehlala enhliziyweni-na?

lessons.title: Ukukhula KuKristu
lessons.keyTextVerse: IVESI LEKHANDA: “Ngenze ukuba abalilayo eSiyoni baphiwe amaqhele esikhundleni somlotha, amafutha enjabulo esikhundleni sokulila, ingubo yokudumisa esikhundleni somoya odangeleyo, ukuze babizwe ngokuthi imithi yokulunga nokutshaliwe nguJehova ukuba adunyiswe”

keyText.text: IVESI LEKHANDA: “Ngenze ukuba abalilayo eSiyoni baphiwe amaqhele esikhundleni somlotha, amafutha enjabulo esikhundleni sokulila, ingubo yokudumisa esikhundleni somoya odangeleyo, ukuze babizwe ngokuthi imithi yokulunga nokutshaliwe nguJehova ukuba adunyiswe”

keyNote.text: “Weyame kuKristu kuphela, ukuze uphile ukuphila okungcwele, njengoba kunjalo ngegatsha esihlahleni esiyisiqu ukuze sikhule sithele izithelo.”- Steps to Christ, p. 69.

q.text: a. Kungayiphi indlela uMbhalo ufanekisa ukuthuthuka koMkrestu-na?

note.text: “Akusikho konke ukuhlakanipha kanye nekhono lomuntu okungaveza ekuphileni kwento encane kakhulu kwimvelo. Kungenxa yokuphila uNkulunkulu uQobo akunikezile, ukuthi isitshalo noma isilwane singaphila. Ngakho-ke kungenxa yokuphila okuvela kuNkulunkulu kuphela ukuthi ukuphila kwesimoya kungalethwa ezinhliziyweni zabantu.”-Steps to Christ, pp. 67.

q.text: b. Kuyini okufanekiswa nokweyama kwethu kuKristu ukuze sikhule futhi sithuthuke-na?

note.text: “Ngesipho esingelinganiswe seNdodana Yakhe, uNkulunkulu uhaqe umhlaba wonke ngomoya womusa ngempela njengomoya ozungeza umhlaba. Bonke abakhetha ukuphefumula lomoya onika-ukuphila bazophila futhi bakhule ngokomzimba babe ngabesilisa nabesifazane kuKristu Jesu.

“Njengezimbali eziphendukela elangeni, ukuthi imisebe ekhanyayo ingasiza ekupheleliseni ubuhle obulingene, nathi kufanele siphendukele kwiLanga Lokulunga, ukuze ukukhanya kungakhazimula phezu kwethu, ukuze izimilo zethu zingakhuliswa ekufaneni noKristu.”-Ibid., p. 68.

q.text: a. Uyini umcijo obalulekile iNkosi yethu eyawugcizelela kubafundi Bakhe ngaphambi kokuqeda umsebenzi Wakhe emhlabeni-na?

note.text: “Abaningi banomcabango wokuthi kumele benze inxenye ethize yomsebenzi bebodwa. Bathembela kuKristu ekuxolelweni kwesono, kodwa manje bafuna ngemizamo yabo ukuphila ngokuqondile. Kodwa yonke imizamo enjalo kumele yehluleke. UJesu uthi, ‘Ngaphandle Kwami ningenze lutho.’ Ukukhula kwethu emuseni, ukujabula kwethu, usizo lwethu-konke kweyame ebunyeni bethu noKristu. Kungenxa yobudlelwane bethu Naye imihla ngemihla, ihora nehora-ngokuhlala Kuye-ukuze sikhule emuseni. Akayena uMqalisi kuphela, kodwa noMphelelisi wokukholwa kwethu. UKristu ungowokuqala nowokugcina nangezikhathi zonke. Kufanele abenathi, kungesikho ekuqaleni kuphela kodwa nasekupheleni kohambo lwethu, nenyathelo ngalinye endleleni.”-Steps to Christ, p. 69.

“Uma uthanda ukufunda ubumnene nokuthobeka kwenhliziyo esikolweni sikaKristu, uZokunika ukuphumula nokuthula. Unzima kakhulu umshikashika wokushiya intando yakho nendlela yakho. Kodwa lesifundo esifundwayo, sizothola ukuphumula nokuthula. Ukuzigabisa, ubugovu, nenhloso kufanele kunqotshwe; intando yakho kufanele igwinywe yintando kaKristu. Ukuphila konke kungaba ukuthanda ukuzidela okuqhubekayo, sonke isenzo esibonakalayo, nalo lonke izwi eliphumayo lothando. Njengoba ukuphila komvini kujikeleza esiqwini nesithelo, kwehlele kwimithambo engezansi, kufinyelela egatsheni ngaphezulu, kanjalo umusa nothando lukaKristu oluvuthayo noluhlala emphefumulweni, lithumela kuzo zonke izinxenye zesitshalo, futhi kugcwalisa sonke isenzo somzimba nengqondo.”-The SDA Bible Commentary [E. G. White Comments], vol. 5, pp. 1091, 1092.

“Uzinikela kuNkulunkulu ukuba uphelele Kuye, ukumkhonza nokumlalela, nokwamukela uKristu njengoMsindisi wakho. Awusoze ngokwakho uhlangule izono zakho noma uguqule inhliziyo yakho; kodwa ngokuzinikela kuNkulunkulu, uyakholwa ukuthi Yena ngenxa kaKristu ukwenzile konke lokhu ngenxa yakho. Ngokukholwa ufana noKristu, ngokukholwa futhi kufanele ukhulele Kuye-ngokupha nangokwamukela. Kufanele unikele konke-inhliziyo yakho, intando yakho, umsebenzi wakho-zinikele Kuye ngokulalela zonke izimfuno Zakhe; futhi kufanele uthathe konke-uKristu, ukugcwala kwesibusiso sonke, kuhlale enhliziyweni yakho, ukuba abengamandla akho, ukulunga kwakho, umsizi wakho ongunaphakade-okunika amandla okulalela.”-Steps to Christ, pp. 69, 70.

q.text: a. Yimuphi umsebenzi wokuqala wabantwana bakaNkulunkulu njengoba beqala usuku ngalunye-na?

note.text: “Zihlukanisele uNkulunkulu ekuseni; yenza lokhu kube ngumsebenzi wakho wokuqala. Umkhuleko wakho mawuthi, Ngithathe, Nkosi, ngokuphelele Kuwe. Ngibeka wonke amacebo ami ezinyaweni Zakho.’ Lona ngumsebenzi wemihla ngemihla. Njalo ekuseni zihlukanisele kuNkulunkulu ngalolosuku. Nikela wonke amacebo akho Kuye, kufanele aphumelele noma anikelwe ekuhlinzekeleni Kwakhe ukuba awaqondise. Kanjalo imihla ngemihla uzobe unikela ukuphila kwakho ezandleni zikaNkulunkulu, ngakho-ke ukuphila kwakho kuzokwakhiwa njalo-njalo kulandele ukuphila kukaKristu.”-Steps to Christ, p. 70.

q.text: b. Yisiphi isimemo uKristu asinikeza nsuku zonke-na?

note.text: “Ukuphila kukaKristu ukuphila okunesizotha. Kungahle kungabikhona umuzwa wokwesasa, kodwa kufanele kubekhona okuhlalayo, ithemba elizothile. Ithemba lenu alikho kinina; kodwa likuKristu. Ubuthakathaka benu buhlanganiswa namandla Akhe, ukungazi kwenu kuhlanganiswe nokuhlakanipha Kwakhe, ukuntengantenga kwenu emandleni Akhe aqhubekayo. Kanjalo awufanele uzibheke, akufanele uvumele ingqondo ihlale phezu kukamina, kodwa bheka kuKristu. Vumela ingqondo ihlale othandweni Lwakhe, ebuhleni Bakhe, ekupheleleni Kwakhe, besimilo Sakhe. UKristu ekuzideleni Kwakhe, uKristu ekuthotshisweni Kwakhe, uKristu ekuhlanzekeni Kwakhe nobungcwele Bakhe, uthando lukaKristu olungelinganiswe-lesi isihloko sokuzindla komphefumulo. Kungenxa yokuMthanda, ukuMfanekisa, nokweyama ngokugcwele Kuye, ozoguqulwa ngayo ufane Naye.”-Ibid., pp. 70, 71.

q.text: c. Siyini isihluthulelo sokuthola amava okuthula kwengqondo-na?

note.text: “Labo abamukela uKristu ngokwezwi Lakhe, banikele ukuphila kwabo ekulondolozeni Kwakhe, izimpilo zabo ekulawulweni Nguye, bazothola ukuthula nesizotha. Akukho okomhlaba okuzobenza badabuke lapho uKristu ebenza bajabule ngobukhona Bakhe. Ngokuzithoba okuphelele kukhona ukuphumula okuphelele….ukuphila kwethu kungabonakala kuhlangahlangene; kodwa njengoba sizinikela kwiNduna Yomsebenzi ehlakaniphile, uzoletha umfanekiso wokuphila nesimilo esizoba yiso enkazimulweni Yakhe.
“NgoKristu singena ekuphumuleni, izulu liqala siselapha emhlabeni. Sisabela isimemo Sakhe esithi, Wozani, nifunde Kimi, kanjalo ngokuza siqala ukuphila okungunaphakade.”-The Desire of Ages, p. 331.

q.text: a. Uyini umphumela wokuvumela ingqondo ihlale kuJesu esikhundleni sokubheka umina-na?

note.text: “Ngokubheka njalo kuJesu ngeso lokukholwa, sizonikwa amandla. UNkulunkulu uzokwembula okuyigugu kakhulu kubantu Bakhe abalambile nabomile. Bazothola ukuthi unguMsindisi wabo. Njengoba bezondla ngezwi Lakhe, bazobona ukuthi lingumoya lingukuphila. Izwi libulala inyama, imvelo yomhlaba, linikeze ukuphila okusha ngoKristu Jesu. UMoya Ongcwele uza emphefumulweni njengoMduduzi. Ngesithunywa esiguqulayo somusa Wakhe, umfanekiso kaNkulunkulu udalwa kabusha kumfundi; uba yisidalwa esisha. Uthando luthatha indawo yenzondo, nenhliziyo yamukela ukufana okungcwele.”-The Desire of Ages, p. 391.

“Uma ingqondo izindla ngomina, iyaxoshwa isuke kuKristu, ongumthombo wamandla nokuphila. kulokhu kungumzamo kaSathane ongapheliyo ukugcina ukunaka kuphambukiswe kuMsindisi kanjalo uvimbela ukuhlangana nokuxhumana komphefumulo noKristu. Ukuzijabulisa komhlaba, ukunaka okwelizwe nokudideka nosizi, amaphutha abanye, noma amaphutha akho nokungalungi-noma kokuphi noma kukho konke uzofuna ukuguqula ingqondo. Ungaphambukiswa izinkohliso zakhe. Abaningi abanomthetho ngempela, nabafisa ukuphilela uNkulunkulu, nabo kaningi baholelwa ukuba bahlale emaphutheni nasebuthakathakeni babo, kanjalo ubahlukanisa noKrisu enethemba lokuzuza ukunqoba. Akufanele senze umina umthombo wokuzitika ngovalo nokwesaba ukuthi ingabe sizosindiswa. Konke lokhu kususa umphefumulo uxoshwe kuMthombo wamandla ethu. Sebenza ukugcina umphefumulo wakho kuNkulunkulu, umethembe Yena. Khuluma futhi ucabange ngoJesu. Vumela umina alahlekele Kuye.”-Steps to Christ, pp. 71, 72.

q.text: b. Kuyini esingayifunda ekuguqukeni okwafikela abafundi emva kokuba benoKristu emsebenzini wokuvangela nsuku zonke-na?

note.text: “Ngokubheka njalo [kuJesu], siyaguqulwa, sibe njengalowo-mfanekiso ngokuya enkazimulweni, njengalokhu kumi ngeNkosi enguMoya.’ 2 Korinte 3:18.

“Kwakunjalo nakubafundi basendulo abazuza ukufana noMsindisi wabo othandekayo. Lapho abafundi bezwa amazwi kaJesu, bezwa isidingo Sakhe. Bamfuna, bamthola, bamlandela. Babe-Naye endlini, etafuleni, ekamelweni, ensimini. Babe-Naye njengabafundi nothishela, nsuku zonke izifundo eziphuma ezindebeni Zakhe zeqiniso elingcwele. Babheka Kuye, njengezinceku zenkosi yabo, ukufunda umsebenzi wabo. Labo bafundi ‘izikhonzi ezifana nathi.’ Jakobe 5:17. Babelwa ngokufanayo nesono okumele balwe naso. Babedinga umusa ofanayo, ukuze baphile ukuphila okungcwele.”-Ibid., pp. 72, 73.

q.text: a. Yisiphi isithembiso esimangalisayo uJesu asishiyela abalandeli Bakhe ababhekene nezinselelo zomhlaba olwayo-na?

note.text: “Lapho uKristu enyukela eZulwini, umcabango wobukhona Bakhe ubulokhu unabalandeli Bakhe. Kungenxa yobukhona bakhe, begcwele uthando nokukhanya. UJesu, uMsindisi, owahamba wakhuluma wakhuleka nabo, owakhuluma ithemba nenduduzo ezinhliziyweni zabo, lapho, isigijimi sokuthula sisezindebe Zakhe, uthe wasuswa kubo wanyuselwa ezulwini, amazwi ephimbo Lakhe abuyele kubo, njengoba ifu lezingelosi liMamukela-‘Bhekani, mina nginani izinsuku zonke kuze kube sekupheleni kwezwe.’ Mathewu 28:20.”-Steps to Christ, pp. 73, 74.

q.text: b. Yimuphi umyalo obalulekile uJesu awushiyela abafundi Bakhe ukuze bazi ukuthi kuyini okumele bakwenze ngesikhathi sokuswela-na?

note.text: “Njengoba babehlangene ndawonye emva kokwenyuka Kwakhe babeshisekela ukuletha isicelo sabo kuBaba egameni likaJesu…belulela isandla sokukholwa ngaphezulu kakhulu ngempikiswano enamandla, ‘UKristu uJesu owafayo, yebo impela, owavuswa kwabafileyo, ongakwesokunene sikaNkulunkulu, nguYena osinxuselayo.’ Roma 8:34. I-Pentekoste yabalethela ubukhona boMduduzi, lowo uKristu athi Ngaye, uyakuba kini,’ waqhubeka futhi wathi, ‘Kunilungele ukuba Ngimuke: ngokuba uma ngingamuki, uMduduzi kayi kuza kini; kepha uma Ngimuka, ngiyakumthumela kini.’ Johane 14:17; 16:7. Emva kwalokhu ngoMoya, uKristu kwakufanele ahlale njalo ezinhliziyweni zabantwana Bakhe. Ukuhlangana kwabo Naye kwakusondele kakhulu kunesikhathi enabo ubuqu. Ukukhanya, nothando, namandla nokuhlala kukaKristu ngaphakathi kwabonakala kubo ngaphandle, ukuze abantu, babheke, ‘bamangala; baqonda, ukuthi kade benoJesu.’ Izenzo 4:13.”-Ibid., pp. 74, 75.

reviewQuestions: 1. Uma sikhula njengezitshalo, kungani sidinga usizo oluvela ezulwini-na?
2. Njengoba izitshalo zidinga izihlambi zemvula ukuze zikhule emoyeni-na?
3. Kuyini okwenza ukuzinikela nsuku zonke zibalulekile kithi ngabanye-na?
4. Kungani uNkulunkulu efisa ukuthi sikhiphe umina engqondweni futhi sicabange ngoJesu njalo-njalo-na?
5. Isiphi isithembiso okufanele sibe yiqiniso ekuphileni konke kwawo wonke okholwayo-na?

lessons.title: Umsebenzi Nokuphila
lessons.keyTextVerse: IVESI LEKHANDA: “Kepha bonke abamamukelayo wabapha amandla okuba babe-ngabantwana bakaNkulunkulu, labo abakholwa egameni Lakhe”

keyText.text: IVESI LEKHANDA: “Kepha bonke abamamukelayo wabapha amandla okuba babe-ngabantwana bakaNkulunkulu, labo abakholwa egameni Lakhe”

keyNote.text: “Umoya kaKrisu wothando lokuzidela ungumoya ogcwalisa izulu futhi uyingqikithi yentokozo yalo. Lona umoya abalandeli bakaKristu abazoba nawo, umsebenzi abazowenza.”-Steps to Christ, p. 77.

q.text: a. Kuyini okunganakwa yinhliziyo yemvelo-futhi ngamuphi umphumela-na?

note.text: “UNkulunkulu ungumthombo wokuphila nokukhanya nenjabulo ezulwini nasemhlabeni. Njengemisebe yokukhanya evela elangeni, njengemifula yamanzi ibhobhoka emthonjeni wokuphila, izibusiso ezigeleza zivela Kuye nakuzo zonke izidalwa Zakhe. Lapho ukuphila kukaNkulunkulu kusenhliziyweni yabantu, kuzogelezela kwabanye ngothando nesibusiso.”-Steps to Christ, p. 77.

q.text: b. Lapho uthando lukaKristu lulondozwa enhliziyweni, kuyini okuzobonakala ekuphileni-na?

note.text: “Lapho uthando lukaKristu lungcweliswa enhliziyweni, njengephunga elimnandi elingeke lafihlakala. Umfutho wawo uzozwakala kubo bonke esixhumana nabo. UMoya kaKristu enhliziyweni ufana nomfula ehlane, ogelezela ukuqabula bonke wenze nalabo abalungele ukufa, bazimisele ukuphuza amanzi okuphila.”-Ibid., p. 77.

“Vumela umhlaba ubone ukuthi anigwinyangwa ubugovu bobumnandi, kodwa ukuthi nifisa abanye bahlanganyele izibusiso zethu namalungelo. Bavumele babone ukuthi inkolo ayisenzi singabi nozwelo noma sibacindezele. Vumela bonke abafakazela ukuthi bamtholile uKristu, bafundise njengaYe ukusiza abantu.”-The Desire of Ages, p. 152.

q.text: a. Uma samukela uJesu njengoMsindisi wethu, yisiphi Isidingo esinikezwayo-na?

note.text: “Labo abangabahlanganyeli bomusa kaKristu bazolungela ukwenza noma yikuphi ukuzidela, ukuze abanye athe wabafela bangabelana nesipho sezulu. Bazokwenza konke abangakwenza ukuba umhlaba ube yindawo engcono yokuhlala kuwo. Lomoya ungumphumela oqinisekile womphefumulo ophenduke ngempela. Ngokushesha nje lapho umuntu eza kuKristu kuba ukutshalwa enhliziyweni yakhe isifiso sokwazisa abanye ngalokho umhlobo oligugu amfumene kuJesu; iqiniso elisindisayo nelingcwelisayo angeke lavalelwa enhliziyweni yakhe. Uma sembathiswe ukulunga kukaKrisu futhi sigcwaliswe ngenjabulo yokuhlala koMoya Wakhe ngaphakathi angeke sagcina ukuthula kwethu. Uma sithe sanambitha futhi sabona ukuthi iNkosi yinhle sizoba nokuthile esizokusho. Njengo-Filiphu lapho efumana uMsindisi, sizomemela abanye ebukhoneni Bakhe.”-Steps to Christ, p. 78.

q.text: b. Uma sibhekene nezinkinga nobunzima, yisiphi iseluleko sompostoli uPawule-na?

note.text: “UJesu wazi izidingo ezifunwa abantwana Bakhe, futhi uyathanda ukulalela imikhuleko yabo. Vumela abantwana bavalelwe ngaphandle komhlaba kunoma yikuphi okuthathekisa imicabango yabo isuke kuNkulunkulu, mabezwe ukuthi babodwa noNkulunkulu, nokuthi amehlo Akhe abheka ingaphakathi lenhliziyo, afunde izifiso zomphefumulo, nokuthi bangakhuluma noNkulunkulu.”-Sons and Daughters of God, p. 121.

q.text: c. Lapho siphenduka umntwana kaNkulunkulu, kuyini esikukweleta abanye-na?

note.text: “Kungamuphi umcabango uPawule ubenesikweletu kumaJuda nakumaGreki-na? Kuye unikeziwe uthumo, njengoba lunikezwe wonke umfundi kaKristu, ‘Hambani, nishumayele ezizweni zonke, nibabhapathize egameni likaYise, neleNdodana, nelikaMoya Ongcwele; nibafundise ukugcina konke enginiyale ngakho: bhekani, mina nginani izinsuku zonke kuze kube sekupheleni kwezwe.’ Ngokwamukela uKristu, uPawule wamukela loluthumo. Waqonda ukuthi phezu kwakhe isibopho sokusebenzela zonke izigaba zabantu-kumaJuda namaGreki, abafundile nabangenalwazi, labo abasezikhundleni eziphakeme nalabo abaphansi kuyo yonke indima yempilo.”-The SDA Bible Commentary [E. G. White Comments], vol. 6, p. 1067.

q.text: a. Uma uMoya Ongcwele usenhliziyweni yethu, zizoba yini izenzo zethu zokuqala-na?

note.text: “Sizofuna ukuletha [kwabanye] ukuthathekisa kukaKristu nezinto ngempela ezingabonwa zomhlaba ozayo. Kuzobakhona isifiso esikhulu sokulandela endleleni eyahanjwa nguJesu. Kuzobakhona ukulangazela ngenkuthalo ukuthi labo abasizungezile banga ‘bheka iWundlu likaNkulunkulu, elisusa izono zezwe.’ Johane 1:29.

“Umzamo wokubusisa abanye uzobuyisela izibusiso phezu kwethu. Lena inhloso kaNkulunkulu yokusinika inxenye esingayenza kwicebo lensindiso. Unikile abantu ilungelo lokuba ngabahlanganyeli bemvelo engcwele futhi, kamuva, bahlakaze izibusiso kubangane babo. Lena inhlonipho ephakeme, injabulo enkulu, yokuthi kungenzeka kuNkulunkulu ukukubeka phezu kwabantu. Labo ababa ngabahlanganyeli ekusebenzeni ngothando basondezwa eduze noMdali.

“UNkulunkulu ngabe wanikeza isigijimi sevangeli, nomsebenzi wonke wokuthanda ukufundisa, kwizingelosi zezulu. Ngabe wasebenzisa ezinye izindlela zokuphelelisa inhloso Yakhe. Kodwa ngothando Lwakhe olungapheli wakhetha ukusenza abasizana Naye, noKristu nezingelosi, ukuze sabelane nesibusiso, injabulo, ukuphakanyiswa kwesimoya, umphumela walokho umsebenzi wokufundisa ngokuzidela.

“Silethwa ekuzwelaneni noKristu ngokuhlanganyela ezinhluphekweni Zakhe. Isenzo ngasinye sokuzidela ngobuhle babanye sinikeza amandla umoya wokuphana enhliziyweni yalowo ophanayo, ngokuhlanganyela kakhulu eduze noMhlengi welizwe, lowo, nakuba ecebile, kodwa ngenxa yenu….waba ngompofu, ukuze ngobumpofu Bakhe nicebe nina.’ 2 Korinte 8:9. Futhi kungalendlela kuphela esiphelelisa inhloso engcwele yokudalwa kwethu ukuthi ukuphila kungaba isibusiso kithi.”-Steps to Christ, pp. 78-80.

q.text: b. Yisiphi isibonelo sikaKristu okufanele sisiqondise ebudllelwaneni bethu nezihlobo kanye nomakhelwane-na?

note.text: “Uma uzophuma usebenze njengokuhlela kukaKristu ukuthi abafundi bazosebenza, bazuzele imiphefumulo Kuye, uzokuzwa isidingo samava ajulile nolwazi olukhulu lwezinto ezingcwele, futhi uzolambela womele ukulunga. Uzoncenga uNkulunkulu, nokukholwa kwakho kuzoqiniswa, nomphefumulo wakho uzophuza ngokujulile amanzi emthonjeni wensindiso. Lapho ubhekana nabamelana nawe nezilingo zizokuholela eBhayibhelini nasemkhulekweni. Uzokhula emseni naselwazini lukaKristu, futhi uzokhulisa amava anothile.”-Ibid., p. 80.

q.text: a. Yisho ingozi eyodwa enkulu kithina njengamalunga ebandla namuhla.

note.text: “Namuhla [AmaAdventist agcina usuku lweSabatha’] ingozi enkulu ukwandisa ingcebo yabo. Abanye bayaqhubeka ukunaka okwabo nemisebenzi yabo; bayazikhandla. Umphumela ukuthi, uNkulunkulu nezimfuno zendlela Yakhe bayazikhohlwa; bafile ngokwesimoya. Kufanele benze umhlatshelo kuNkulunkulu, ngomnikelo. Umhlatshelo awukhuli, endaweni yalokho uyancipha futhi uyadliwa….Imali eningi phakathi kwabantu bakithi ifakazela ingozi kulabo ababambelela kuyo.”-Testimonies for the Church, vol. 1, p. 492.

q.text: b. Yiziphi izimfanelo ezinhle zobuKrestu ezisiza amakholwa akhule emseni naselwazini lweNkosi uJesu Kristu-na? 1 Peter 4:8-10;

note.text: “Amathuba anikezwa uAbrahama noLoti asenqatshelwanga wona. Ngokubonisa ukwamukela izihambi kubantwana bakaNkulunkulu nathi, futhi, singangenisa izingelosi Zakhe ezindlini zethu. Ngisho nasosukwini lwethu, izingelosi ngesimo somuntu ziyangena ezindlini zabantu futhi zamukelwa yibo. Futhi amaKrestu aphila ekukhanyeni kobuso bukaNkulunkulu kaningi ahamba nezingelosi ezingabonwa, futhi lezidalwa ezingcwele zishiya ngasemuva isibusiso ezindlini zethu.”-Ibid., vol. 6, p. 342.

q.text: c. Yisiphi isidingo okufanele sigcwaliswe amakholwa namuhla-na?

note.text: “Amalunga amabandla ethu angaphelelisa umsebenzi lowo, nokho, abakawuqali ngempela. Makungabikho noyedwa oya endaweni entsha ngenxa yamathuba elizwe; kodwa lapho kungavuleka indawo yomsebenzi wokuphila, makuthi imikhaya efundiswe kahle ngeqiniso, izongena umuzi owodwa noma emibili esikhundleni, ukusebenza njengabahambisi bevangeli. Kufanele baluzwe uthando lwemiphefumulo, umthwalo wokuyisebenzela, futhi bazokwenza imfundo yokuthi bangayiletha kanjani eqinisweni. Bangahambisa amapheshana, babambe imihlangano emakhayeni abo, bajwayelane nomakhelwano babo, babameme ukuba beze kulemihlangano. Kanjalo bangavumela ukukhanya kwabo kukhazimule ngemisebenzi emihle.”-Testimonies for the Church, vol. 8, p. 245.

“Kuyisikhathi eside uNkulunkulu elindele umoya wokusebenza ukuba uthathe indawo yebandla lonke ukuze wonke umuntu amsebenzele ngokuya ngokwekhono lakhe. Lapho amalunga ebandla likaNkulunkulu enza umsebenzi abanikwe wona kumasimu adingayo ekhaya nakude, ekupheleliseni uthumo lwevangeli, umhlaba wonke masinyane uzoxwayiswa neNkosi uJesu izobuya kulomhlaba ngamandla nangenkazimulo enkulu.”-The Acts of the Apostles, p. 111.

q.text: a. Kuyini okulindeleke kubo bonke abaphathiswe iVangeli-ikakukhulukazi izisebenzi-na?

note.text: “Kuyilungelo lomlindi ezindongeni zaseSiyoni ukuphila eduze kakhulu noNkulunkulu, nokuvumela ukucindezela koMoya Wakhe, ukuthi ungasebenza ngabo ukuba batshele izoni ngengozi yabo, babakhombise indawo yokuphepha. Abakhethwe uNkulunkulu, bephawulwe ngegazi lokuzahlukanisa, kufanele basindise abesilisa nabesifazane ekubhujisweni okulindelwe. Ngokwethembeka kufanele baxwayise abahlobo babo ngomphumela ngempela wokweqa umthetho, ngokuthembeka futhi kufanele balondoloze intakazelelo yebandla.”-Gospel Workers, p. 15.

q.text: b. Isiphi isibonelo uDaniyeli asibekele abasha namuhla-na?

note.text: “INkosi izovuma ukuba sifunde isifundo esivela kumava kaDaniyeli. Kukhona abaningi abangaba abantu abanamandla njengalomHeberu othembekile abangeyama kuNkulunkulu ngomusa ukuba ngabanqobi, ngenxa yamandla okweneliseka emsebenzini wabo. UDaniyeli wembula kakhulu ubumnene obuphelele, kubadala bakhe kanye nabasha. Wema njengofakazi kaNkulunkulu, futhi wafuna ukuthatha indlela yokuthi angabi namahloni ngenxa yezulu ukulalela amazwi akhe noma abheke imisebenzi yakhe. Lapho uDaniyeli ecelwa ukuba ahlanganyele ekudleni okunothile etafuleni lenkosi, akazange aphakamise inkanuko, akazange agcizelele ukuzimisela ukudla noma aphuze ngokuthanda. Ngaphandle kokukhuluma izwi elilodwa lokweyisa, wayisa indaba kuNkulunkulu. Yena nabangane bakhe bafuna ukuhlakanipha okuvela eNkosini, uma besondela ngomkhuleko ophikelelayo isinqumo sabo senziwa. Ngesibindi seqiniso nobumnene bobuKrestu, uDaniyeli waletha indaba kumphathi obaphethe, wacela ukuthi banikwe ukudla okulula. Labasha bezwa ukuthi izimiso zenkolo yabo zisengcupheni, beyama kuNkulunkuklu, lowo abamthandayo nabamkhonzayo.”-Testimonies to Ministers, p. 263.

reviewQuestions: 1. Yisiphi isimo somhlaba esenza kudingeke kuNkulunkulu ukuhlakaza ukukhanya kuwo-na?
2. Iyiphi inguquko emangalisayo ezobonakala ekuphileni kwamakholwa-na?
3. Lapho isibusiso samukelwa, kufanele ibeyini impendulo-na?
4. Chaza ezinye izindlela ngamunye wethu esingasebenzela ngazo abanye.
5. Kungayiphi indlela ukuthembeka kukaDaniyeli kungikhuthaza-na?

lessons.title: Ulwazi NgoNkulunkulu
lessons.keyTextVerse: IVESI LEKHANDA: “Ohlakaniphileyo makaqaphele lokhu; bayakuqonda umusa kaJehova”

keyText.text: IVESI LEKHANDA: “Ohlakaniphileyo makaqaphele lokhu; bayakuqonda umusa kaJehova”

keyNote.text: “Ukuba nolwazi ngoNkulunkulu lonke ulwazi lweqiniso nentuthuko yangempela zinemisuka yakhona.”-Education, p. 14.

q.text: a. Yiziphi izinto kulomhlaba iNkosi efuna ukudonsela abantu Kuyo-na?

note.text: “Ziningi izindlela uNkulunkulu afuna ukuSazisa zona ngokusiletha ebudlelwaneni Naye. Imvelo ikhuluma ngemizwa yethu ingaphumuli. Inhliziyo evulekile izocindezelwa ngothando nenkazimulo kaNkulunkulu njengoba yembuliwe ngemisebenzi yezandla Zakhe. Indlebe ezwayo izoqonda ubudlelwano bukaNkulunkulu ngezinto zemvelo. Amasimu aluhlaza, izihlahla ezinde, izimfumba zezimbali, amafu adlulayo, imvula enethayo, nemithombo exokozayo, nobukhazikhazi bamazulu, zikhuluma enhliziyweni yethu, ziyasimema ukuba sijwayelane Naye odale konke.”-Steps to Christ, p. 85.

q.text: b. Kuyini uJesu akusebenzisa ukugxilisa iqiniso ezingqondweni zabalaleli Bakhe-na?

note.text: “UMsindisi wethu uhlanganisa izifundo eziyigugu nezinto zemvelo. Izihlahla, izinyoni, izimbali zemihosha, izintaba, iziziba, namazulu amahle, kanye nezehlakalo nokusizungezile imihla yokuphila kwethu, zonke zihlanganiswa ngamazwi eqiniso, ukuze izifundo Zakhe zingabuyiswa njalo engqondweni, ngisho naphakathi kokunaka okumatasatasa komshikashika wokuphila komuntu.
“UNkulunkulu uzovumela abantwana Bakhe ukuba bathokozela imisebenzi Yakhe bajabulele ubulula, ubuhle obuzothile ahlobise ngabo ikhaya lethu lasemhlabeni.”-Ibid.

q.text: a. Yisiphi isifundo esingafundwa kwimvelo-ngesibonelo sezimbali, esezinyoni, kanye nezinkanyezi-na?

note.text: “Uma sifunda isayensi…kufanele sithole ulwazi loMdali. Isayensi yangempela kungukuchazwa kombhalo kaNkulunkulu ezintweni zomhlaba. Isayensi iletha ucwaningo lobufakazi obusha kuphela bokuhlakanipha namandla kaNkulunkulu. Kuqondwa kahle, kokubili incwadi yemvelo nezwi elilotshiwe kusenza sijwayelane noNkulunkulu ngokusifundisa okuthize ngolwazi nemithetho esizayo leyo asebenza Ngayo.”-Patriachs and Prophets, p. 599.

“Uma singalalela kuphela, imisebenzi yendalo kaNkulunkulu izosifundisa izifundo eziyigugu zokulalela nethemba. Ukusuka ezinkanyezini emsebenzini wazo ongenandlela emkhathini ukusuka esikhathini esidlule ukuya esikhathini esizayo endleleni ekhonjiwe, ukwehlela phansi entweni encane, izinto zemvelo zilalela intando yoMdali. Nokuthi uNkulunkulu unaka yonke into futhi aqinise lokhu akudalileyo.”-Steps to Christ, p. 85., 86.

q.text: b. Uma sicabanga ngobuhle nokuthula kwemvelo engangcoliswanga, kuyini okufanele kukhumjulwe ngomhlaba omusha othenjisiwe-na?

note.text: “Vumela umcabango wakho ubone ikhaya labasindisiwe, ukhumbule ukuthi uzokhazimula kakhulu kunombono wakho okhazimulayo ongawufanekisa. Ngezipho zikaNkulunkulu ezahlukahlukene zemvelo sibona kancane ubukhazikhazi benkazimulo Yakhe.”-Ibid., pp. 86, 87.

“Ibandla likaNkulunkulu lithe lanikezwa izambulo zenhloso kaJehova engunaphakade. Abantu Bakhe bathe bavunyelwa ukubheka ngaphesheya kwezilingo zanamuhla ukuya ekunqobeni kwesikhathi esizayo, lapho, impi isiphalile, abahlengiwe bazongena ezweni lesithembiso. Imibono yenkazimulo ezayo, izehlakalo ezifanekiswa yisandla sikaNkulunkulu, kufanele zithandeke ebandleni Lakhe namuhla.”-Prophets and Kings, p. 722.

“EBhaybhelini ifa labasindisiwe libizwa ngokuthi ‘ilizwe.’ Heberu 11:14-16. Lapho uMalusi ezulwini eholela umhlambi Wakhe kumfula wamanzi okuphila. Umuthi wokuphila othela isithelo sawo inyanga nenyanga, namaqabunga omuthi angawokuphulukisa izizwe. Kukhona imifula ephuphumayo njalo-njalo, ucwebezela njengekristalu, futhi eduze kwawo kukhona imithi eletha ithunzi endleleni elungiselwe abahlengiwe beNkosi. Lapho amathafa ahlakazekile akhukhumala aba ngamagquma amahle, nezintaba zikaNkulunkulu ziphakamisa ukuzithoba kwazo okuphakeme. Kulawo mathafa anokuthula, ngaphandle kwemifudlana ephilayo, abantu bakaNkulunkulu, isikhathi eside beyizihambi nemihambuma, bazothola ikhaya.”-The Great Controversy, p. 675.

q.text: a. Yiziphi izifundo eziyigugu ezingafundwa kubaprofethi ukuze zisikhuthaze ezikhathini zokudangala kanye nokulingwa-na?

note.text: “Kwizimeko zethu nalokhu okusizungezile, izinguquko ezibonakalayo nsuku zonke phambi kwethu, singathola izifundo eziyigugu uma izinhliziyo zethu zivulelwa ukuzehlukanisa…[ku-Patriachs and Prophets] abantu ‘isikhonzi esinesifiso njengathi,’ Jakobe 5:17. Siyabona ukuthi bahlupheka kanjani ekudumaleni njengathi, nokuthi bawela kanjani ngaphansi kwezilingo njengathi, nokho bavuka futhi banqoba ngomusa kaNkulunkulu; futhi, ngokubheka, siyakhuthazwa kumzamo wethu wokufuna ukulunga.”-Steps to Christ, pp. 87, 88.

q.text: b. Uma uNkulunkulu enakekela okwemvelo, kakhulu kangakanani kubantwana Bakhe-na?

note.text: “Imvelo nesambulo ngokufanayo kufakazela uthando lukaNkulunkulu. UBaba wethu osezulwini ungumthombo wokuphila, wokuhlakanipha, nowenjabulo. Bheka okumangalisayo ezintweni ezinhle zemvelo. Cabanga ngenguquko emangalisayo kodingayo nenjabulo, kungesiye umuntu kuphela, kodwa kuzo zonke izidalwa eziphilayo. Ukukhanya kwelanga nemvula, okujabulisa kuqabule umhlaba, izintaba nolwandle namathafa, konke kukhuluma kithi uthando loMdali.”-Ibid., p. 9.

q.text: c. Kukuphi lapho isithembiso sokunakekela kukaNkulunkulu okufanele sisiholele ekugxileni kukho-na?

note.text: “Uma samukela ezandleni zethu ukuphatha izinto okufanele sizenze, futhi seyame kokwethu ukuhlakanipha ukuze siphumelele, samukela umthwalo uNkulunkulu angasinikanga wona, futhi sizama ukuwuthwala ngaphandle kosizo Lwakhe. Samukela phezu kwethu ukuziphendulela lokhu okungoka-Nkulunkulu, kanjalo sizibeka ngokwethu impela endaweni Yakhe. Singaba nokukhathazeka ngengozi engabekezeleki nokulahlekelwa, ngeqiniso kuzowela phezu kwethu. Kodwa uma sikholwa ngempela ukuthi uNkulunkulu uyasithanda nokuthi usicabangela okuhle sizoyeka ukukhathazeka ngekusasa. Sizomethemba njengomntwana othemba umzali onothando. Besekuthi izinkinga zethu nokuhlupheka kuzonyamalala, ngoba intando yethu igwinywe yintando kaNkulunkulu.”-Thoughts from the Mount of Blessings, pp. 100, 101.

q.text: a. Kukuphil lapho uKristu ebeka khona izambulo ezicacile zecebo likaNkulunkulu lokusindisa abantu-na?

note.text: “UNkulunkulu ukhuluma nathi ngezwi Lakhe. Lapha sinomugqa osobala wesambulo sesimilo Sakhe, izenzo Zakhe aphatha ngazo abantu, nomsebenzi omkhulu wokuhlenga.”-Steps to Christ, p. 87.

q.text: b. Kuyini okufanele kwenziwa nsuku zonke yibo bonke abafisa ukukhula ekuqineni nasemandleni kaNkulunkulu-na?

note.text: “Isihloko sendaba yokuhlengwa yileso izingelosi ezifisa ukuyibheka; izoba isayensi nengoma yabahlengiwe ezohlatshelelwa iminyaka engapheli ingunaphakade. Akufanele yini ucabange ngokunakekela nangemfundo manje-na? Umusa ongunaphakade nothando lukaJesu, umhlatshelo owenziwe ngenxa yethu, udinga ukubuyiswa okunzima kakhulu nokunesizotha. Kufanele sigxile kwisimilo soMhlengi wethu othandekayo noMlamuli. Kufanele sizindle ngomsebenzi Wakhe owenzayo ukusindisa abantu Bakhe ezonweni zabo.”-Ibid., pp. 88, 89.

q.text: c. Kungayiphi indlela okumele samukele ngayo izwi likaNkulunkulu ezinhliziyweni zethu-na?

note.text: “Akukho noyedwa onomoya wokuthokozela imfundiso yalo ongafunda umusho owodwa eBhayibhelini ngaphandle kokuzuza okuthize okuzosiza umcabango. Kodwa imfundo ebalulekile kakhulu eBhaybhelini akufanele izuzwe ngezinye izikhathi noma ihlolwe ngokungahlangene. Uhlelo olukhulu lweqiniso alilethwanga ukuba lihlukaniswe ngokushesha nokufunda ngobudlabha. Ingcebo yalo eningi ihlezi ekujuleni okukhulu, futhi ingatholakala kuphela ngokuhlola ngokukhuthala nangomzamo oqhubekela phambili. Amaqiniso enza konke kuphelele kufanele ahlolisiswe futhi ahlanganiswe, ‘lapha ingcosana, nalapho ingcosana.’ Isaya 28:10.

“Uma iqiniso usulihlolile walihlanganisa, lizotholakala lilingene ngokuphelele elinye kwelinye. IVangeli ngalinye lengeza amanye, sonke isiprofetho sichasisa esinye, lonke iqiniso likhulela kwelinye iqiniso. Imifanekiso yohlelo lwamaJuda lwenziwe lwakhanya ngenxa yevangeli. Sonke isimiso esisezwini likaNkulunkulu sinendawo yaso, wonke umcijo uthela isithelo. Nesakhiwo esiphelele, ngokuqonda nesenzo, kuthwele ubufakazi boMqambi waso. Isakhiwo esinjalo akukho mqondo kuphela Lowo Ongapheli ongakwazi ukucabanga noma ukulungisa.”-Education, pp. 123, 124.

q.text: a. Kuyini okwaletha induduzo nosizo kuJeremiya ngesikhathi sosizi lwakhe-na?

note.text: “Akukho okulinganiswe ngempela okuqinisa ulwazi kunokuhlolwa kweMibhalo. Ayikho enye incwadi enamandla amakhulu okukhulisa imicabango, nokunika ukuqina emandleni, njengobubanzi, bamaqiniso akhulisayo eBhayibheli. Uma izwi likaNkulunkulu belifundwa njengoba kufanele, abantu bebezoba nokuqonda okubanzi, isimilo esithobekile, nokusimama kwenhloso ebonakala ingavamile namuhla.”-Steps to Christ, p. 90.

“Lowo onikela ngothando iMibhalo, ukunaka ngokukhuleka uzozuza ukuqonda okukhanyayo nokwahlulela okuzwakalayo, kungathi ngokuphendukela kuNkulunkulu ufinyelele kwizinga eliphakeme ngokomqondo.”-Mind, Character, and Personality, vol. 1, p. 95.

q.text: b. Kungayiphi indlela iMibhalo kufanele ihlolwe ngayo nokuthi kuyini okumele kwandulele ukuhlola iBhaybheli-na?

note.text: “Iqiniso likaNkulunkulu, njengegolide, kaniningi alitholakali lihlezi phezu komhlaba; litholakala kuphela ngomcabango okhuthele nokufunda.”-Gospel Workers, p. 76.

“Njengalowo osebenza emgodini ethola izinxenye zensimbi eziyigugu zigqitshwe ngaphansi komhlaba, kanjalo angeke afune nobekezela ekuhloleni izwi likaNkulunkulu njengengcebo efihliwe ethola amaqiniso anenani elikhulu, lawo afihlakele kumbono wofuna ngobudlabha. Amazwi aphefumulelwe, azindla enhliziyweni, azofana nemifula egelezayo evela kumthombo wokuphila.

“IBhayibheli akufanele lifundwe ngaphandle komkhuleko. Ngaphambi kokuvula amakhasi alo kufanele sifunde ukukhanyiselwa nguMoya Ongcwele, futhi sizowuphiwa…Izingelosi ezivela kumhlaba wokukhanya zizoba nalabo abazithoba ngenhliziyo befuna ukuqondiswa okungcwele.”-Steps to Christ, p. 91.

reviewQuestions: 1. Iyiphi indlela yokufundisa eyasetshenziswa uMsindisi wethu ukufinyelela ebantwini-na?
2. Malungiselelo mani uNkulunkulu awenzile ukuze aziBonakalise kubo bonke-kuhlanganisa nalabo abangakwazi ukufinyelela eZwini likaNkulunkulu-na?
3. Kuyini okungafundwa ngokuhlinzekela kukaNkulunkulu-na?
4. Chaza isimo sengqondo okufanele sibenaso ngeBhayibheli njengesambulo sikaNkulunkulu.
5. Mava mani kaJeremiya maqondana nombhalo okufanele aphindwe-na?

fso.title: Umnikelo weSabatha Lokuqala
fso.subtitle: Bible Missionary Training School in the Philippines

paragraph.text: “Njengoba sikhunjuzwa ngothumo olukhulu lokuya emhlabeni wonke senze abafundi, kufanele senze okuthize. IBible Missionary Training School isikhungo esinikelwe ekulungisweni nokuhlomisa izisebenzi zensimu yeNkosi. Solokhu samiswa ngoNhlolanja-1984, lesikolo sibe isikhonkwane sokholo, esibumba izinhliziyo nezingqondo zalabo abashisekela ukuhambisa ivangeli ezizweni zonke. Abafundi abaningi abaqede iminyaka emibili yohlelo lokufunda kulesikhungo baphenduke baba abavangeli baphesheya kwezilwandle, abanye bangabaholi nabafundisi abahambisa ivangeli emazweni anabantu abaningi eziqhingini zase-Philipines.

“Sakhiwe eCabatang, Tiaong, Quezon Province, Phillipines, iBible Training School isebenza ngamandla ukunikeza isisekelo seBhayibheli esiqinile ukukhuthaza abavangeli basePhillipines nakulo lonke lePacific Region. Lesikhungo sinikela indawo yokuhlala abafundi, ukufunda isiNgisi nokuqeqeshelwa ukuba ngabavangeli, abathengisi bezincwadi, izisebenzi zezempilo kanye nabaphathi abadingeka kakhulu kulelizwe nakumazwe aphesheya kwezilwandle. Lesikhungo sisebeza futhi ukufundisa ngamaSeminar, amaYouth Conventions, nemihlangano ingabanjelwa kulendawo.

Njengoba umsebenzi wemvuselelo uthe wasabalala endaweni yonke yasePhillipines, ukwengezwa nokuthuthukisa lesikhungo kudingeka kakhulu ukuze siqhubeke ukusebenza izidingo zomsebenzi kaNkulunkulu ukuya phambili. Njengoba sazi ngalezidingo, amacebo asendleleni okubamba ingqunguthela yeGeneral Conference khona manje kuso lesikhungo. Yisibusiso esinjani ukubamba lomhlangano wabakholwayo, lapho kukhona imibono yevangeli nemvuselelo yesimoya ezothatha indawo lapha!

“Umusa wenu kuMnikelo wesiKolo seSabatha namuhla uzoba ithulusi kwisakhiwo esidingeka kakhulu kulesikhungo. Njengoba sipha, masikhumbule amazwi atholakala ku 2 Korinte 9:7, “Yilowo nalowo anikele njengalokho azikhethele khona enhliziyweni, kungabi ngokudabuka nangokucindezelwa: ngokuba uNkulunkulu uyamthanda onikelayo ethokoza.”

“Kwangathi izipho zenu zokukhulisa lesikolo, nokunika amandla umsebenzi waso, nokuletha izisebenzi zilungele ukumemezela ivangeli elingunaphakade. Masinikele ngokukholwa nenjabulo, nokwazi ukuthi iminikelo yethu izoletha izithelo ezingunaphakade embusweni kaNkulunkulu.
“Ngiyabonga, kwangathi iNkosi inganibusisa kakhulu njengoba ninikela!

lessons.title: Ilungelo Lomkhuleko
lessons.keyTextVerse: “IVESI LEKHANDA: “Kepha wena, nxa ukhuleka, ngena ekamelweni lakho, uthi usuvale umnyango wakho ukhuleke kuYihlo osekusithekeni; noyihlo obona ekusithekeni uzakukuvuza”

keyText.text: “IVESI LEKHANDA: “Kepha wena, nxa ukhuleka, ngena ekamelweni lakho, uthi usuvale umnyango wakho ukhuleke kuYihlo osekusithekeni; noyihlo obona ekusithekeni uzakukuvuza”

keyNote.text: “Umkhuleko ungukuvulela inhliziyo kuNkulunkulu njengomngani. Kungesikho ukuthi kudingekile ukuba simazise uNkulunkulu lokhu esiyikho, kodwa ukuze sikwazi ukumamukela. UMkhuleko awehliseli uNkulunkulu kithi, kodwa umkhuleko usikhuphulela Kuye.”-Steps to Christ, p, 93.

q.text: a. Njenge-Ndodana yomuntu, kuyini uJesu akubona kudingekile-na?

note.text: “Bheka iNdodana kaNkulunkulu iguqile ikhuleka kuYise! Noma eyiNdodana kaNkulunkulu, wayeqinisa ukholo Lwakhe ngomkhuleko, nobudlelwano neZulu ehlanganisa amandla Akhe okumelana nobubi nokusiza izidingo zabantu. NjengoBhuti wethu Omdala wesizwe sethu, uyazazi izinswelo zalabo, abazungezwe ukugula nabaphila emhlabeni wesono nezilingo, nokho belangazela ukumsebenzela. Uyazi ukuthi izithunywa abona zifanele ukuba angazithuma zibuthakathaka, abantu abonayo; kodwa bonke abazinikela ngokuphelele emsebenzini Wakhe ubathembise usizo olungcwele. Isibonelo Sakhe yisiqiniseko sokuthi ukunxusa ngobuqotho, nokubekezela kuNkulunkulu ngokukholwa-ukukholwa okuholela ekweyameni ngokuphelele kuNkulunkulu, nokuzinikela ngokuphelele emsebenzini Wakhe-lapho ehlose ukuletha ebantwini usizo loMoya Ongcwele empini yokumelana nesono.”-Gospel Workers, p, 511.

q.text: b. Ngeyiphi indlela kaKristu yokukhuleka eyisibonelo kithi-na? Marako 1:35;

note.text: “UJesu uQobo, ngesikhathi ehlala phakathi kwabantu, wayekhuleka njalo.”-Steps to Christ, p, 93.

q.text: a. UJesu wabafundisa kanjani abafundi Bakhe ukukhuleka-na?

note.text: “Ngesikhathi uJesu elapha emhlabeni, wafundisa abafundi Bakhe ukukhuleka. Wabaqondisa ukuthi bangaletha kanjani izidingo zabo zemihla ngemihla phambi kukaNkulunkulu, nokuthi balahlele zonke izidingo zabo phezu kwakhe. Nesiqiniseko abanika Sona sokuthi izicelo zabo zizolalelwa, kuyisiqiniseko esiza nakithi….

“Ungumfowethu ebuthakathakeni bethu, ‘ngazo zonke izindlela walingwa njengathi;’ kepha njengalowo ongenasono imvelo Yakhe yayesaba okubi; wabekezelela umshikashika nokuhlukunyezwa komphefumulo emhlabeni wesono. Ubuntu Bakhe banikelwa kumkhuleko njengemfuneko nelungelo. Wayethola induduzo nenjabulo kubudlelwano noBaba Wakhe. Uma uMsindisi wabantu, iNdodana kaNkulunkulu, ezwa isidingo sokukhuleka, kukangakanani ababuthakathaka, izidalwa ezifayo nezonayo zizwa isidingo somkhuleko ovuthayo, noqhubekela phambili.”-Steps to Christ, pp. 93, 94.

q.text: b. IBhayibheli likuchaza kanjani ukuzinikela kukaKristu, nesizathu sokuthi lokhu kwakubaluleke kangaka-na?

note.text: “Njengoba ubuntu babuphezu Kwakhe, wazizwa enesidingo samandla avela kuBaba Wakhe. Wakhetha izindawo azokhuleka kuzo. Wayethanda ukugcina ukuxhumana noBaba Wakhe eyedwa entabeni. Ngalesenzo ubungcwele Bakhe, umphefumulo wobuntu baqiniselwa ukusebenza nokumelana nezilingo zosuku. UMsindisi Wethu uzihlanganisa nezidingo zethu nobuthakathaka bethu, kulokhu nguYena osincengelayo, osinxuselayo ebusuku, efuna kuBaba Wakhe izidingo ezintsha zamandla, ukuba zize kithi azosinika amandla nokuqabuleka, silungele ukusebenza nesilingo. Uyisibonelo sethu ezintweni zonke.”-Testimonies for the Church, vol. 2, pp. 201, 202.

“Ngabona ukuthi akukho noyedwa kwabangamashumi amabili wabasha owaziyo ukuthi iyini inkolo evivinyayo. Bazikhonza ngokwabo kodwa bezisho ukuthi bayizinceku zikaKristu; kodwa ngaphandle kokuthi ishwa eliphezu kwabo ligqashulwe, bazobona masinyane ukuthi inxenye yesiphambeko singesabo. Moqondana nokuzidela noma umhlatshelo ngenxa yeqiniso, bazothola indlela elula ngaphezu kwakho konke. Mayelana nokunxusa okuqotho ngezinyembezi nokukhala okunamandla kuNkulunkulu ngomusa Wakhe othethelelayo nangenxa yamandla avela Kuye okumelana nezilingo zikaSathane, bathole kungenasidingo sokubaqotho futhi bakushisekele; bangaphilisana kahle ngaphandle kwayo. UKristu, iNkosi yenkazimulo, yayivame ukuhamba yodwa ezintabeni nasezinkangala ukuze athululele isicelo somphefumulo Wakhe kuBaba Wakhe; kodwa umuntu oyisoni, ongenamandla kuye, ucabanga ukuthi angaphila ngaphandle komkhuleko ongaka.”-Ibid., vol. 1, pp, 504, 505.

q.text: a. UJesu wasembulela kanjani isimo sengqondo kaYise ngesidingo somuntu-na?

note.text: “UBaba wethu osezulwini ulindele ukubeka phezu kwethu ukugcwala kwesibusiso Sakhe. Kuyilungelo lethu ukuphuza kakhulu emthonjeni wothando olungapheli. Kuyamangalisa ukuthi sikhuleka kancane kangaka! UNkulunkulu ukulungele futhi uyathanda ukulalela umkhuleko oqotho wokuthobeka kwabantwana Bakhe, nokho kubonakaliswa ukungabaza okukhulu ohlangothini lwethu ukwenza izidingo zethu zaziwe nguNkulunkulu.”-Selected Messages, bk. 2, p. 118. “UNkulunkulu uhlakaniphe kakhulu ukuba angaphambuka, futhi muhle kakhulu ukuthi angagodla noma kuyini okuhle kulabo abahamba ngokuqondile. Kanjalo ungesabi ukumethemba, noma ungaboni impendulo esheshayo yomkhuleko wakho. Yencika ezithembisweni Zakhe eziqinisekile, ‘Celani, niyakuphiwa.’ ”-Testimonies to Ministers, vol. 6, pp. 61, 62.

q.text: b. Kuyini okuvimba izicelo zethu ukuba zizwakale eNkosini-na?

note.text: “Izingqondo zethu zingadonselwa [ku-Nkulunkulu]; singazindla ngemisebenzi Yakhe, umusa Wakhe, izibusiso Zakhe; kodwa lokhu akwanele, ngomcabango ogcwele, ukuxhumana Naye. Ukuze sikhulume noNkulunkulu, kufanele kubekhona esingakusho Kuye maqondana nokuphila kwethu.”-Ibid., p. 93. “Kuyini izingelosi zasezulwini ezingakucabanga ngezidalwa zoluntu ezingenakho ukuzisiza, ezingaphansi kwesilingo, lapho inhliziyo kaNkulunkulu enothando olungapheli ilangazelela bona, ilungele ukubanika okukhulu kunalokhu abakucelayo noma abakucabangayo, kodwa bakhuleka kancane kakhulu, futhi banokholo oluncane-na? Izingelosi zithanda ukukhothama phambi kukaNkulunkulu, zithanda ukuba seduze Kwakhe. Zibheka ukuxhumana noNkulunkulu njengentokozo yazo enkulu; kodwa abantwana belizwe, abadinga kakhulu usizo lolu kunguNkulunkulu kuphela ongabanika lona, babonakala benelisekile ukuhamba ngaphandle kokukhanya koMoya Wakhe, umngane wobukhona Bakhe. “Ubumnyama balowo omubi buzungeza labo abadembesela ukukhuleka. Izilingo ezinyeyezwa yisitha ziyabayenga ukuba bone; futhi konke lokhu kungenxa yokuba abasebenzisi amalungelo uNkulunkulu abanike wona wokubeka isikhathi sokukhuleka.”-Ibid., p. 94. “Uma sigcina ububi ezinhliziyweni zethu, uma sibambelela noma kwesiphi isono esaziwayo, uNkulunkulu akasoze asizwa; kodwa umkhuleko wozisolayo, umphefumulo odabukile uyamukelwa ngezikhathi zonke. Uma zonke iziphambeko ezaziwayo zilungiswa, singakholwa ukuthi uNkulunkulu uzophendula izicelo zethu. Ukufaneleka kwethu angeke kwasincoma emuseni kaNkulunkulu; kungenxa yokufaneleka kuka-Jesu okuzosisindisa, igazi Lakhe lizosihlanza, kodwa sinomsebenzi esingawenza wokuvumelana nemibandela yokwamukeleka.”-Ibid., p. 95.

q.text: a. Yiziphi izimpawu ezibalulekile zomkhuleko ophumelelayo uma ziqhathaniswa nomkhuleko obuthakathaka nongasizi ngalutho-na?

note.text: “Uma singamukeliswa izinto esizicelile, ngesikhathi esizicele ngaso, kufanele sikholwe ukuthi iNkosi isizwile nokuthi izophendula imikhuleko yethu. Siyona futhi asiboni kahle okwenza ngezinye izikhathi sicela izinto ezingeke zasilethela isibusiso, noBaba wethu osezulwini uyathanda ukuphendula imikhuleko yethu nokusinika lokhu okuhle kakhulu-lokhu nathi esingakufisa uma singakhanyiselwa ngombono ongcwele singabona zonke izinto ngobunjalo bazo. Uma imikhuleko yethu ibonakala ingaphendulwa, kufanele sibambelele esithembisweni; ngoba isikhathi sokuphendula sizofika ngempela, futhi sizokwamukela isibusiso esisidinga kakhulu.”-Steps to Christ, p. 96.

q.text: b. Ukuze umkhuleko uzwakale eNkosini, yisiphi isimoya okufanele sibenaso-na?

note.text: “Uma sisondela ukucela umusa nesibusiso kuNkulunkulu kufanele sibe nomoya wothando nokucela nentethelelo ezinhliziyweni zethu. Singakhuleka kanjani sithi, ‘Usithethelele amacala ethu, njengalokhu nathi sibathethelela abanamacala kithi,’ Nokho sithokozela umoya wokungathetheleli-na? Uma sibheke ukuthi imikhuleko yethu ingalalelwa kufanele sithethelele abanye ngendlela efanayo ngobubanzi njengoba sithemba ukuthethelelwa.”-Ibid., p. 97. [Author’s italics.]

q.text: c. Kuyini esingakufunda kumkhuleko kaEliya ekhulekela imvula-na?

note.text: “Inceku kaEliya yabheka lapho ekhuleka. Izikhathi eziyisithupha ibuya ekubhekeni, ithi, Akukho lutho, kungekho nefu, lungekho nophawu lwemvula. Kodwa umprofehi kazange adangale. Waqhubeka ehlola ukuphila kwakhe, ebheka ukuthi kukuphi lapho ehluleke khona ukudumisa uNkulunkulu, wavuma izono zakhe, waqhubeka futhi ukuhlupha umphefumulo wakhe phambi kukaNkulunkulu, lapho elokhu ebheka isibonakaliso sokuthi umkhuleko wakhe uphenduliwe. Lapho ehlola inhliziyo yakhe, wabonakala encipha kancane kancane, kokubili ekulinganisweni kwakhe nasemehlweni kaNkulunkulu. Kuye kwabonakala sengathi wayengelutho, nokuthi uNkulunkulu wayeyikho konke; kwathi lapho esefinyelele ezingeni lokuzidela, ngesikhathi ebambelele kuMsindisi njengokuphela kwamandla akhe nokulunga kwakhe, impendulo yafika.”- The SDA Bible Commentary, [E. G. White Comments] vol. 2, p. 1035.

q.text: a. Myalo muni obalulekile abapostoli abawunikezayo maqondana nomkhuleko-na? 1 Peter 4:7;

note.text: “Kukhona isidingo sokukhuthalela umkhuleko; makungabikho lutho okukuvimbelayo. Yenza wonke umzamo wokuvula ukuxhumana phakathi kukaJesu nomphefumulo wakho. Funa wonke amathuba okuya lapho kwenziwa khona umkhuleko. Labo abafuna ngempela ukuxhumana noNkulunkulu bazobonakala kwimihlangano yokukhuleka, bethembekile ekwenzeni umsebenzi wabo imihla ngemihla ngobuqotho nokunye ukuvuna yonke inzuzo abangayithola. Bazothuthukisa lonke ithuba lokuzibeka ngokwabo lapho bangathola khona imisebe yokukhanya okuvela ezulwini.”-Steps to Christ, p. 98.

q.text: b. Njengomzali ngamunye, kuyini iNkosi ekulindele kubantwana ukuba bakwenze-na?

note.text: “‘Egameni lami,’ UKristu unxusa abafundi Bakhe ukuba bakhuleke. Egameni likaKristu abalandeli Bakhe kufanele beme phambi kukaNkulunkulu. Ngenani lomhlatshelo owenzelwe bona, bayigugu emehlweni eNkosi. Ngenxa yokulunga kukaKristu esabelwa kona sibalelwa njengabayigugu. Ngenxa kaKristu iNkosi ithethelela labo abamesabayo. Akaboni kubo ububi besoni. Ubheka kubo isithombe seNdodana Yakhe, lowo abakholwa Kuye.”-The Desire of Ages, p. 667.

“Asikho isikhathi noma indawo okungafanele silethe isicelo kuNkulunkulu. Akukho okungasivimba ukuba siphakamisele phezulu izinhliziyo zethu ngomoya womkhuleko oqinisekile. Esitaladini esinesixuku sabantu, phakathi komhlangano webhizinisi, singathumela isicelo kuNkulunkulu sinxuse ukuhola okungcwele, njengoba enza uNehemiya lapho eletha isicelo phambi kweNkosi uAthazeksas. Ubudlelwano obusondelene bungatholakala noma kukuphi lapho sikhona.”-Steps to Christ, p. 99.

2. Yisiphi isiprofetho esibonisa ukubaluleka kokukhuleka njalo ekuseni-na?
3. Kuyini okudingekayo ukuze umkhuleko uphumelele-na?

5. Chaza ukuthi kusho ukuthini ukukhuleka egameni likaJesu.

lessons.title: Kuyini Esingakwenza Ngokungabaza
lessons.keyTextVerse: IVESI LEKHANDA: “Kepha makacele ngokukholwa engangabazi ngalutho; ngokuba ongabazayo unjengedlambi lolwandle eliqhutshwa, ligujiswa ngumoya”

keyText.text: IVESI LEKHANDA: “Kepha makacele ngokukholwa engangabazi ngalutho; ngokuba ongabazayo unjengedlambi lolwandle eliqhutshwa, ligujiswa ngumoya”

keyNote.text: “UNkulunkulu akazange asicele ukuba sikholwe, ngaphandle kokunikeza ubufakazi obanele esingasekela kukho ukholo lwethu.”-Steps to Christ, p. 105.

q.text: a. Kuyini okufanele sikukhumbule lapho silingeka ukuntengantenga phakathi kokukholwa nokungabaza-na?

note.text: “Isithembiso [soMsindisi] esalabo kuphela abathanda ukulandela iNkosi ngokuphelele. UNkulunkulu akacindezeli intando noma ekabani; angeke ahole labo abazidla kakhulu ukuba bangafundiswa, labo abathobela ukwenza eyabo indlela. Kumuntu ombaxa-mbili, lowo ofuna ukulandela eyakhe intando, lapho efakazela ukwenza intando kaNkulunkulu-kulotshiwe, ‘Ngakho makangasho lowomuntu ukuthi uyakwamukeliswa utho yiNkosi.’ Jakobe 1:7.”-Patriachs and Prophets, p. 384.

q.text: b. Kuyini iNkosi esinikeze kona ukuze sinqobe ukungabaza-na?

note.text: “Ukukholwa kwethu kufanele kweyame phezu kobufakazi, kungabi umbukiso. Labo abafisa ukungabaza intando bazolithola ithuba; futhi kulabo abafisa ukwazi iqiniso bazothola ubufakazi obuningi abangasekela ukukholwa kwabo.”-Steps to Christ, p. 105.

“UNkulunkulu unikile ezwini Lakhe ubufakazi obanele besimilo salo esingcwele. Amaqiniso amakhulu aqondene nensindiso yethu alethwe ngokukhanyayo. Ngosizo loMoya Ongcwele, othenjiswe bonke abawufuna ngeqiniso, wonke umuntu angaqonda lamaqiniso ngokwakhe. UNkulunkulu unikile abantu isisekelo esiqinile leso phezu kwaso kuhlezi ukukholwa kwabo.”-The Great Conroversy, pp. 526, 527.

q.text: a. Kufanele siqonde kanjani izimfihlakalo uNkulunkulu angazange asichazele zona-na?

note.text: “Izwi likaNkulunkulu, njengesimilo soMqambi walo ongcwele, libeka izimfihlo ezingeke zaqondwa izidalwa ezifayo. Ukungena kwesono emhlabeni, ukuguqulelwa kukaKristu enyameni, ukuzalwa kabusha, ukuvuswa, nezinye izihloko eziningi ezivela eBhaybhelini, kuyizimfihlo ezijule kakhulu ingqondo yomuntu engazichaza, noma ziqondwe ngokuphelele. Kodwa asikho isizathu sokungabaza izwi likaNkulunkulu ngoba angeke saqonda izimfihlo zokuhlinzekela Kwakhe.”-Steps to Christ, p. 106.

“UNkulunkulu akacindezeli abantu ukuba bashiye ukungakholwa kwabo. Phambi kwabo kukhona ukukhanya nobumnyama, iqiniso nesiphambeko. Kukubo ukuba banqume ukuthi yikuphi abazokwamukela. Umqondo womuntu unikezwe amandla okuhlukanisa phakathi kokuhle nokubi. UNkulunkulu ucebile ukuthi abantu angeke banquma ngokuhluthuka kwenhliziyo, kodwa ngesisindo sobufakazi, ngokunakekela baqhathanise umbhalo ngombhalo. Uma amaJuda ayebeke ubandlululo lwawo futhi aqhathanise isiprofetho esilotshiwe namaqiniso abonisa ukuphila kukaJesu, ayezobona ukuvumelana okuhle phakathi kweziprofetho nokugcwaliseka kwazo ekuphileni nasemsebenzini womGalile othobekile.

“Abaningi badukisiwe namuhla ngendlela efanayo njengoba kwakunjalo kumaJuda. Othishela bezenkolo bafunda iBhayibheli ngokukhanya kokuqonda kwabo namasiko; nabantu abazihloleli iMibhalo ngokwabo, noma bazibonele ngokwabo ukuthi liyini iqiniso; kodwa banikela ukwahlulela kwabo, futhi banikela imiphefumulo yabo kubaholi babo. Ukushumayela nokufundisa izwi Lakhe indlela yinye uNkulunkulu ayigcobile yokuhlakaza ukukhanya; kodwa kufanele silethe yonke imfundiso yokuvivinya imiBhalo.”-The Desire of Ages, pp. 458, 459.

q.text: b. Kuyini okubhekwa eBhayibhelini ukuthi kunezinto okunzima ukuziqonda-na? 2 Peter 3:16.

note.text: “Ubunzima beMibhalo kuthe kwacindezelwa ukungakholwa njengempikiswano yokumelana neBhayibheli; kodwa kuze kube manje ukusuka kulokhu, bamisa ubufakazi obunamandla bokuphefumulelwa okungcwele. Uma ingaqukethe incazelo kaNkulunkulu kodwa lokhu esingakuqonda kalula; uma ubukhulu Bakhe nobukhosi kungaqondwa izingqondo zabafayo, kanjalo iBhayibheli belingeke lithwale ukufaneleka okungenaphutha kwegunya elingcwele. Ubukhosi obukhulu nemfihlakalo yezihloko ezilethwayo kufanele zikhuthaze ukukholwa njengezwi likaNkulunkulu.”-Steps to Christ, p. 107.

q.text: a. Ngeyiphi ingozi ekhethekile kumakholwa alezinsuku zokugcina-na?

note.text: “Lapho uNkulunkulu ethumela ebantwini izixwayiso ezibalulekile ezilethwa njengezimenyezelwa izingelosi ezindiza emkhathini wezulu, ufuna wonke umuntu onikwe umcabango onamandla ukuqaphela isigijimi. Ukwahlulela okwesabekayo okulethwayo okumelene nokukhonza isilo nomfanekiso waso (Isambulo 14:9-11), kufanele uholele bonke ekuhloleni ngokukhuthala iziprofetho bafunde ukuthi luyini uphawu lwesilo, nokuthi kumele bagweme kanjani ukulamukela. Kodwa abantu abaningi baphendula izindlebe zabo ekulaleleni iqiniso futhi baguqukela ezinganekweni. Umpostoli uPawule uthi, uma ebheka ezinsukwini zokugcina: ‘Ngokuba siyeza isikhathi abangayi-kuvuma ngaso isifundiso esiphilileyo.’ 2 Thimothi 4:3. Lesikhathi sesifikile ngokuphelele. Abaningi abalifuni iqiniso leBhayibheli, ngoba lithikameza izifiso zokona, inhliziyo ethanda okomhlaba; noSathane ubanikeza izinkohliso abazithandayo.”-The Great Controversy, pp. 594, 595.

q.text: b. Kuyini okuprofethiwe ngesimo samaxuku amambili ezinsukwini zokugcina-na?

note.text: “UNkulunkulu uzakuba nabantu emhlabeni abazogcina iBhaybheli, iBhaybheli kuphela, njengesilinganiso sezimfundiso zonke nezisekelo zemvuselelo yonke. Imibono yabantu abafundile, ukuphungula kwesayensi, izimiso noma izinqumo zemihlangano yabafundisi, noma iminingi futhi ingavumelani njengoba enjalo amabandla abawamelayo, izwi labaningi -kungekho okukodwa noma konke lokhu kungabhekwa njengobufakazi noma ukumelana noma yimuphi umcijo wenkolo yokukholwa. Ngaphambi kokwamukela noma ngeyiphi imfundiso noma isifiso, kufaneke sifune okusobala ‘Isho njalo iNkosi’ ukuliqinisa.”-Ibid., p. 595.

“Ukukhanya okusha kuzokwembuleka njalo ezwini likaNkulunkulu kulowo ophila ngokuxhumene neLanga lokuLunga. Makungabikho ofinyelela kwisinqumo sokuthi alikho elinye iqiniso elizokwembulwa. Lowo ofuna ngokukhuthala, nangomkhuleko iqiniso uzothola imisebe yokukhanya eyigugu futhi uzokhazimula ngezwi elivela kuNkulunkulu. Amagugu amaningi ahlakazekile okufanele abuthelwe ndawonye ukuba abeyimfuyo yensali yabantu bakaNkulunkulu. Kodwa ukukhanya akunikezwa kalula ukuba kube amandla ebandla, kodwa ukuba kuhlakazelwe kulabo abase-bumnyameni.”-Counsels on Sabbath School Work, p. 34.

q.text: a. Singahlukanisa kanjani phakathi kokubalulekile nokuyize-na?

note.text: “Lapho uNkulunkulu enikeze ubufakazi obulingene bokukholwa, akasoze asusa nanini zonke izaba zokungakholwa. Bonke ababheka izinkintsho noma izipikili zokubophela ukungabaza kwabo bazozithola. Nalabo abenqaba ukwamukela nokulalela izwi likaNkulunkulu kuze kufinyelele lapho lonke izwi lisuswa khona, futhi lingasekho ithuba lokungabaza, angeke bafinyelela ekukhanyeni.”-The Great Controversy, p. 527.

“‘Konke ukuswela kwanikezwa, ukulamba komphefumulo wami kweneliswa; manje iBhayibheli kimi lingukwembulwa kuka-Jesu Kristu. Uyabuza yini ukuthi kungani ngikholwa kuJesu-na? Ngoba kimi unguMsindisi Ongcwele. Kungani ngikholwa yiBhayibheli-na? Ngokuba ngitholile ukuthi liyizwi likaNkulunkulu emphefumulweni wami.’ Singaba nobufakazi kithi bokuthi iBhayibheli liqinisile, ukuthi uKristu uyiNdodana kaNkulunkulu. Siyazi ukuthi ukuthi asilandeli amacebo ezinganekwane ezinobuqili.”-Steps to Christ, p. 112.

q.text: c. Umpostoli uPawule uchaza kanjani amava okholwayo namuhla nawesikhathi esizayo-na?

note.text: “Kulokhu kuphila singaqala ukuqonda izihloko ezimangalisayo zokuhlengwa. Ngokuqonda kwethu okuphelayo singabona ngobuqotho ubukhulu behlazo nenkazimulo, ukuphila nokufa, ukulunga nomusa, okuhlangana esiphambanweni; nokho ngokwamandla ethu engqondo siyehluleka ukubamba ukubaluleka kwawo ngokugcwele. Ubude nobubanzi, ukujula nokuphakama, kothando oluhlengayo zicatshangwa kalufifi. Icebo lensindiso alisoze laqondwa ngokugcwele ngisho nalapho abahlengwayo bebona njengoba bebonwa futhi bazi njengoba baziwa; kodwa ezikhathini ezingunaphakade iqiniso elisha lizoqhubeka lembuleka ezingqondweni ezimangele nezijabulile kakhulu.”-The Great Controversy, p. 651.

“Ngokukholwa singabheka emva kwalokhu sibambe isiqiniseko sikaNkulunkulu sokukhula ekuqondeni, ukuqonda komuntu kuhlanganiswa nobungcwele, namandla onke omphefumulo alethwa ngokuqondile ekuxhumaneni noMthombo wokukhanya. Singathokozela ukuthi konke okusididayo ngokuhlinzekela kukaNkulunkulu kuzokwenziwa kubesobala, izinto ezinzima ukuziqonda sizothola incazelo yazo; lapho izingqondo zethu ezifayo zithola kuphela ukudideka nezinhloso ezonakele, sizobona ukuvumelana okuphelele nokubukeka okukhulu. [1 Korinte 13:12 ngokuphindwa.]”-Ibid., pp. 112, 113.

q.text: a. Iyiphi indlela ephawulekayo iNkosi eyembula izwi layo namuhla njengoba ukuphela kusondela-na?

note.text: “Incwadi leyo eyanamatheliswa bekungeyona incwadi yeSambulo, kodwa inxenye yesiprofetho sikaDaniyeli esihlangene nezinsuku zokugcina… (Daniyeli 12:4) Lapho incwadi ivulwa, isimemezelo senziwa, “Akusayikubakho isikhathi.” (Bheka Isambulo 10:6.) Incwadi kaDaniyeli manje ivuliwe, futhi isambulo esenziwa uKristu kuJohane kumele sifinyelele kubo bonke abakhile emhlabeni. Ngokwanda kolwazi umuntu kufanele alungiselwe ukuma ezinsukwini zokugcina.”-Selected Messages, bk. 2, p. 105.

“Abaningi bathe bathokozela umcabango wokuthi incwadi yeSambulo iyincwadi evaliwe, futhi angeke banikele isikhathi sokufunda izimfihlakalo zayo. Bathi kufanele siqhubeke ukubheka inkazimulo yensindiso, nokuthi izimfihlo ezambulelwa uJohane esiqhingini sasePatmose zifanele ukunakwa kakhulu kunalezi. Kodwa uNkulunkulu akabheki kakhulu lencwadi….
“Incwadi yeSambulo ivulelwe umhlaba lowo obulokhu kukhona, kuyini, nalokhu okuzayo; kuyimfundo yethu labo isiphelo somhlaba sesikile. Kufanele ifundwe ngenhlonipho nokwesaba.

“INkosi uQobo yembulela inceku Yayo uJohane izimfihlo zencwadi yeSambulo, futhi yaceba ukuthi izovulelwa ukufunda kwabo bonke. Kulencwadi kuphawulwa izehlakalo manje ezedlulile, nezinye zentakazelelo engunaphakade ezenzakalayo ngapha nangapha kwethu; ezinye iziprofetho angeke zagcwaliseka ngokuphelele kuze kufike isikhathi sokuphela, lapho impi yokugcina phakathi kwamandla obumnyama neNkosana yezulu zizokwenzeka.”-The SDA Bible Commentary, [E. G. White Comments] vol. 7, p. 954.

q.text: b. Kuyini amakholwa okufanele akwenze ekuhloleni iMibhalo-na?

reviewQuestions: 1. Yisiphi isimo okufanele sibe naso ukuze siqonde ukuthi liyini iqiniso-na?
2. Chaza ukuthi kungani zonke izinxenye zeMibhalo zingaqondwa ngokugcwele.
3. Kungani abaningi bengafuni ukwamukela iqiniso leBhayibheli-na?
4. Kuyini okuzotholwa yilabo abafisa ngempela ukungabaza-na?
5. Kungani ukuzimisela ukulalela kudingeka ukuze uqonde iqiniso-na?

lessons.title: Ukuthokoza ENkosini
lessons.keyTextVerse: IVESI LEKHANDA: “Kepha njengalokhu ningabahlanganyeli bezinhlupheko zikaKristu, thokozani, ukuze kuthi nasekwambulweni kwenkazimulo yakhe nithokoze, nethabe nokwethaba”

keyText.text: IVESI LEKHANDA: “Kepha njengalokhu ningabahlanganyeli bezinhlupheko zikaKristu, thokozani, ukuze kuthi nasekwambulweni kwenkazimulo yakhe nithokoze, nethabe nokwethaba”

keyNote.text: “INkosi izokwenza ukuba amadodana namadodakazi Akhe ajabule, abenokuthula, futhi alalele.”-Steps to Christ, p. 124.

q.text: a. Kuziphendulela kuni uJesu akusho kubafundi Bakhe abanakho kulomhlaba-na?

note.text: “AmaKrestu amiswe njengabathwali bokukhanya endleleni eqonde ezulwini. Kufanele babonakalise ezweni ukukhanya okukhazimula phezu kwabo kuvela kuKristu. Ukuphila kwabo nesimilo kufanele kubonakale kwabanye abazothola umcabango olungile ngoKristu nangomsebenzi Wakhe.”-Steps to Christ, p. 115.

q.text: b. Kuyini abakholwayo okufanele babeyikho ebantwini bonke-na?

note.text: “Kumntwana Wakhe ngamunye, uJesu uthumela incwadi emhlabeni. Uma ungumlandeli kaKristu, uthumela wena incwadi eya emndenini, edolobheni, emgwaqeni, lapho uhlala khona. UJesu, ehlala kuwe, ulangazela ukukhuluma ezinhliziyweni zalabo abangajwayelene Naye. Hleze abalifundi iBhayibheli, noma abalizwa izwi Lakhe elikhuluma kubo ngamakhasi alo; abaluboni uthando lukaNkulunkulu emisebenzini Yakhe. Kodwa uma ungummela kaKristu ngokweqiniso, kungenzeka ukuthi ngawe bangaholelwa ekuqondeni okuthize ngokulunga Kwakhe futhi bazuzelwe ekumthandeni nasekumkhonzeni.”-Ibid., p. 115.

q.text: a. Yikuphi ukubonakaliswa okuphakeme kakhulu kothando lukaNkulunkulu kubantwana Bakhe-na?

note.text: “Uma kubonakala sengathi singabaza uthando lukaNkulunkulu futhi sisola izithembiso Zakhe siyamhlambalaza futhi sidabukisa uMoya Ongcwele. Umama angazizwa kanjani uma abantwana bakhe bekhononda njalo ngaye, kungathi akacabangi okuhle ngabo, lapho ukuphila kwakhe konke ebeke phambili izintakazelelo zabo nokubanika induduzo-na? Mhlawumbe bangabaza uthando lwakhe; kuzophula inhliziyo yakhe. Kungayiphi indlela noma yimuphi umzali ongazizwa ngayo uma ephathwa ngabantwana bakhe ngalendlela-na? Futhi uBaba wethu osezulwini angasibheka kanjani uma sisola uthando Lwakhe, olwaMholela ukuba anikele ngeNdodana Yakhe ezelwe yodwa ukuze sibe nokuphila-na? Umpostoli uma ebhala uthi, ‘Yena ongayigodlanga eyakhe iNdodana, kepha wayinikela ngenxa yethu sonke, kungaba-kanjani ukuba angasiphi konke kanye nayo-na? Roma 8:32. Kodwa bangakhi, ngenzenzo zabo, uma kungewona amazwi, abathi, ‘INkosi ayisho lokhu kimi. Mhlawumbe uthanda abanye, kodwa mina akangithandi.”-Steps to Christ, pp. 118, 119.

q.text: b. Kuyini okufakazele ukuthi uNkulunkulu uthanda ukunika abantwana Bakhe zonke izinto-na?

note.text: “Wena ozizwa ungafanelekile kakhulu, ungesabi ukubeka indaba yakho kuNkulunkulu. Lapho ezinikela uQobo kuKristu ngenxa yesono somhlaba, wazithwalisa icala lomphefumulo ngamunye. ‘Yena ongayigodlanga eyakhe iNdodana, kepha wayinikela ngenxa yethu sonke, kungaba-kanjani ukuba angasiphi konke kanye nayo-na?’ Roma 8:32. Angeke yini agcwalisa izwi lomusa elinikezwe ukusikhuthaza nokusiqinisa-na?
“UKristu ufisi kakhulu ukuhlenge ifa Lakhe lisuswe embusweni kaSathane.”-Christ’s Object Lessons, p. 174.

q.text: c. Loluthando kufanele lubonakaliswe kanjani kithi-na?

note.text: “Izisebenzi zikaKristu eziphumelele emizameni yazo kufanele zimazi uKristu; futhi ukuze bamazi Yena, kufanele bazi uthando Lwakhe. Ezulwini ukufaneleka kwabo njengezisebenzi kulinganiswa nekhono labo lokuthanda njengoKristu athanda basebenze futhi njengoba aSebenza.

“‘Masingathandi ngezwi nangolimi,’ kubhala umpostoli, ‘kodwa ngezenzo nangeqiniso.’ Ukuphelela kwesimilo soMkrestu kutholakala lapho ukuthathwa yinhliziyo ukusiza nokubusisa abanye kubonakala njalo kuvela ngaphakathi. Ngumoya waloluthando oluzungeza umphefumulo wokholwayo okumenza abe usawoti wokuphila ekuphileni nokwenza uNkulunkulu abusise umsebenzi wakhe.”-The Acts of the Apostles, p. 551.

q.text: a. Kuyini okwabonakala ekuphileni kukaKristu emsebenzini Wakhe wokusindisa abantu-na?

note.text: “Ukuphila [kuka-Kristu] kwaku-gcwaliswe kaningi ukuzidela. Wayengenakhaya kulomhlaba, ngaphandle komusa wabangane anikezwe bona njengesihambi. Weza ukuba aphile ngenxa yethu ukuphila impilo yabantu abantula kakhulu, futhi wayehamba futhi asebenze phakathi kwabadingayo nabahluphekile. Engabonwa futhi engahlonishwa, wehla enyuka phakathi kwabantu labo aBenzele okukhulu.”-Gospel Workers, pp. 42, 43.

“Izinyembezi [zeNdodana kaNkulunkulu] bekungezona eZayo, noma beyazi kahle ngakhona izinyawo Zakhe ezibheke khona. Phambi Kwakhe kumi iGetsemane, isehlakalo sosizi Lwakhe oluzayo. Isango lezimvu lalibonakala, lelo iminyaka eyikhulu izilwane zemihlatshelo beziholelwa kulo, okwakufanele livulelwe Yena lapho ezolethwa ‘njengewundlu eliyiswa ekuhlatshweni.’ Isaya 53:7. Eduze kwakukhona iKhalvari, indawo yokubethelwa. Endleleni uKristu masinyane wayezohamba kuyo kwakuzoletha ukwesaba kobumnyama obukhulu okwakufanele enze umphefumulo Wakhe ube ngumnikelo wesono. Kodwa kwakungafanele ukuba azindle ngalezehlakalo eziletha ithunzi phezu Kwakhe kuhora lokujabula. Kungekho ukufukamela Kwakhe ngaphezu kobuhlungu babantu okufiphaza umoya wokuzidela. Wakhalela ukuchithwa kweJerusalema-ngenxa yobumpumputhe nokungadabukeli ukona kwalabo afikela ukubabusisa nokubasindisa.”-The Great Controversy, p. 18.

q.text: b. Ekuhluphekeni Kwakhe nasekulingweni, kuyini okwanikeza uJesu isibindi sokuphelelisa umsebenzi Wakhe-na?

note.text: “Umphumela wokulwa koMsindisi namandla obumnyama kuyinjabulo yabahlengiwe, ukubuyisela inkazimulo kaNkulunkulu ephakadeni nasezindaweni zonke. Futhi ukubaluleka komphefumulo lokhu uBaba enelisekile inani elikhokhiwe; noKristu uQobo, ebheka izithelo zomhlatshelo Wakhe omkhulu, futhi enelisekile.”-Ibid., p. 652.

“Kaningi kuthiwa uJesu wakhala izinyembezi, kodwa lokhu kokuthi akazange aziwe njengo-momothekayo. UMsindisi Wethu ubenguMuntu woSizi ngempela, futhi ejwayelene nosizi, ngoba wayevulela inhliziyo Yakhe kuzozonke izimpi zabantu. Kodwa noma ukuphila Kwakhe bekungukuzidela futhi kufiphazwe ubuhlungu kanye nokunaka, umoya Wakhe awuzange uchofozeke. Ubuso Bakhe abuzange bembathe usizi noma ukuphindisela, kodwa babunokuthula njalo nokucweba. Inhliziyo Yakhe ibingumthombo wokuphila, noma kukuphi lapho ehamba khona wayethwala ukuphumula nokuthula, ukuthokoza nenjabulo.”-Steps to Christ, p. 120.

q.text: a. Lapho isilingo sibhekene nokholwayo, kuyini okwanikeza ukuze anqobe lempi yesimoya-na?

note.text: “Sonke siyahlolwa; usizi olunzima ukuluthwala, izilingo okunzima ukumelana nazo. Ungatsheli umuntu ofayo ukukhathazeka kwakho, kodwa kuyise konke kuNkulunkulu ngomkhuleko. Yenza kube ngumthetho ukuthi ungakhulumi nelilodwa izwi lokungabaza nokudumala. Ungenza okukhulu ukukhanyisa ukuphila kwabanye nokukhuthaza imizamo yabo, ngamazwi ethemba nokwenama okungcwele.”-Steps to Christ, p. 26.

q.text: b. Kungani abaningi bengabaza phakathi kokukholwa nokungabaza lapho belingwa noma bevivinywa-na? Kufanele benzeni-na?

note.text: “Kukhona imiphefumulo enesibindi kaningi ecindezelwe kabuhlungu yisilingo, elindele ukuquleka empini kamina nasemandleni omubi. Ungadangalisi lowo oshikashikeka kanzima. Mthokozise ngesibindi, khuluma amazwi anethemba azomgqugquzela endleleni yakhe. Kanjalo ukukhanya kukaKristu kungakhazimula kuwe. ‘Ngokuba akakho phakathi kwethu oziphilela yena.’ Roma 14:7. Ngomfutho wethu ngabomu sikhuthaza abanye futhi sibaqinise, noma sibadangalise, noma baxoshwe kuKristu naseqinisweni.

“Kukhona abaningi abanomcabango ophambukile wokuphila nesimilo sikaKristu. Bacabanga ukuthi wayentula imfudumalo nenjabulo, ukuthi wayelukhuni, eqinile, enosizi. Ezikhathini eziningi amava ezenkolo anikezwa amabala yilabo ababheka ngombono ofiphele.”-Ibid., p. 120.

q.text: c. Injani indlela yabalungileyo naphakathi kwesilingo-na?

note.text: “Indlela ingabanzima futhi ibe-ngummango owenyukelayo; kungabakhona amagebe esandleni sokudla nasesandleni sokhohlo; kungafanela sibekezelele umsebenzi ohambweni lwethu; uma sikhathele, uma silangazela ukuphumula, kufanela ukuba siqhubeke sisebenze; uma sikhathele, kufanelela ukuba silwe; uma sidangele, kufanele sibe nethemba; kodwa ngoKristu ongomholi wethu angeke sihluleke ukufinyelela enqabeni elangazelwayo ekugcineni. UKristu uQobo wayihamba indlela emaholo phambi kwethu futhi wayenza yaba bushelelezi enzela izinyawo zethu.
“Futhi yonke indlela enyukelayo eholela ekuphileni okuphakade iyimithombo yenjabulo yokuqabula okhathele.”-Thoughts from the Mount of Blessing, p. 140.

q.text: a. Yisiphi isithembiso sikaJesu okufanele sisinikeze isizathu sokujabula nokudumisa uBaba wethu osezulwini-na?

note.text: “Akuyona intando kaNkulunkulu ukuthi abantu Bakhe bangabhekelwa phansi ngokuxwaywa. Kodwa iNkosi yethu ayisikhohlisi. Ayithi kithi, ‘Ungesabi; azikho izingozi endleleni yakho.’ Iyazi ukuthi kukhona izilingo nezingozi, futhi isiphatha ngokucwebile. INkosi ayihlosi ukusisusa ezweni lesono nobubi, kodwa isikhomba kwisiphephelo esingahluleki.”-Steps to Christ, pp. 122, 123.

q.text: b. Yisho ezinye izithembiso ezimangalisayo zokuthula nenjabulo uJesu azinikezayo.

note.text: “Asikwazi kuphela ukubukela phambili ukudideka okusha nokulwa okuzayo, kodwa singabheka okudlule ngokufanayo nalokhu okuzayo, futhi masithi, ‘Kuze kube manje uJehova usisizile.’ ‘Nanjengezinsuku zakho obanjalo amandla akho.’ Duteronomi 33:25. Izilingo angeke zidlule amandla esizonikezwa ukuzithwala. Ngakho-ke masithathe umsebenzi wethu lapho siwuthole khona, sikholwe ukuthi noma yini esizohlangana nayo, amandla alinganiselwe isilingo esinikezwa sona.

“Futhi ingabe amasango ezulu azovulwa ukwamukela abantwana bakaNkulunkulu, futhi ezindebeni zeNkosi yenkazimulo ukuvuma kuzowela ezindlebeni zabo njengomculo onamandla, ‘Zanini nina enibusisiwe nguBaba, nidle ifa lombuso eniwulungiselweyo selokhu kwasekelwa umhlaba.’ Mathewu 25:34.

“Ngombono wefa elikhazimulayo elizoba ngelakhe, ‘Ingabe uyakukhiphani umuntu, kube yisihlengo sokuphila kwakhe-na? Mathewu 16:26….Umphefumulo ohlengiwe wahlanzwa esonweni, ngamandla onke athobekile anikelwa emsebenzini kaNkulunkulu, adlula ukubaluleka; futhi kukhona injabulo ezulwini phambi kukaNkulunkulu nezingelosi ezingcwele ngomphefumulo owodwa osindiswayo, injabulo igcizelelwa ngezingoma zokunqoba okungcwele.”-Ibid., pp. 125, 126.
